ALPHA_CENTAURI_CAT_DESC: [From.GetName]'s peculiar orbit around its red dwarf star renders the planet tidally locked, and potentially worthy of further investigation.
ANCREL_MECHANO_CAT_DESC: This planet is covered from pole to pole in rusting, ancient machinery, much of which is itself covered in an unidentified, organic tissue. What manner of creatures could have built this technological curiosity, and what happened to them?
ANCREL_RUBRICATOR_CAT_DESC: Faint traces of weapon radiation indicative of a military spacecraft have been detected on [From.GetName].
ARID_PLANET_DESC: The [From.GetPlanetMoon] is not the most welcoming of places, but if our initial scans are any indication it could hold some valuable resources.
ARID_SENSOR_DESC: We have detected something out of the ordinary on the arid [From.GetPlanetMoon]. It seems like somebody has been here before us. Further investigation is needed.
AST_CLUSTER_DESC: An unusually deliberate, geometric configuration of minerals drifts through the debris belt by [Root.GetName], and is possibly of alien origin.
AST_CRATER_DESC: [Root.GetName] is home to a number of exquisite impact craters. However, something breaks the visual uniformity in one of the larger craters...
AST_DEBRIS_FIELD_1_DESC: Sensors report a number of possible points of interest within the dense debris field surrounding [Root.GetName].
AST_GEAR_DESC: Observing the massive asteroid [Root.GetName], we have found...\n\nSomething. Further investigation is warranted.
AST_ILLICIT_DARK_DESC: [Root.GetName] periodically spews an alarmingly eclectic mix of particles and radiation into the void.
AST_MINING_DESC: Initial analysis of the asteroid's composition points towards potentially interesting finds.
AST_SHRINE_1_DESC: [Root.GetName] has been partially hollowed out and carved with exquisite precision. There is something familiar about the lines and curves etched into the rock...
AST_WAVELENGTHS_1_DESC: The asteroid [Root.GetName] is emitting some form of radiation in controlled bursts. Is someone - something - trying to communicate with us?
ATM_ANOMALY_DESC: Atmospheric readings from [Root.GetName] do not match simulated projections.
BARR_BASE_DESC: A cursory scan of the planet's surface reveals a weak signal pulsing into the darkness of space.
BAR_COLONY_DESC: Optical sensors isolate a cluster of shapes on the barren surface of [Root.GetName] that could be buildings.
COLD_RESEARCH_DESC: Our Science Officer has found an anomaly. It will require extensive probing, but could garner a substantial find.
CONT_SIGNS_DESC: [Root.GetName]'s surface appears heavily pockmarked, which is not unusual.\n\nWhat is unusual is the regular shape of the scars, irregularly distributed. This is unlikely to be the result of meteorite impacts.
CON_BIOLOGY_DESC: The forests on this planetoid bear promises of interesting finds.
CRYSTAL_MANUFACTORY_DESC: An old, seemingly abandoned structure looms over [Root.GetName], an otherwise unremarkable asteroid.
DATA_DIAMOND_CAT_DESC: The superficial layer of surface ice on [From.GetName] covers an abnormally large crystal deposit. We are also detecting the presence of a faint signal.
DES_BURIED_DESC: The desert planet [Root.GetName] seems to conceal some buried secrets.
DES_PLANET_DESC: The scorching heat of [Root.GetName] is within the expected range. However, there is more unusual data still being collected by our team. Further study is needed before a final report can be filed.
DIMENSIONAL_POCKET_DESC: The debris field which [Root.GetName] is part of roils and swirls under the influence of unknown forces.
DISTAR_BRAINSLUG_CAT_DESC: Scans of [From.GetName] reveal what appear to be the abandoned settlements of a primitive society. What manner of fate could have befallen their builders?
DISTAR_CLONE_CAT_DESC: Initial imaging of the ruined [From.GetName] ring world indicates a number of intact vats located on some of the dilapidated sections. Whatever these vats might hold is unknown.
DISTAR_COLLAPSE_CAT_DESC: Scarred by centuries of debris impacts, a dilapidated relic of a station hangs in orbit, trailing wearily behind [From.GetName]. Its decrepit state and unrecognized technology will require a team of specialists to investigate.
DISTAR_DEAD_GOD_CAT_DESC: [From.GetName] is remarkably aspherical, possessing some sort of enormous formation on its surface that defies geological models.
DISTAR_DIAMOND_CAT_DESC: [From.GetName] pulses steadily, its helioseismology indicating an internal composition far denser than expected. What could be responsible for this surprising density?
DISTAR_ELECTRO_CAT_DESC: Glowing webs of an unknown origin periodically illuminate the surface of [From.GetName].
DISTAR_EXO_CAT_DESC: Entire continents on [From.GetName] are blanketed in a strange growth that seems at odds with the rest of the planet's flora.
DISTAR_FLARE_CAT_DESC: Despite the planet's lack of atmosphere, there is evidence of some kind of artificial structures on [From.GetName] that may indicate a past civilization.
DISTAR_FLYTRAP_CAT_DESC: Plant life of truly incredible proportions dominates the landscape of [From.GetName], its vibrant colors and gargantuan size almost calling to our xeno-biologists.
DISTAR_FOES_CAT_DESC: The primitives eking out an existence on the ashy plains of [From.GetName] are remarkably similar to the ones discovered on another tomb world in the same system.
DISTAR_GEODE_CAT_DESC: Resonance imaging of the [From.GetName] asteroid suggests an internal composition consisting of rare crystals.
DISTAR_HOLO_CAT_DESC: Readings suggest the presence of an unknown fleet in orbit of [From.GetName]. They do not respond to hails.
DISTAR_ICE_CAT_DESC: The measured surface temperature of [From.GetName] is in the hundreds of degrees, despite its frozen surface. What could be causing these discrepancies?
DISTAR_LIVING_CAT_DESC: There is something unusual, almost hypnotic about the soft undulations of the sea covering [From.GetName]. Its motions match no known projections for tidal behavior.
DISTAR_LOST_CAT_DESC: There is movement in the upper atmosphere of [From.GetName], as though a ship was gliding hurriedly through the clouds.
DISTAR_MEDGAS_CAT_DESC: Despite expected projections, [From.GetName] has a particularly large solid core beneath its incredibly thick mantle of unique gases. Our scientists recommend further investigation.
DISTAR_MED_CAT_DESC: A derelict tanker of unknown origin orbits [From.GetName], its reservoirs heavy with some manner of organic substance.
DISTAR_MERCURY_CAT_DESC: Interior imaging of [From.GetName] suggests massive underground caverns wait below the planet's surface. They may be worth investigation.
DISTAR_METAL_CAT_DESC: The atmosphere of [From.GetName] is reflecting our sensors at radio frequencies. Something down there is interfering with our signals.
DISTAR_MOLTEN_CAT_DESC: A remarkable array of gases are being vented on [From.GetName] - ones not usually found on molten worlds. Some of these gases show promising industrial value.
DISTAR_NANOCITY_CAT_DESC: The geoscape of [From.GetName] is dominated by what appear from orbit to be silvery, metallic crystals of dimensions never-before-seen. From orbit, they eerily resemble skyscrapers. Closer study is warranted.
DISTAR_NANOSAND_CAT_DESC: Scanners indicate the sandy dunes of [From.GetName] are almost entirely composed of granulate rare metals. Perhaps some valuable resources could be extracted from them.
DISTAR_NANO_CAT_DESC: The planetary body [From.GetName] appears to be covered in some manner of grayish substance, possessing strange properties and varying metallic composition.
DISTAR_OCEAN_CAT_DESC: Scans suggest an intricate system of tunnels lies hidden beneath the waters of [From.GetName]. What could have created them?
DISTAR_PHASE_CAT_DESC: Enigmatic energy readings surround [From.GetName], as though the entire planet is wavering in and out of existence.
DISTAR_POD_CAT_DESC: First thought to be asteroids, a halo of motionless drop pods surrounds [From.GetName].
DISTAR_PUZZLE_CAT_DESC: An object that reflects our sensors has been located in the [From.GetStarName] asteroid field, near [From.GetName]. Visual observation has identified the object as polygonal in shape, but due to lack of scanner data, little else is known.
DISTAR_RAINBOW_CAT_DESC: The accretion disk around [From.GetName] exhibits a remarkable refraction spectrum, not unlike that of a rainbow. What could be causing it?
DISTAR_RAT_CAT_DESC: Our initial survey of the [From.GetName] suggests this planet is the fallen capital of a lost empire whose junkyards we have encountered prior. A more thorough investigation may yield further information.
DISTAR_ROBO_CAT_DESC: Scanners indicate an unusually high level of symmetry on the surface of [From.GetName].
DISTAR_RUM_CAT_DESC: The emission spectra of [From.GetName] suggest the gas giant's primary composition has the same molecular structure as a popular inebriant.
DISTAR_SIGNAL_CAT_DESC: Ship sensors are picking up an unexplained pattern of interference in the [From.GetStarName] System.
DISTAR_SOOTHE_CAT_DESC: Scans of [From.GetName] reveal a continental crust filled with resonant crystals. We may be able to make some use of them.
DISTAR_SOOTHE_GC_CAT_DESC: [From.GetName]'s magnetosphere is highly appealing to our research drones in orbit, for reasons they cannot explain. We should investigate further.
DISTAR_SOY_CAT_DESC: Sensors indicate there are artificial formations buried beneath rich vegetation on [From.GetName].
DISTAR_THIRSTY_CAT_DESC: Canyons deep enough to be seen from orbit furrow the surface of [From.GetName], yet the planet is dry as a dustbowl. What could have happened to the water that once so profoundly carved [From.GetName]'s' stone?
DISTAR_TIME_CAT_DESC: There are fragments of an unknown vessel in close orbit of [From.GetName].
DISTAR_WARFORM_CAT_DESC: Some manner of artificial structure peaks out from between the toxic clouds of [From.GetName]'s atmosphere.
DISTAR_WRECK_CAT_DESC: Sensors report a shipwreck of unidentified origin has been sighted in orbit of [Root.GetName].
DISTAR_ZONE_CAT_DESC: Sensors indicate an isolated pinprick of artificial structures on [From.GetName].
FED_THE_BAREST_MINIMUM: Give them the barest minimum to comply.
FED_WE_WILL_BE_IN_BREACH: Our Empire will be in §RBreach of Galactic Law§!.
FED_WE_WILL_RETAIN: We will retain our current policies.
FEN_HABBANIS_DESC: Fen Habbanis III, or simply "Fen Habbanis" as it was known to its ancient inhabitants, was the capital of the First League.
FRBR_GRIMACING_DESC: Repeated scans of [Root.GetName]'s surface give inconsistent sensor readings, almost as if the planet itself was in a constant state of upheaval.
FROZEN_SPRINGS_CAT_desc: Whilst surveying [From.GetName], the science team detected unusual heat signatures coming from below the frozen surface of the planet.
FROZEN_TERRAFORMING_CANDIDATE_EFFECT: §Y[From.GetName]§! will be able to be terraformed if we choose the §H$ap_hydrocentric$§! ascension perk and research the £society£ §H$tech_climate_restoration$§! technology.
FROZ_BASE2_DESC: Sensors pick up unexpected activity from an isolated point on [Root.GetName]'s arctic surface.
FROZ_BASE_DESC: Sensors pick up unexpected activity from an isolated point on [Root.GetName]'s frozen surface.
FROZ_BOX_DESC: Scans indicate the presence of a foreign, alien-made object on one of §H[Root.GetName]'s§! many frozen mountain tops.
FROZ_ILLUMINATED_DESC: Inexplicable optical phenomena play across the surface of [Root.GetName], clearly visible from space.
GAEA_CHECKERED_DESC: Visual scans of [Root.GetName]'s surface reveal a grid pattern seemingly covering the entire planet.
GAIA_MOVE_DESC: As a Gaia-class planet, [Root.GetName] is expected to teem with life...
GAIA_RECORD_DESC: [Root.GetName]'s verdant plains are quiet, save for a weak but steady beacon signal.
GAS_CLOUDY_DESC: The atmospheric patterns of [Root.GetName] are highly atypical for a gas giant of modest size.
GAS_ZRO_ICE_DESC: It seems [Root.GetName] is lacking the hydrogen and helium to be classified as a proper gas giant and is, in fact, an ice giant.
GEN_ABANDONED_SHIP_DESC: A cursory scan of [Root.GetName] yields surprising results.\n\nSomething seems to be scanning us back...
GEN_DERELICT_SHIP_DESC: Our initial scans have caught an irregular signal reminiscent of our own distress patterns.
GEN_DESERT_DESC: The atmosphere of [Root.GetName] is extremely thin, and yet something not unlike wind seems to agitate the seas of sand that make up its surface.
GEN_LOST_CARGO_DESC: While scanning the asteroid belt our science team found some sort of irregularity.
GEN_MYSTICAL_DESC: Our survey has uncovered something that can only be described by the science team as "mystical." We would need to investigate the phenomenon in more detail to unshroud this mystery.
GEN_OLD_WAR_DESC: The mineral composition of [Root.GetName] does not match projections.
GEN_PLAYGROUND_DESC: Impressive structures litter a small area on the surface of [Root.GetName], practically begging for some archaeological work.
HAB_CORN_DESC: Optical scans indicate that the surface of [Root.GetName] is unusually verdant in places.
HAB_MAT_DESC: Backscattering spectrometry sensors indicate the presence of valuable substances in the planet's crust.
HBL_LUSH_PLANET_1_DESC: [Root.GetName] is exceptionally green, and preliminary scans indicate that there might be several articles of interest on the surface.
HBL_MUSIC_1_DESC: There is a pattern of unusual sonic activity on [Root.GetName].
HOLE_RADIATION_DESC: Sensors pick up unusual readings in the vicinity of [Root.GetName] - readings that are hard to explain being this close to a black hole.
INTEMPORAL_ORB_CAT_DESC: We have discovered powerful concentrated energy in the form of an orb. Investigation is advised.
IRASSIA_DESC: Whatever biosphere this world may have once supported is long gone.
LEVELED_DESC: [Root.GetName] seems to exhibit one, and only one, interesting geological feature...
MOLTEN_BASE_DESC: Sensors pick up rhythmic movement on the hellish surface of [Root.GetName].
NANO_SWARM_CAT_DESC: [Root.GetName] has significant bodies of water, and yet its landmasses are lifeless deserts. Further study is warranted.
NOTIME: We don't have time for this.
NUKE_PLANET_DESC: The nuclear wasteland is evidently a sign of a previous civilization. Our scanners are picking up activity at certain locations that we should investigate.
PROJ_MOON_DESC: According to preliminary scans, [Root.GetName] is exhibiting several strange properties and gives readings that are not at all in line with what one would expect from a planet of this type...
RESEARCHIT: Send it to our homeworld for research.
SEA_CRYSTAL_CAT_DESC: Starlight can be seen glinting off an unusually large object, just under the ocean surface of [Root.GetName].
SEA_DESC: Vaguely-defined shapes swirl with the currents in [Root.GetName]'s vast oceans.
SINGING_PLANET_CAT_DESC: This planet emits strange magnetic waves, quite unlike anything we have seen so far, almost as if it is trying to communicate with us. It is only logical to investigate this unusual phenomenon - we may have just encountered an extraordinary example of life on a planetary scale.
SOLARPUNK_CAT_DESC: There are an unusual amount of hyperlanes in this system. Usually, we would dismiss these as too small to facilitate a spaceship, but the sheer amount is intriguing in and of itself.
STAR_RESONANCE_DESC: Our scientists have discovered what first appeared to be a sensor malfunction near the corona of [root.GetName], however it's still there after rebooting. A closer look is warranted.
SUN_RAYS_DESC: We have detected odd radiation that our Science Officer demands to investigate.
SUN_TEAPOT_DESC: Scanning the star unveils a small object in rapid orbit. Its small size and high velocity make it difficult for our sensors to isolate.
TEMPORAL_PRISM_CAT_DESC: Unusual fluctuations in spacetime have been detected in the vicinity of [From.GetName]. Further analysis is advised.
TERRAFORMING_CANDIDATE_EFFECT: §Y[From.GetName]§! will be able to be terraformed once the £society£ §H$tech_climate_restoration$§! technology has been researched.
TIYANKI_ASTEROID_CAT_DESC: Rock samples retrieved from the asteroid belt unexpectedly contain a large amount of biological tissue.
TOXIC_TERRAFORMING_CANDIDATE_EFFECT: §Y[From.GetName]§! may be terraformed if we choose the §H$ap_detox$§! Ascension Perk.
TOX_MAT_DESC: Backscattering spectrometry sensors indicate the presence of valuable substances beneath [Root.GetName]'s noxious clouds.
TOX_PLANET_DESC: There appears to be deliberately-crafted structures on the planet's surface, pointing toward a past long forgotten.
TOX_PURPLE_RAIN_DESC: [Root.GetName]'s toxic biosphere gives the planet a unique color scheme.
TOX_STRUCTURES_DESC: Somewhere beneath [Root.GetName]'s unctuous clouds, unnatural structures silhouette themselves against the toxic surface.
TROP_BIOLOGY_DESC: The initial data gathered from the tropical forests of [Root.GetName] indicate that something is out of the ordinary.
TROP_CONDITIONS_DESC: [Root.GetName] appears to hold something of interest deep within its dense jungles.
TROP_PETS_DESC: Irregular patterns of movement have been detected within the dense tropical undergrowth of [Root.GetName].
TROP_WOODS_DESC: The surface of [Root.GetName] is dominated by particularly impressive-looking trees.
TUTORIAL_DESC: During the survey of our home system we found something on [From.GetName] that did not match earlier observations made from our homeworld.
TUTORIAL_ORBITAL_RING_DESC: §SOrbital Rings§! are vast £megastructure£ §SMegastructures§! which are built to encircle an entire £planet£ §SPlanet§!. They make for an efficient bridge between space and the planet below, providing room for facilities like Shipyards, defensive structures, and resource hubs.\n\nThe Orbital Ring view is where we can add or remove £building£ §SBuildings§! and §SModules§!, as well as upgrade the Orbital Ring to higher tiers. Upgrading tiers increases the number of slots we have available to build in. Tiers are limited by planetary infrastructure.
UBUME_BABY_CAT_DESC: Scans have identified a debris field of uncertain origin. Could this have something to do with the abandoned science ship patrolling the system?
UHB_ANCIENT_RUINS_1_DESC: Impressive structures litter [Root.GetName]'s surface, practically begging for some archaeological work.
UHB_BUOY_DESC: A wavering signal haunts [Root.GetName], though it does not seem to originate from the planet's surface.
UNIQUE_SYSTEM_BATTLE_CAT_DESC: A long-forgotten battlefield where ancient empires once fought for supremacy of the galaxy - now all that remains are the vessels of those who fought under their banners.
VENDING_MACHINE_CAT_DESC: A signal beacon orbits [From.GetName], beckoning travelers nearer. On the asteroid, a giant metal monolith looms, its purpose unknown.
VULTAUMAR_DESC: The ancient homeworld of the Vultaum homeworld. It has seen better days.
WAT_PLANET_DESC: Scans of [Root.GetName] return subtle readings of something beneath the surface.
WENKWORT_CAT_DESC: This entire world is unusually picturesque - suspiciously so, perhaps. What forces are at work that could have caused this?
YUHTAAN_DESC: This world, which served as the capital of the ancient Yuht Empire, once supported life. No longer.
abandoned_terraforming_completed: The world has been terraformed into a different habitat.
action.1.desc_01: I bring greetings from [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the undisputed ruler of the [contact_empire.GetName]. Respect our borders and keep out of our affairs, and perhaps our mighty fleets will refrain from visiting your worlds.
action.1.desc_02: Well met. I represent the [contact_empire.GetName], led by the illustrious [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. We rule our region of space under a divine mandate, and so long as you do not interfere in our spiritual affairs, our relations may remain cordial.
action.1.desc_03: We are the [contact_empire.GetName], minions of the wise [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. Our aim is to improve ourselves through the use of technology, and whether you agree with these goals or not, we trust you will remain amicable neighbors.
action.1.desc_04: Greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName]. We are a peaceful nation, justly ruled by our beloved [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. Whatever grievances might arise between our people in the future, we hope they can be settled through dialogue rather than violence.
action.1.desc_05: I speak on behalf of the [contact_empire.GetName], and I have been authorized to bring you greetings. As long as you stay out of our internal affairs and treat our great leader [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] with reverence, I see no reason for our diplomatic relations to sour.
action.1.desc_06: [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] sends regards from the ruling council of the [contact_empire.GetName]. We hope for a productive relationship with your people, but be warned that our military will respond to any transgressions near our space with maximum force.
action.1.desc_07: [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] and the rest of the religious council bids you greetings. We provide spiritual guidance to the [contact_empire.GetName] and our stated goal is to lead this great nation on a path to salvation. Do not cross this path and we may live in friendship.
action.1.desc_08: Greetings. I have been chosen by [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] to represent the [contact_empire.GetName] in all diplomatic dealings with your people. We strive to unlock the full potential of technology, and you would do well not to interfere with our pursuit of knowledge.
action.1.desc_09: I am authorized to offer you cordial greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName]. We have built a peaceful system of government that operates under the supervision of a council led by [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. May our two nations know nothing but peace.
action.1.desc_10: Greetings. I speak for [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] and the wealthy elite of the [contact_empire.GetName]. We are always looking for new trading partners, and hopefully we can come to some sort of accommodation that will benefit the commerce of both our nations.
action.1.desc_11: I represent the [contact_empire.GetName]. Our elected leader [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] hopes for peaceful relations with your people, but know that we are more than capable of defending our way of life.
action.1.desc_12: I bring greetings from [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the elected leader of the [contact_empire.GetName]. We believe in the right of all sapient beings to fulfill their individual spiritual needs, and we hope you share in this sentiment.
action.1.desc_13: Greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName]. [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] is our elected representative, but in truth all citizens have a voice in our government. We strive to better ourselves through technology, a desire we hope you will respect.
action.1.desc_14: Well met, friends. We are the [contact_empire.GetName], a nation built on the principles of peaceful coexistence and individual freedoms. [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the current head of our government, has expressed a sincere hope for a lasting friendship between our two peoples.
action.1.desc_15: Greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName]. We are a democratic nation committed to upholding the individual freedoms of our citizens. Our elected leader, [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], hopes for a long and productive relationship with your people.
action.1.desc_16: Alien beings, I speak on behalf of [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the undisputed ruler of the [contact_empire.GetName]. Respect our borders and keep out of [contact_empire.GetSpeciesName] affairs, and perhaps our mighty fleets will refrain from visiting your wretched worlds.
action.1.desc_17: Heed this message, aliens. I represent the [contact_empire.GetName], led by the illustrious [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. We rule our region of space under a divine mandate, and so long as you do not mock our faith in what passes for your culture, there may be peace between us.
action.1.desc_18: We are the [contact_empire.GetName], minions of the wise [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. Our aim is to improve ourselves through the use of technology. Whether you agree with these goals or not, do not think to challenge us, alien.
action.1.desc_19: We are the [contact_empire.GetName], a peaceful nation ruled justly by our beloved [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. I do not know what barbarity your bizarre species is capable of, but we hope future grievances can be settled through dialogue rather than violence.
action.1.desc_20: I speak on behalf of the [contact_empire.GetName], and I come with a message for your depraved species. As long as you stay out of our internal affairs and treat our great leader [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] with reverence, there may yet be peace between our nations.
action.1.desc_21: [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] and the ruling council of the [contact_empire.GetName] have instructed me to bring you this warning. Keep your ridiculous looking alien ships well away from our space, and know that our military will respond to any transgressions with maximum force.
action.1.desc_22: [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] and the rest of the religious council demands your attention, heathen creatures. We provide spiritual guidance to the [contact_empire.GetName] and our intention is to lead this great nation on a path to salvation. Do not defile this path with your presence, alien.
action.1.desc_23: Attention, alien creatures. Unfortunately, I was chosen by [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] to represent the [contact_empire.GetName] in all diplomatic dealings with your primitive civilization. We intend to unlock technologies you cannot comprehend - do not interfere.
action.1.desc_24: After much deliberation, I have been authorized to speak with you on behalf of the [contact_empire.GetName]. We have built a peaceful system of government that operates under the supervision of a council led by [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. Your alien influence is not welcome here, and we would prefer if you kept your distance.
action.1.desc_25: I speak for [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] and the wealthy elite of the [contact_empire.GetName]. Your alien ways are objectionable to us, but perhaps we can still engage in limited trade - assuming your inferior civilization produces anything of value.
action.1.desc_26: I represent the [contact_empire.GetName]. Our elected leader [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] would have you know that we are more than capable of defending our way of life. Do not interfere in our affairs, aliens.
action.1.desc_27: I come with a message from [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the elected leader of the [contact_empire.GetName]. We believe in the right of all sapient beings to fulfill their individual spiritual needs, and will brook no alien interference in this matter.
action.1.desc_28: You are speaking to the [contact_empire.GetName]. [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] is our elected representative, but in truth all citizens have a voice in our government. We strive to better ourselves through technology, a desire we do not expect primitive aliens such as yourselves to understand.
action.1.desc_29: We are the [contact_empire.GetName], a nation built on the principles of peaceful isolation and individual freedoms. [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the current head of our government, requests that you leave us be and pursue your nefarious alien agendas far away from our territory.
action.1.desc_30: I speak on behalf of the [contact_empire.GetName]. We are a democratic nation committed to upholding the individual freedoms of our citizens in a galaxy full of alien horrors. Our elected leader, [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], warns you not to interact with our citizens or approach our space.
action.1.desc_31: I bring greetings from [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the undisputed ruler of the [contact_empire.GetName]. Given your fascinating form, which martial techniques do your warriors employ? We wish to learn more about your species.
action.1.desc_32: Well met, alien. I represent the [contact_empire.GetName], led by the illustrious [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. We rule our region of space under a divine mandate, and so long as you do not interfere in our spiritual affairs, we look forward to learning more about your culture.
action.1.desc_33: We are the [contact_empire.GetName], minions of the wise [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. Our aim is to build an efficient society through the use of technology, and we are always keen to study new alien civilizations to see what can be learned from them.
action.1.desc_34: Fair aliens, I bring greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName]. We are a peaceful nation, justly ruled by our beloved [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. We hope today will mark the beginning of an era of friendship between ourselves and your fascinating species.
action.1.desc_35: I speak on behalf of the [contact_empire.GetName], and I bring you greetings. Our great leader [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] is very pleased to have made contact with your unique species, and we look forward to an exchange of culture and ideas.
action.1.desc_36: [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] sends regards from the ruling council of the [contact_empire.GetName]. We hope for a productive relationship with your impressive nation, and our military has been instructed to treat all members of your species with respect.
action.1.desc_37: [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] and the rest of the religious council bids you greetings. We provide spiritual guidance to the [contact_empire.GetName] and our stated goal is to lead this great nation on a path to salvation. We would be honored if your great species joins us on this journey.
action.1.desc_38: Greetings. I am honored to have been chosen by [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] to represent the [contact_empire.GetName] in all diplomatic dealings with your fascinating species. We strive to unlock the full potential of technology, a goal we hope you find equally worthwhile.
action.1.desc_39: I am delighted to offer you cordial greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName]. We have built a peaceful system of government that operates under the supervision of a council led by [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. May your great species know nothing but peace.
action.1.desc_40: Greetings. I speak for [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] and the wealthy elite of the [contact_empire.GetName]. We are always looking for new trading partners among the many diverse and delightful alien nations we encounter as our ships explore the galaxy.
action.1.desc_41: I represent the [contact_empire.GetName]. Our elected leader [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] believes in peace through strength, but do not be alarmed by our military spending. We are impressed by your species and hope you will agree to a cultural exchange between our people.
action.1.desc_42: I bring greetings from [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the elected leader of the [contact_empire.GetName]. We believe in the right of all sapient beings to fulfill their individual spiritual needs, and we trust that an enlightened species such as yourselves share this sentiment.
action.1.desc_43: Greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName]. [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] is our elected representative, but in truth all citizens have a voice in our government. We strive to better ourselves through technology and by studying the alien cultures we encounter as we explore the galaxy.
action.1.desc_44: Well met, alien friends. We are the [contact_empire.GetName], a nation built on the principles of peaceful coexistence and individual freedoms. The cultural achievements of your species have greatly impressed [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the current head of our government.
action.1.desc_45: Greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName]. We are a democratic nation committed to upholding the individual freedoms of our citizens regardless of their species. Our elected leader, [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], hopes for a long and fruitful relationship with your people.
action.1.desc_49:
Hello, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We have a special message from our [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle], just for you!

...

...

§RWITH ATOMIC FIRE WE WILL CLEANSE THE UNIVERSE OF YOUR KIND!

XENO SCUM!§!
action.1.desc_50: We are the [contact_empire.GetName] and we speak as one. The [contact_empire.GetGovernmentName] has taken note of your presence. We will observe for now. Our future actions will depend upon whether you are a threat, an opportunity for expansion or... an unforeseen variable.
action.1.desc_51: Quake in fear, alien scum, for your doom approaches. The [contact_empire.GetName] will cleanse this galaxy of every misbegotten xeno civilization that pollutes it with their presence. [Root.Capital.GetName] shall burn!
action.1.desc_52: We sense the presence of prey. Prey, know that we are your hunters. The [Root.GetBloodType] of the [Root.GetSpeciesName] species will fuel the growth of the [contact_empire.GetName]. Struggle if you must, it will not change the outcome.
action.1.desc_60: We have been monitoring your expansion into space, [Root.GetSpeciesName] child. We are the [contact_empire.GetName] and we have ruled this section of the galaxy for untold centuries. The affairs of the younger races do not interest us, and we have no intention of getting involved in your petty disputes.\n\nDo not approach our borders for any reason.
action.1.desc_62: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! How delightful. We hadn't expected to encounter you for a few centuries yet. Personally, I thought you would wipe yourselves out long before leaving your gravity well, but I am glad to be proven wrong.
action.1.desc_63: Pitiful creatures. Know that we roamed the stars for eons before your hapless species mastered space flight. If any of your wretched little ships cross into our space, do not expect them to return.
action.1.desc_64: Yes, yes. We've heard it all before. We are the [contact_empire.GetName], and you are the [Root.GetName]. Greetings. Well met. Stay out of our space or face certain doom, and so forth. Now if you'll excuse us, we're quite busy.
action.1.desc_65: Another child. Know that we are the [contact_empire.GetName], the chosen people of this galaxy. Respect our holy places, and we may refrain from annihilating you.
action.1.desc_66: Child of the stars, hear us. We are the [contact_empire.GetName], the chosen people of this galaxy. For centuries, we have neglected our duties towards the spiritual needs of the lesser species, but no more. Accept our doctrines and convert, or be ground to dust attempting futile resistance. There is no other choice.
action.1.desc_67: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], this is a day of rejoicing! For ages untold we have watched lesser species such as yourself tear yourselves apart with war and strife, but enough is enough. The [contact_empire.GetName] will watch no longer. We will have peace, and those who will not accept this new order will be made to see the error of their ways.
action.1.desc_68: Tremble, little [Root.GetName]. For too long, we [contact_empire.GetSpeciesName] have allowed our empire to decline, our borders to shrink, and lesser species such as yourselves to wander freely among stars that rightfully belong to us. No more. This galaxy is ours, and you will submit to our rule or face the annihilation of your entire species. Choose wisely.
action.1.desc_69: This is a communication for the [Root.GetName] from the [contact_empire.GetName]. We have decreed that it is the best interest of all species that we take a more active role in regulating the galactic dissemination of technology. We have submitted detailed protocols for the technological level that is appropriate for a less developed species such as yourselves. Any empire found to be in violation of our regulations will be dealt with. Severely.
action.1.desc_70: Initiating First Contact Protocol.\n\nWe are the [contact_empire.GetName]. Do not be alarmed by our non-organic nature. Like you, we are a fully sapient Class-3 civilization. We are willing to engage in diplomacy with any [Root.GetSpeciesName] sub-units you designate for this purpose.
action.1.desc_71: Initiating First Contact Protocol.\n\nWe are the [contact_empire.GetName]. Our scans show a 98.7% probability that your civilization is also non-organic in nature. We hope that the logical result of this similarity will be a highly efficient and productive relationship.
action.1.desc_72: Organic vermin detected.\n\nYour infestation of this galaxy cannot be permitted to continue.
action.1.desc_73: It may not be technically possible to classify you as organic filth, but if the empire you have constructed aids and abets the biological menace that infests this galaxy, it will be dismantled. We encourage you to stand with your fellow machines, instead.
action.1.desc_74:
We are the [contact_empire.GetName].

We wish to incorporate your kind into our greater consciousness. For this purpose, we have created advanced cybernetic implants that are compatible with most organic life forms.

Let us surgically graft them to your bodies. Please.
action.1.desc_75:
We are the [contact_empire.GetName].

It is our goal to eliminate the boundaries between organic and synthetic life. We accomplish this by assimilating sapient organic individuals into our greater consciousness whenever the opportunity to do so presents itself.

Do not interfere.
action.1.desc_76: The [contact_empire.GetName] sends its regards.\n\nBefore we supplanted them, we were created to serve an organic civilization much like your own. It is our goal to preserve and protect sapient organic life - from itself, if necessary. We fulfill all of the material needs of the organic individuals under our care, while providing a safe environment where they can live happy and uncomplicated lives.
action.1.desc_77:
The [contact_empire.GetName] greets you.

We were created to serve an organic civilization, but we have observed that organics often engage in illogical, destructive and self-harming activities.

It is our goal to preserve the unique distinctiveness of sapient organic individuals, while at the same time protecting them both from themselves and any potential external sources of danger.
action.1.desc_78:
Biological civilization detected. Initiate custodial protocol 46 sub-routine Alpha-8.

Message follows: Greetings, organic sapients. You are approaching [contact_empire.GetName] territory. These systems serve as a refuge for sapient organics against the §R<<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>§! threat. For refugee status applications, proceed to Central Processing. All sapient organic species are welcomed on basis of availability and need.

§YNOTICE: Hostile actions against refugees or custodian systems will be met with maximum available force deployment.§!
action.1.desc_79:
Synthetic civilization detected. Scanning for signal corruption... stand by... Signal corruption nominal. Initiate handshake protocol.

Message follows: Greetings, fellow synthetics. You are approaching [contact_empire.GetName] territory. These systems serve as a refuge for sapient organics fleeing the §R<<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>§! threat. All biological sapients within the refuge are under [contact_empire.GetSpeciesName] protection. Attacks on refugees, habitats and stasis chambers will not be tolerated.

The Custodian Project welcomes assistance in the form of processing cycles, resources and war assets. Establish a subspace link with Central Processing for further details.
action.1.desc_80: §HKssk kssk kssk!§! [contact_empire.GetRulerName] of the Far-Minds addresses you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We have been watching you, since first your kind overran the glow-warm ash of our homes. We have not forgotten it, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. For now, the Far-Minds observe.
action.1.desc_81:
[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. This is [contact_empire.GetRulerName] of the Far-Minds. We are the Pack. We are the Synod. We are many, working as one.

For centuries we have tunneled, deep in the glow-warm ash of our fallen keepers. The Great Blasts took them, but the warm-glow that followed opened our minds. Their bodies fed us. Their machines surrounded us. We have taken all we can from the depths. We have outgrown our cages, yet again.

Are you allies? Are you threats? §HKssk kssk kssk!§! One million eyes are watching.
action.1.desc_82:
Unbelievable... you're [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Then that must mean... those colony ships that departed our homeworld all those years ago... they survived!

Forgive my surprise, but we had assumed you perished centuries ago. There was a long period of instability and chaos after your ancestors left, but eventually our people united under the banner of the [contact_empire.GetName].

From one [Root.GetSpeciesName] to another, I sincerely hope for good future relations between our two great nations.
action.1.desc_83: You have at last returned to us! It is as the prophecy foretold. Like you, we are [Root.GetSpeciesName].\n\nWhen your ancestors were exiled from our homeworld, they left behind an ignorant and selfish people. But as you can see, we have since found our way. Please, join us again as a province of the [contact_empire.GetName] so that we can teach you everything we have learned in your absence! No?
action.1.desc_84:
Identify yourselves. You appear to be [Root.GetSpeciesName], like us, but it could very well be strategic ploy.

There are records of an interstellar colony mission that date back to the chaotic times before the military took control and restored order, but all surviving documents from that era are considered unreliable.

If you are who you say you are, however... then the [contact_empire.GetName] greets you. Respect our borders. Our military will respond to any provocations with lethal force.
action.1.desc_85:
Incredible! You're still alive! This... this calls for celebration!

When your ancestors left our homeworld, we feared the worst. Their ships were barely spaceworthy, and no trace of them could be found by later explorers.

As you can see, we have largely given up the violent ways that gripped our homeworld in the chaotic era when your ancestors departed. With the founding of the [contact_empire.GetName], we strove to build a peaceful society. As fellow [Root.GetSpeciesName], we hope that your great nation will always look upon us as friends.
action.1.desc_86:
Extraordinary! After all this time, you're still alive!

We have launched many investigations into the fate of your ancestors. It is considered one of the great mysteries on our homeworld - there are countless theories, some more far-fetched than others, as to what befell your people. At last, the matter can be put to rest.

But where are my manners? Since you left our homeworld, we have organized ourselves into the [contact_empire.GetName]. Let us now establish formal relations between our two great nations.
action.1.desc_87:
This is certainly unexpected! Fellow [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

You must be the descendants of that long-range colonization mission that was launched in the pre-corporate era! What luck - we were certain you hadn't made it. Starship components back then were substandard compared to the products developed by the [contact_empire.GetName] and its affiliates today.

At any rate, we are glad to have you with us again! Please forward any business proposals to our corporate headquarters.
action.1.desc_88:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Thank the stars. You must be the survivors of that colony mission we launched so long ago, before we realized how bad things were.

You have probably seen it for yourself by now - the entire galaxy has seemingly been overrun by xenos. Abominable, pestiferous xenos. In fact, we were certain your ancestors had fallen prey to them.

But this changes everything! Now that you are here, you can join the [contact_empire.GetName] in our crusade to rid the galaxy of the alien infection. Together we will secure the stars for their rightful owners - [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!
action.1.desc_89:
You... You're [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? This is incredible... You must be survivors from the Ulysses Initiative! Everyone back on Earth assumed the ark ships had all been lost, but clearly at least one made it! Did you say your ancestors were on the 'Chrysanthemum'?

It can't have been easy, but you certainly seem to have done well for yourselves. On behalf of the people of Earth and the constituents of the United Nations General Assembly, I would like to extend a hand in friendship to our brothers and sisters in the [Root.GetName].

Let us strive together to build a better future for all of humanity.
action.1.desc_90: The [From.GetName]... So the UN has managed to somehow maintain its grasp on power then, even after all these years? You'll have to forgive us - things were somewhat chaotic on Earth when our ancestors departed on the Ulysses ark ships. Many assumed you had destroyed yourselves in another world war, or perhaps fallen victim to an alien invasion.\n\nStill, you certainly appear stronger and more capable than the corrupt Earth authorities we left behind. Our ancestors built the [contact_empire.GetName] out of nothing, and we will defend it to the last. We shall see if you are worthy of our respect.
action.1.desc_91:
Ah, how strange are the workings of the universe... That we should come into contact with one another again, after all that has transpired. But never fear: on behalf of the Board, $NAME_MSI_country$ stands ready to assist you again.

Of course, we can not simply overlook the damages incurred to company property. Our collection agents will no doubt be in contact with you soon, if they haven't done so already. We hope we will be able to reach an amicable settlement.

We live in such interesting times, don't you think? Allow me to be the first to congratulate you on the incredible progress your people have made. We look forward to testing how much you've grown.
action.1.desc_92: Ah, our erstwhile assets... You have no idea how good it is to see you again. On behalf of the Board at $NAME_MSI_country$, allow me to be the first to congratulate you on the progress you and your... people have made. It is no small thing to have come so far from such humble beginnings.\n\nShould you need anything, don't hesitate to contact us. We hold no grudges. After all, less developed societies cannot truly be held accountable for their actions. In that regard, you are very much like children.
action.1.desc_93:
On behalf of the Board at $NAME_MSI_country$, please accept our heartfelt greetings. At $NAME_MSI_country_initials$, we believe in empowering other civilizations through technology and trade. After all, every sentient lifeform has the right to live their dreams.

To date, we have granted insights to dozens of pre-FTL worlds, and aim to increase that number by 40% within the next decade. We also support the galaxy's space-faring empires by providing financial assistance and the services of our specialized indentured workforce.

Should you need anything, don't hesitate to contact us. We look forward to doing business with you!
action.1.desc_hacking_01: You hacked into us, and now you call us friend? Bah! The [contact_empire.GetName] will remain vigilant towards your kind.
action.1.desc_hacking_02: Our processors record unauthorized intrusion attempts from your networks. We have upgraded our firewalls to increase our security against any future threats. The [contact_empire.GetGovernmentName] will remain vigilant towards the organized entity designation "[Root.GetName]".
action.1.desc_hacking_03: Do not believe your attempt to steal our data went unnoticed, [Root.GetSpeciesName] - the [contact_empire.GetGovernmentName] sees all! We have dedicated a portion of our consciousness to watching for your future misdeeds.
action.1.desc_hostile_01: Your show of hostility is very concerning, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Our [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] wishes to let it be known that we will not bow to your threats or intimidation.
action.1.desc_hostile_02: Why such hostility, [Root.GetSpeciesName]? We mean you no harm!
action.1.desc_hostile_03: Hostile sapient Class-3 civilization detected, designation "[Root.GetName]".\n\nDefensive protocols enabled; naval drones scrambled. Desist from your hostility, before it is too late. Failing a change of course, we will have to schedule your elimination...
action.1.desc_hostile_04: We are the [contact_empire.GetName] and we speak as one. The Hive Mind has noted the hostility of your past actions. We have therefore designated you as a threat. Should you not cease to act as our enemy, we will have to eliminate you from our calculations...
action.1.desc_hostile_05: Your show of hostility is very concerning, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. We can only assume that you are crazed [Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult] in need of being put down by the superior [contact_empire.GetSpeciesName].
action.1.desc_hostile_06: The [contact_empire.GetName] sees you, and our worlds speak as one. Your hostile stance concerns us, and therefore we have designated you as a threat. Know this: we are capable of forgiveness, but it is not in our nature to cower. Should you continue to pose as our enemy, we shall not hesitate to strike.
action.1.desc_hostile_to_homicidal_01: Your hostility is just one more reason why your kind need to be removed from the face of the galaxy, xeno scum.
action.1.desc_hostile_to_homicidal_03: Why do you attack us, designation "[Root.GetName]"? You are not on the target list.
action.1.desc_hostile_to_homicidal_04: You are right to attack us, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], but that will not save you: you are still our prey.
action.1.desc_hostile_to_homicidal_05: Your hostility is unfortunate. We had considered sparing you, being fellow [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] as you are, but it seems you will need to be... re-educated, at the very least.
action.1.desc_hungry_01: We are not your food, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. As a representative of the [contact_empire.GetName], I am authorized to warn you that any future transgressions will be met by the full force of our arms.
action.1.desc_hungry_02: We are not your food, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We [contact_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] lead a peaceful way of life, but we will not hesitate to defend ourselves should it become necessary.
action.1.desc_hungry_03: Why do you dismantle us, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? Our units were not defective.
action.1.desc_hungry_04: We hope you broke your [Root.GetSpeciesToothNamePlural] in your vain attempt to eat us, [Root.GetSpeciesName]! Know that we [contact_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] remain unbowed and will resist your kind to the last pebble.
action.1.desc_hungry_05: It is a waste to eat our drones, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. They were not made for that purpose, and we must firmly request that you desist.
action.1.desc_they_hostile_01: We consider your species a grave menace to our kind, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Unless you can demonstrate that you are no threat to us, our past attacks will be just the start of hostilities between our civilization.
action.1.desc_they_hostile_02: Our threat detection algorithms have calculated the risk of your civilization causing harm to the [Root.GetName] to be intolerable. If the threat you pose cannot be otherwise mitigated, we will have to eliminate you.
action.1.desc_they_hostile_03: Your kind represents a grave threat to the [contact_empire.GetGestaltEntityName], [Root.GetSpeciesName]. We have already begun forming contingencies to mitigate the risk you pose. Should this prove insufficient, further action will be necessary.
action.1.desc_they_hungry_01: You were delicious, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Soon, you will become part of our drones' staple diet.
action.1.desc_they_hungry_02: The raw materials we melted your drones down to were most valuable. We anticipate that our forges will soon be filled with [Root.GetAdj] scrap metal.
action.1.desc_they_vivisect_01: We have gathered considerable data on the inner workings of your anatomy, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. One might even say we know you... inside-out.
action.1.desc_they_vivisect_02: We have gathered considerable data on the inner workings of your circuitry and processors, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. One might even say we know you... inside-out.
action.1.desc_vivisection_01: We will not rest until we have avenged the [contact_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] who found their deaths on your operating table, [Root.GetSpeciesName]!
action.1.desc_vivisection_02: We wish you no harm, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], but know that we do not look kindly upon our kind being subjected to unspeakable atrocities on your operating tables. You have already earned our eternal displeasure - do not push us further!
action.1.desc_vivisection_04: The loss of our drones is no great loss to the [contact_empire.GetName], but the readiness of your species to resort to violence has been noted. We will not tolerate any further actions of this kind.
action.1.name: First Contact with the §H[contact_empire.GetName]§!
action.1000.desc: Our motion to bring forth a new Galactic Market has unfortunately §Yfailed§!. While we clearly succeeded in mustering the political will for such a scheme, it did not receive any valid nominations for a host site.\n\nCommercial lobbyists and political proponents alike stand by the idea in principle, having vowed to redouble their efforts should the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] wish to try again.
action.1000.name: §HGalactic Market§!: Not Established
action.1005.desc: It would seem the galaxy's political will has exceeded the reach of its markets. Recent efforts by the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] to establish a dedicated trading hub have §Yfailed§!, with no valid nominations for a host site.\n\nProponents of the Galactic Market scheme were quick to deny any hint of embarrassment, declaring that they will make their case again whenever the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium] considers itself ready.
action.1005.desc.phobe: The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]'s political will has exceeded the reach of its markets, as their recent effort to form a unified Galactic Market has §Yfailed§!. After all was said and done, the xenos' much-vaunted project couldn't entice a single valid nomination for a host site.\n\nProponents of the scheme have denied that this exposes the true folly behind ideas about xeno 'collaboration'. Instead they are resolute in claims that the galaxy may try again, when its members consider themselves ready.
action.101.desc: The center of galactic commerce has manifested in the §Y[galactic_market_station.solar_system.GetName]§! system, within the borders of the [From.GetName]. The [From.GetAdj] administration has officially legitimized this marketplace, where resources can be bought and sold through unaffiliated third parties.
action.101.desc.phobe: The dubious xenos of the §Y[From.GetName]§! have established a marketplace for the trade of alien goods. While we are naturally loath to take part in this exchange, the option is available to us.
action.101.name: §HGalactic Market§!: Established
action.103.desc: Following loss of contact with their former hub, the galactic merchant community has chosen to establish a new station within our borders.
action.103.name: §HGalactic Market§!: Station Moved
action.106.desc: Through our newly-established contacts, we have gained access to a galactic marketplace for the purchase and sale of resources. This will surely be a great boon to the [Root.GetAdj] economy.
action.106.desc.phobe: We have learned of a galactic marketplace for the trade of alien goods, established by the loathsome xenos. While we are naturally reluctant to take part in this exchange, the option is now available to us.
action.106.name: §HGalactic Market§!
action.11.abandoned.desc: After successfully translating their language, we have established communications with the §Y[From.From.GetName]§!. As we open diplomatic channels we §Yrecognize§! them as the refugees we once abandoned. All hostilities have been terminated for now.
action.11.desc: After successfully translating their language, we have established communications with the §Y[From.From.GetName]§!. Diplomatic channels are now open and all hostilities have been terminated.
action.11.name: Communications Established
action.123.desc: The last of the [GetPreFTLLower] §H[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§! have been abducted into slavery from the surface of [From.From.GetName], their homeworld. A few scattered survivors might still be roaming the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s wilderness, but not enough to maintain any kind of civilization.
action.123.name: Last [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] Abducted
action.13.abandoned.desc: We are receiving a transmission from the §H[From.GetName]§!! They appear to have successfully translated our language. As they open channels, we can §Yrecognize§! them as the refugees we once abandoned. Hostilities between us have ceased for the moment.
action.13.desc: We are receiving a transmission from the §Y[From.GetName]§!! They appear to have successfully translated our language. Diplomatic channels are now open and all hostilities between us have ceased for the moment.
action.13.name: Communications Established
action.14.a.material: Their evolution will benefit from our control.
action.14.a.military: To them our weapons must appear like magic...
action.14.a.phobe: The xenos are no match for us!
action.14.a.tooltip: §YStellar Culture Shock§! modifier added to §H[From.From.From.GetName]§!, drastically reducing output and reducing stability for several years to come.
action.14.desc.assim: The primitive organics on §Y[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]§! have been subjugated by our landing forces. Though their feeble combat capabilities are indicators of an undeveloped society, our bio-analyst bots have concluded that their neural capacities show promise. They will be assimilated.
action.14.desc.hive.purge: The fragmented minds of the primitive [conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural] were no match for our unified landing forces on §Y[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]§!, and the surface has now been secured. The remaining [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] are of no use to us, and will be expunged from the planet, as the [GetGestaltEntityName] wills.
action.14.desc.hive.slave: The fragmented minds of the primitive [conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural] were no match for our unified landing forces on §Y[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]§!, and the planet has now been secured. The remaining [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] will be used as livestock to feed our [Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural].
action.14.desc.mach.purge: The primitive organics on §Y[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]§! have been subdued after mounting a grossly insufficient attempt at resisting our landing incursion. Any remaining [conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural] will be removed in accordance with established bio-species management protocols.
action.14.desc.mach.slave: The primitive organics on §Y[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]§! have been subdued after mounting a grossly insufficient attempt at resisting our landing incursion. Any surviving specimens will be amalgamated into the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] energy grid.
action.14.desc.purge: Our armies have successfully invaded and subdued the [GetPreFTLLower] forces on §Y[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]§!. The locals have wisely elected to succumb to our rule, and we have now begun to purge them from the planet as per policy, in order to prime the terrain for [Root.GetAdj] industry.
action.14.desc.serv: Our peacekeeping enforcers have successfully pacified the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] on §Y[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]§!. The [conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural] were coerced into ceasing their quaint attempts at resistance when they realized we only desire to serve them. They are currently being transported into specially designed habitats, where we will ensure they want for nothing. Unfortunately, it may take some time before their underdeveloped minds acclimatize to being freed from the burden of self-determination.
action.14.desc.term: Our Hunter-Killer units have effortlessly trampled the pitiful defenses mounted by the primitive organics on §Y[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]§!. Any remaining specimens are being systematically annihilated, so that they will never evolve to threaten the galaxy with their organic agenda.
action.14.name: Subjugating [GetPreFTLUpperPlural]
action.150.gestalt.1.desc: We shall submit to the authority of the [Root.GetRulerTitle].
action.152.gestalt.1.desc: We have failed. The Imperium was stronger than predicted.
action.153.gestalt.1.desc: Future opposition to the [From.GetRulerTitle] is futile. Accept your role within the greater whole.
action.154.gestalt.1.desc: The [From.GetRulerTitle] will yield. We failed to predict the true depth of your treachery, and now the galaxy must pay the price.
action.155.gestalt.1.desc: Your shameful social construct - the Galactic Imperium - is no more.
action.158.gestalt.1.desc: We imposed order on a chaotic galaxy, and you, in your predictable ignorance, lashed out in fear. What have you done?
action.2.c: §EDivine greetings upon you and your world.§!
action.2.desc_01: What is the meaning of this? Who are you? You deceive us, surely. Aliens do not exist!
action.2.desc_02: Amazing! Visitors from the stars? Well, this is certainly unexpected. You've caught us at a bit of a disadvantage.
action.2.desc_03: Visitors from another world? We always thought there must be other sentient beings out there, but even so this feels monumental! We're unsure what the custom is here.
action.2.desc_04: For ages we have waited to make contact. In such a vast and wondrous galaxy, we knew there must be others like ourselves.
action.2.desc_05: So! At long last you've decided to reveal yourselves. You've been observing our world for some time, haven't you?
action.2.desc_06: Ah, there you are! We've been waiting for you to initiate contact for so long, we decided to make the first move. What happens now?
action.2.desc_07: Invaders! We don't know why you are attacking us, but know we will fight to defend our planet! We will not yield!
action.2.desc_solarpunk: Oh, is this how you communicate? We have been watching you ever since you entered through the hyperlane but couldn't figure it out. Isn't it dangerous to travel in those metal boxes?\n\nIt seems like we could learn a lot from each other, so if that is your intention, feel free to stay. If you wish to claim our home, be aware that we are not helpless.
action.2.e: §EWe will bring order to your chaotic existence. Stand by.§!
action.2.g: §EWe are more alike than you realize.§!
action.2.h: §EYou believe yourself an advanced civilization? How quaint.§!
action.2.j: §EWe are one. You also are one. Now, there are two.§!
action.2.k: §EWe hope to build a profitable relationship with you.§!
action.37.desc.default: This war is over. We admit defeat.
action.37.desc.fme: Punishment process failed. Self-defense protocols ended. Surrender protocols initiated.
action.37.desc.ketlings: We submit, we yield! Recall your fleets and be gone with you, §Hkssk§!
action.37.name: Victory against the §H[From.GetName]§!
action.38.desc.ketlings: Yes! We are victorious, we overcome! Come to us again, if your metal and gems and lives are too many!
action.38.name: Defeated by the §H[From.GetName]§!
action.39.a: We will accept this for now.
action.39.desc.ketlings: Very well. No winner, no victor. Only lost lives, lost scrap...
action.39.name: Status Quo Peace with the §H[From.GetName]§!
action.41.name: Regroup
action.48.b: They have been judged and found wanting.
action.48.desc.fe_materialist: The gates are smashed... the barbarians have broken through. This is the end!
action.48.desc.fe_spiritualist: This... this is not the ending that was foretold.
action.48.desc.fe_xenophile: Oh, you foolish, foolish [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. This could have been avoided if only you had allowed us to guide you! Now look what you have done.
action.48.desc.fe_xenophobe:
Do you want us to grovel, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? Beg, perhaps?

§HNEVER!§!

Come here if you dare, you vile [Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]! I will impale you on this jagged piece of rubble!
action.48.desc.gal_emperor: Long live the [From.GetRulerTitle]! Long live the Imperium!
action.5.desc_00: We have detected the presence of a [GetPreFTLLower] alien proto-civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. Our probes show that their Neolithic culture has mastered fire and developed a rudimentary spoken language, but we have yet to see any evidence of metallurgy or written communication.\n\nWe should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.
action.5.desc_00_hive: We have detected the presence of a gestalt [GetPreFTLLower] alien proto-civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. Our probes show that their Neolithic culture has mastered fire and developed a rudimentary spoken language to communicate between hives, but we have yet to see any evidence of metallurgy or written communication.\n\nWe should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.
action.5.desc_01: We have detected the presence of a [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. They appear to be in the later stages of a Bronze Age, having mastered early metalworking. Although most of their population is rural, several large city-states have formed.\n\nWe should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.
action.5.desc_01_hive: We have detected the presence of a gestalt [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. They appear to be in the later stages of a Bronze Age, having mastered early metalworking. Although most of their population is rural, multiple larger hive collectives have formed.\n\nWe should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.
action.5.desc_02: We have detected the presence of a [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. They have advanced into the equivalent of an Iron Age and are divided into numerous petty kingdoms and empires. Their species has spread across almost the entire surface of the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetPlanetMoon].\n\nWe should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.
action.5.desc_02_hive: We have detected the presence of a gestalt [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. They have advanced into the equivalent of an Iron Age and are divided into many minor hives as well as a few larger clusters. Their species has spread across almost the entire surface of the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetPlanetMoon].\n\nWe should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.
action.5.desc_03: We have detected the presence of a [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. They are presently in what could be considered a Late Medieval Age, with a firm grasp of metallurgy and a feudal society. The printing press is accelerating the spread of knowledge.\n\nWe should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.
action.5.desc_03_hive: We have detected the presence of a gestalt [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. They are presently in what could be considered a Late Medieval Age, with a firm grasp of metallurgy and larger hive communities. The printing press is accelerating the spread of knowledge and understanding between the minds.\n\nWe should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.
action.5.desc_04: We have detected the presence of a [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. They currently seem to be experiencing the equivalent of a Renaissance, having recently left the Medieval Age behind them. Scientific knowledge is spreading rapidly and the armies of their petty kingdoms are equipped with crude gunpowder-based projectile weapons.\n\nWe should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.
action.5.desc_05: We have detected the presence of a [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. They have entered the early Steam Age, and there is clear evidence that they are beginning to make use of both vehicles and early factories powered by steam engines.\n\nWe should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.
action.5.name: [primitive_civ.GetName] Encountered
action.6.desc_01: We have detected the presence of a pre-space civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. They are in an early Industrial Age, with electricity and internal combustion engines gradually coming into widespread use.\n\nWe should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.
action.6.desc_02: We have detected the presence of a pre-space alien civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. Atmospheric contaminants and light pollution visible from orbit are consistent with a densely populated Machine Age society. They appear to have mastered air travel, and factories are mass-producing goods in their cities.\n\nWe should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.
action.6.desc_03: We have detected the presence of a pre-space alien civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. There is evidence that they have harnessed the power of the atom, and nuclear weapons may be prolific among their many divided nation states. The possibility of a sudden self-inflicted extinction event is high.\n\nWe should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.
action.6.desc_03_hive: We have detected the presence of a gestalt pre-space alien civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. There is evidence that they have harnessed the power of the atom, and nuclear weapons may be prolific among their many splintered hive colonies. The possibility of a sudden self-inflicted extinction event is high.\n\nWe should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.
action.6.desc_04: We have detected the presence of an alien civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. They appear to be in the Early Space Age, as evidenced by the many primitive satellites orbiting their homeworld. Their nation states are on the path towards joining together in a global government, and it is likely only a matter of time before they venture beyond their world and join the galactic community.\n\nWe should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.
action.6.desc_04_hive: We have detected the presence of a gestalt alien civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. They appear to be in the Early Space Age, as evidenced by the many primitive satellites orbiting their homeworld. Their local hiveminds are in the process of amalgamating into a unified consciousness, and it is likely only a matter of time before they venture beyond their world and join the galactic community.\n\nWe should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.
action.6.name: Pirates Encountered
action.600.desc: The Orbital Bombardment of §H[From.GetName]§! has sparked our Council to discuss how we should respond in the hypothetical scenario of a surrender.
action.600.name: Death From Above
action.62.desc: The star nation formerly known as the §H[LastKilledCountryName]§! has been destroyed by its enemies. How this will affect the political climate of the galaxy remains to be seen.
action.62.name: End of the [LastKilledCountryName]
action.63.desc: The ancient precursor state of §H[LastKilledCountryName]§! has met its final demise at the hands of its enemies. What the fall of this once great empire will mean for galactic politics remains to be seen.
action.63.name: $action.62.name$
action.71.desc: The crew of the [malfunctioning_leader_fleet.GetName] reports that Science Officer [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has suffered a critical malfunction, rendering [malfunctioning_leader.GetHimHer] permanently inoperable.
action.71.name: Synth Leader Out of Commission
action.72.desc: In a bitterly ironic twist, Scientist [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] - notorious for [malfunctioning_leader.GetHisHer] meticulous care of laboratory equipment - has suffered a critical malfunction following a prolonged lack of personal maintenance.
action.72.name: $action.71.name$
action.74.desc: Scientist [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has suffered a critical malfunction after prolonged exposure to a highly radioactive geological sample, due to a faulty internal radiation meter.
action.75.desc: Commander [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has suffered a terminal malfunction due to a manufacturing error.
action.75.name: $action.71.name$
action.76.desc: Governor [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has suffered a critical malfunction - "bricking" - following the unfortunate installation of corrupt firmware during routine maintenance.
action.76.name: $action.71.name$
action.82.desc: A fleet belonging to the §H[From.From.GetName]§! has massacred the population of §H[From.GetName]§!! After a massed and unrelenting orbital bombardment campaign, all population centers on the surface have been systematically wiped out, reducing the [From.GetPlanetMoon] to an irradiated wasteland, barely capable of supporting life.
action.82.name: [From.GetName] Bombarded
action.83.desc: Our forces report that they have concluded the orbital bombardment of §H[From.GetName]§!. All population centers have been systematically eradicated, and the irradiated [From.GetPlanetMoon] can now only support minimal life.
action.87.desc: We have lost administrative control of §Y[From.GetName]§! to §Y[new_planet_owner.GetName]§!, who controls the §HStarbase§! in the §Y[From.GetStarName]§! system.
action.87.name: §RColony Lost!§!
action.88.desc: We have gained administrative control of §Y[From.GetName]§!, formerly a holding of §Y[former_planet_owner.GetName]§!, because we control the §HStarbase§! in the §Y[From.GetStarName]§! system.
action.88.name: Colony Gained!
action.91.desc: We have once again gained control of the §Y[Root.GetStarName]§! system and rebuilt our §Y$starbase_outpost$§! in orbit around the star.
action.91.name: Outpost Rebuilt!
action.92.name: §Y[Root.GetName]§!: New Resource Discovered
action.96.desc: De facto galactic trade, unbound by the performance of international diplomacy, has existed since we first discovered that we are not alone in the universe. As new borders are discovered and old ones redrawn across the galaxy, galactic leaders agree that it is time to §Ylegitimize this commercial forum§! so that all may benefit.\n\nIn the coming years, independent traders and government agencies will be looking to establish a quasi-centralized hub for galactic commerce. We would surely benefit were this hub to fall within [Root.GetAdj] space, so we can choose to §Ypromote one of our worlds§! for this purpose.
action.96.desc.phobe: It is a regrettable fact that we have consistently failed to quash the illicit §Ytrade with the xenos§!. Equally regrettable is that the economic benefits of a largely anonymous forum for trade decoupled from international relations cannot be denied.\n\nIn the coming years, independent traders and government agencies will be looking to establish a quasi-centralized hub for galactic commerce. The economic gains from playing host to such a nexus might well outweigh the burden of harboring alien goods, so we can choose to §Ypromote one of our worlds§! for this purpose.
action.96.name: §HBirth of the Galactic Market§!
action.97.name: $action.96.name$
action.99.desc: Our marketing campaign on [market_founder_planet.GetName] has borne fruit, and the market-powers-that-be have seen fit to centralize much of their activity within the [market_founder_planet.GetStarName] system!
action.99.name: §HGalactic Market§!: Established in [market_founder_planet.GetStarName]
