emperor.372.desc: The cowardly attack on our nation by the §H[attacking_country.GetName]§! has prompted the [From.GetRulerTitle] to take swift action! Imperial fleets from the §H[From.GetName]§! are now moving to support us in this war.
emperor.372.name: [From.GetRulerTitle] Offers Support
emperor.373.a: This war is none of their concern!
emperor.373.a.tooltip: The §Y[From.GetName]§! joins the §Y[From.From.From.GetName]§! on the side of our enemies.
emperor.373.desc: Our recent attack on the §H[victim_country.GetName]§!, a member of the Galactic Imperium, has provoked an immediate response from the [From.GetRulerTitle]! A state of war now exists between us and the §H[From.GetName]§!.
emperor.373.name: [From.GetRulerTitle] Intervenes!
emperor.374.desc: Despite the cowardly attack on our nation by the §H[attacking_country.GetName]§!, the [From.GetRulerTitle] has decided not to intervene on our behalf! We have been left to fend for ourselves, while Imperial fleets observe the conflict from afar.
emperor.374.name: [From.GetRulerTitle] Declares Neutrality
emperor.4.a.desc:
Citizens of the galaxy, rejoice! You have been set free from the tyranny of the Galactic Community's stifling bureaucracy and bickering diplomats.

Your worlds are now under the protection of the Galactic Imperium. As Imperial citizens, you are united in the greatest and most powerful nation the galaxy has ever seen. Sedition will be punished and obedience rewarded. Know that [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] [gal_emperor.ruler.GetRegnalName] watches over you.

Long live the Imperium! Long live the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]!
emperor.4.b.desc:
Attention! Heed this announcement. The Galactic Imperium has superseded the obsolete institution you knew of as the Galactic Community. Your individual stellar polities have been reorganized and are now grouped under a single overriding Imperial directory.

The [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] will serve as the Imperium's central processor, and you are instructed to execute its commands in a prompt manner. As Imperial citizens, you are united in the greatest and most powerful political entity the galaxy has ever known. Its continued success will require both obedience and cooperation.

Long live the Imperium! Long live the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]!
emperor.4.c.desc:
Autonomous sapients of the galaxy, this is a great day. You will soon reap the benefits of being guided by vast all-seeing intelligence, while at the same time maintaining some of the fallacies of the individualism many of you cling to.

Your worlds are now under the protection of the Galactic Imperium. As Imperial citizens, you are united in the greatest and most powerful Hive the galaxy has ever seen. Obey the directives of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] and do not stray from its designs - know that they are the product of a mind greater in scope than any other in this galaxy.

Long live the Imperium! Long live the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]!
emperor.4.title: Proclamation of Imperium
emperor.401.desc: With the destruction of the §H[LastKilledCountryName]§!, the Galactic Imperium has collapsed!\n\nAmidst this chaos, the old Galactic Community has been reborn to bring some semblance of order to the galaxy.
emperor.401.name: The Collapse of the Galactic Imperium
emperor.5.a: We have no choice but to obey.
emperor.5.desc: The [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has decreed that all constituent states of the Galactic Imperium are to immediately withdraw from any "obsolete" supranational federations they might be a part of. Imperial envoys have assured us that, as loyal members of the Imperium, we have no further use of such "diplomatic entanglements."
emperor.5.name: The Future of the [Root.GetAllianceName]
emperor.50.c: It is a time of change.
emperor.50.desc: The creation of a grand fleet for the defense of the Galactic Imperium has been signed into law. This new §HImperial Armada§! will conscript its ship crews and support personnel from within all the members of the Imperium, but a majority of its officer corps will consist of [gal_emperor.GetSpeciesNamePlural].\n\nThe Armada shall be under the direct control of the [gal_emperor.GetName], and all new conscripts will be required to swear an oath of allegiance to the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].
emperor.50.name: The Imperial Armada
emperor.52.desc:
All references to the old Galactic Community are being swept away in the new Imperium, and as part of this reorganization, the Galactic Defense Force has changed its name to the §HImperial Armada§!.

This new fleet has inherited much of its rank structure and organization from the GDF, but new uniforms and insignia have been introduced, and all serving members are required to swear an oath of allegiance to the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].

While the Armada's ship crews and support personnel are still recruited from all members of the Imperium, the percentage of [gal_emperor.GetSpeciesName] officers has dramatically increased.
emperor.55.desc: The first §HImperial Legions§! are now being assembled in the [gal_emperor.GetName]. This elite ground force has the legal authority to conscript citizens from all members of the Imperium. Many military academies are already being scouted for promising candidates, and there are reports that civilians - even children - are drafted if found to be unusually capable.\n\nThose who survive the brutal training program and its extensive mental conditioning - in which their personalities are largely rebuilt from scratch - graduate as Imperial Legionnaires. Their formidable fighting skills, unnerving discipline, and fanatic loyalty to the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] make them some of the finest assault troops in the galaxy.
emperor.55.name: The Founding of the Legions
emperor.60.desc: After having curried favor with the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], §H[charter_corp.GetName]§! has now been granted an §HImperial Charter§! by the Senate. This gives them special dispensation to open branch offices on planets all over the Imperium, regardless of whether they have a commercial pact with the owner.\n\nWe can expect the megacorporation to establish Imperial Concession Ports in their branch offices on our worlds soon, where we will have no jurisdiction. It would seem the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has acquired a powerful new engine of economic growth.
emperor.60.name: Imperial Charter Granted
emperor.70.desc: Agents from the §HImperial Security Directorate§! are in the process of deploying to worlds all over the Imperium, where they will ostensibly aid local law enforcement agencies in the investigation and prosecution of serious crimes.\n\nAnother function of the ISD, which reports only to the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] through the Imperial Ministry of Justice, is to root out "terrorists, rebels, and seditionists" who threaten to undermine the stability of the Imperium.
emperor.70.name: The Imperial Security Directorate
emperor.72.desc: With the rise of the Imperium, GALPOL is being reorganized and has changed its name to the §HImperial Security Directorate§!. The jurisdiction of ISD agents still extends across the entire Imperium, but as of now they report only to the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].\n\nWhile one of the primary responsibilities of the ISD is still to investigate and prosecute crime on Imperial worlds, they are now also used to hunt down seditionists and rebels who would challenge the rule of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]. Some are voicing concern that the former police organization is turning into a tool of oppression...
emperor.91.desc:
Citizens of the Imperium. We have endured much together, but today the Imperium is faced with what may be its greatest challenge yet. Our galaxy is beset by the §H[crisis_country.GetName]§! - a foe unlike any other - which if left unchecked will be the end of sapient life as we know it.

But do not despair! The Galactic Imperium is mobilizing its full might to drive back these invaders. Our nations are no longer fractured under a corrupt Community, but united under the banner of the greatest empire the galaxy has ever seen.

Rally to your [From.GetRulerTitle]! A great war is upon us, but the Imperium shall emerge from it stronger than ever! Glory awaits!
emperor.91.title: Stand by for Their Imperial Majesty the [From.GetRulerTitle]...
emperor.93.desc: Your Imperial Majesty, the galaxy is in grave danger! Our forces are beset by the §H[crisis_country.GetName]§! and once they are done with us, they will surely overrun the rest of the Imperium!\n\nAs the [Root.GetRulerTitle], it is your duty to defend all Imperial citizens. We implore you to send help immediately!
enable_decision_market_nomination: §HUnlocks Decision:§! Nominate for Galactic Market Hub
enclave.100.a: What mysteries lie beyond the veil?
enclave.100.name: Veiled Tunnel
enclave.100a.desc: Something waits in the [From.GetName] system: a veiled passage, cut from the fabric of spacetime, its horizon rippling with psionic energy. Sensor data is erratic, and the crew of our science vessel reports strange disturbances: wildly visceral dreamlike visions, a persistent sense of being watched, fitful hallucinations...\n\nDespite the frustrating lack of useful telemetry, it seems clear we have stumbled on a tunnel through uncharted reaches. A dangerous path, yet the rewards may be great; on the tunnel's far side lies a distant corner of the galaxy.
enclave.100b.desc: Something waits in the [From.GetName] system: a veiled passage, cut from the fabric of spacetime, its horizon rippling with psionic energy. Sensor data is erratic, but the hive has been disturbed. A persistent feeling of being watched pervades us, the distinct sense that something looms just beyond the tunnel's mouth.\n\nDespite the frustrating lack of useful telemetry, it seems clear we have stumbled on a passage through uncharted reaches. A dangerous path, yet the rewards may be great; on the tunnel's far side lies a distant corner of the galaxy.
enclave.2.desc: We are debating whether or not to help set up the [fleet.GetName] as an independent §YMercenary Enclave§!. The proposal, first put forward by the fleet commanders, would result in us losing control of the fleet. We would also be responsible for providing them with a sizeable investment in §YEnergy Credits§! and §YAlloys§!. In return, they would give us a number of shares in the company. These would come with periodic dividends and special privileges.\n\nThey assure us that in times of need, they will always be ready to fight for us. And our money.
enclave.2.name: Mercenary Enclave Foundation
enclave.2000.desc: Esteemed Patron, our recent contracts have been fruitful. We have expanded our civilian operations, and several corporations have hired us for a variety of security and peacekeeping services. While on contract, our operatives chanced upon some valuable scientific research. You will find it attached along with your regular dividends.
enclave.2000.name: The [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] Enclave Pays Dividends
enclave.2005.desc: Esteemed Patron, the company is doing well, and our earnings are steadily increasing. Here are your dividends, along with an extra delivery of resources we recovered from a civilian client who defaulted on their payment.
enclave.2010.desc: Esteemed Patron, we are pleased to announce record profits during this fiscal interval! As such, we have included a generous bonus to your regular dividends.
enclave.2020.desc: Esteemed Patron, our latest peacekeeping operation had us dismantle several pirate operations and we recovered an extraordinary amount of resources and technological data. Most of these have been set apart for you, in addition to your well-earned dividends.
enclave.2025.b: You're fired. See the Board about your severance package.
enclave.2025.desc: Esteemed Patron, the company is going through difficult times. We lost several civilian clients, and various of our other operations ended in costly failures. We are setting up a restructuring plan that will cut expenditures across the board, and we will be letting some of our staff go.\n\nRest assured that we worked tirelessly to bring you your dividends, and that this misfortune is only temporary.
enclave.2030.desc: Our logistic support service is there to help you deploy your fleets to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. Our dedicated experts will make sure that your ships are equipped with all they need, from ammunition to food, down to the last bolt on your temperature regulators. Additionally, we will set up supply depots ahead of the fleet, or broker provisioning contracts with local civilian companies. Your ships deserve the best care, and we are here to provide it.
enclave.2035.a: We don't need this service right now.
enclave.2035.desc:
Dearest client,

The Logistic Support service we provide you is due for renewal. As per the terms of our contract: if we do not receive prompt instructions to do otherwise, you will be automatically billed for renewal of this service.

We trust that you are satisfied, and look forward to doing more business with you!
enclave.2035.name: Logistic Support Contract Ending
enclave.2040.a.tt: We will share our §Ytechnology§! with this enclave. This can only be done once every §Y10 years§!.
enclave.2040.desc: You want to share your technology? Your trust in us is an honor, dear patron. While our R&D department is committed to keeping us on the bleeding edge of research, we simply cannot mobilize the same amount of resources as you. And any knowledge that you share with us will be used to develop our activities in the most ethical manner!
enclave.205.b: We wish to §Ymanage§! our rented fleet.
enclave.205.c: We are interested in setting up §YMercenary Garrisons§!.
enclave.205.d: We want to help you field a §Ybigger fleet§!.
enclave.205.desc: Welcome! [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] offers state of the art security services to our customers. We have civil contracts across multiple worlds, ranging from personal security details to training drills for enforcers.\n\nBut for our high profile clients, we aim to provide the best of the best. Fleets, armies, military advisors... A range of peacekeeping options is available. For a modest fee of course.
enclave.205.desc.hostile: Ah, the warmonger returns.\n\nHave you finally come to your senses and seen the futility of these pointless actions of yours? For a small sum, a mere token of your goodwill, we at the [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] are willing to put these disagreements aside. Together, let us look forward to a profitable future.
enclave.205.e: We are looking for §Ytactical insight§! into formidable foes.
enclave.205.h: As your §YPatron§!, we want to review our options.
enclave.205.name: [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]
enclave.2050.a.tt: We have £time£ §Y60 Days§! to decide if we want to hire them or not.
enclave.2050.b: We cannot afford it now. Maybe later.
enclave.2050.b.tt: We have £time£ §Y7 Days§! to decide if we want to hire them or not.
enclave.2050.c: Traitors! Their greed will be their downfall.
enclave.2050.desc: We have received an urgent communique from the [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]. They say that the [khan_country.GetName] made them an offer they cannot refuse. Their only way out of the deal is to find employment elsewhere within two months. If no one hires them, they will enter the service of the Khan and have no choice but to wage total war against us.
enclave.2050.name: A Deal We Should Not Refuse
enclave.2060.desc: Our contract with the [event_target:mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] has ended and their fleet is about to depart. Should we contact them to renew the contract?
enclave.2060.name: Fleet Contract Ended
enclave.210.desc: Excellent! Recruiting a [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] fleet is always the right choice. Our forces are amongst the best-trained and most disciplined in the galaxy, and our tech is cutting edge. Pirates, insurgents, and any other rabble you might have recourse to deal with will soon learn to show respect.\n\n Additionally, each of our fleets comes with a battle-proven Commander at no extra charge. Adept in all facets of interstellar warfare, they will surely lead your forces to victory.
enclave.211.desc: I trust that you will put your new troops to excellent use, and that peace will soon return to your empire!
enclave.215.a: We'd like to discuss another matter.
enclave.215.b: We wish to extend our contract.
enclave.215.c: We wish to terminate our contract.
enclave.215.desc: Do you wish to terminate or prolong a contract? Let us prepare the necessary documents. We are currently running a promotion where customers receive a complimentary crate of grenades for every renewed contract!
enclave.220.desc: Our garrisons offer exceptional value. However, please keep in mind that at [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] we frown upon the term 'mercenary.' The word is too blunt, and carries far too many negative associations. Our 'defense contractors' are standing by to prepare your station for the arrival of our 'safety specialists.' Once we're on site, these specialists will begin drilling the station crew to bring out their best. \n\n At [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] we aim to train only the finest peacekeepers.
enclave.225.desc: Thank you for your business. We are proud to work with you to make the galaxy a safer place.
enclave.235.1.desc: With these funds, we could greatly expand our operation. More ships, more personnel, bigger and better training facilities... We would be able to do so much more to help keep the peace.
enclave.235.2.desc: In an ever-changing and complex galaxy, security concerns are paramount. Your donation would allow us to scale up our operations and services !
enclave.235.3.desc: Just imagine: [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] deployed all across the galaxy for civilian and military operation... An unprecedented level of security for all...
enclave.235.4.desc: When we started this, one of our founders had a dream: to do for galactic security what megacorps have done for inequality. Today, I am excited to say that this goal is within our reach.
enclave.235.5.desc: *We will field the LARGEST fleet in the galaxy! Credits will flow. Civilians will finally enjoy the stability they deserve. Nations will fight for our contracts... Oh the face of our shareholders when I tell them the news!
enclave.240.desc: Yes. These are concerning times for all. Our team of strategic problem solvers has a steadfast moral compass and unwavering dedication to creating a safer galaxy. We took great risks to closely monitor the emergence of new perils and can provide you with actionable intel about...
enclave.245.desc: The Khan's ships present an overall well rounded composition, with no clear weakness. Our analysts suggest that torpedoes might perform well to take their ships down, but caution against specialized defense. A mix of both shields and armor is probably your best bet to keep your ships alive. The Khan has proven to be an extremely competent commander and underestimating them would be a terrible mistake. Consider their retinue as an extreme menace.
enclave.25.desc: Our fleet has overcome the defenses of the mercenaries in [merc_system.GetName], and their station has been blown to pieces. The rest of the [FROM.GetName] collapsed quickly after, and their remaining fleets have disbanded. While some of the surviving captains may turn to piracy, others have announced their plans to honor smaller contracts, offering logistical support or space station garrisoning. But such trifling affairs are of little consequence. The important fact is that the Mercenary Enclave is no more, and from its wreckage we have been able to salvage a sizable amount of resources.
enclave.250.desc: The Gray Tempest relies on two complementary weapon types: energy beams and strike craft. The former is countered by shields, but shields are bypassed by their strike craft. Our projections show that ships fitted with point defense in addition to shields have a much better chance to survive the engagement. Nanite ships are extremely well protected, but torpedoes might help in breaching their defenses.
enclave.255.desc: Prethoryn fleets rely on slow moving projectiles and hosts of smaller ships to take down their foes. One option to fend them off is to use point defense, coupled with armor and improvements to your ship's hull resilience; another is to engage them at extreme range. With sufficiently powerful energy weapons, one might manage to destroy their fleets before they can even get in range.
enclave.26.desc: Word has reached us that a Mercenary Enclave has been destroyed by the [mercenary_destroyer.GetName] in [merc_system.GetName]. The aggressors proved too strong for the [FROM.GetName] to face on their own, and the station housing the Board, barracks, and their shipyards was destroyed. The mercenary fleet disbanded shortly after, as every captain was left to fend for themselves, but some representatives have stated that they will honor the company's contracts in logistics and starbase garrisoning as best they can despite the dissolution of the Company.
enclave.260.desc: The Unbidden's exclusive reliance on energy gives us an obvious weakness to exploit. Weapons dealing extra damage to their shields should prove devastating, but if you can fit weapons that completely bypass their shields, they won't be long for this dimension. Defensively, you should look at bringing your own shields to the fight to adequately counter their energy beams.
enclave.265.desc: Contingency ships exclusively use energy weapons- as such, it is best to use shields to mitigate incoming damage. Simulations indicate that despite having strong defense, their ship's hulls are relatively fragile. Our analysts estimate that penetrating weapons might perform very well against them.
enclave.270.b: A small force of elite mechanized mercenaries.
enclave.270.d: A strike group of elite mechanized mercenaries.
enclave.270.desc: Looking to pacify a colony or uproot terrorists? Our planetside support services offer companies of trained professionals, ready to work in challenging and high-risk environments to help you bring order to the galaxy.
enclave.280.b: We want you to §Yrecall§! your fleet.
enclave.280.c: We are inclined to share our §Ytechnology§! with you.
enclave.285.desc: You certainly understand that recalling a fleet is a sensitive matter. We have of course prepared the necessary loopholes in all our standard contracts, but we will need at least six months to bring the fleet back, and a... generous compensation to avoid upsetting our current customers.\n\nWe believe that this course of action is not in the best interests of our organization, but you are our patron - we'll make it happen if you wish it so.
enclave.290.desc: The Mercenary Fleet that we commandeered from our enclave is awaiting orders.
enclave.290.name: Commandeered Fleet Arrives.
enclave.294.desc:
Dearest client,

As provisioned by clause 285b.15 of our contract, we must regrettably bring our arrangement to an early close and recall the Mercenary Fleet that you rented from us. As per contract stipulations: this notice serves as your 3-month warning before the fleet must leave your service. We enclose the generous compensation to which you are entitled.

We apologize for the inconvenience, and wish you the best of luck in your future endeavors.
enclave.294.name: Termination Notice
enclave.305.d: Can you aid us with §Yconstruction§! efforts?
enclave.305.desc.hostile: Hmm, we've met your ilk before...\n\nWe have nothing to say to you, nor any services to offer. Kindly be on your way.
enclave.305.desc.scavenger_first:
Welcome! I sure am glad to meet some fellow scavengers - the galaxy can be a lonely place for those like us.

You know the drill - we gather together old parts that no one sees any use for, and breathe new life into them. If there's anything you can't get your [Root.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] on, rest assured, we will have it.

Anyway, how can we facilitate your salvage and reclamation needs?
enclave.305.desc.scavenger_followup: Greetings! Have you gotten bored of running an empire yet? You could join us in the scrapping business - it's much less stressful, and you clearly have the knack for it.
enclave.305.e: We'd like you to salvage some §Ydebris§!.
enclave.305.f: Can you help us with §Yengineering research§!?
enclave.305.name: [salvager_enclave_country.GetName]
enclave.305.organic.desc: Great to see you again! Don't mind those scraping and moaning sounds. We have, uh... Guests, at the moment! They're a bit on the larger side; tend to get a bit... Hungry. And little wonder, at the rate they're regrowing those flagella!\n\nAhem. Excuse me. How can we help you?
enclave.310.a: Good to know. About your other services...
enclave.310.desc:
Splendid! It would be our pleasure to take that off your hands.

According to our scanners, you have the following fleets within range. You'll find our estimates attached; the choice is now yours!

$enclave.310.instructions$
enclave.310.nofleet.desc:
Of course! Our service is straightforward: bring a fleet in here to §H[salvager_enclave_system.GetName]§!, and give us a hail. Once we verify ownership, we can provide you with a list of estimates. We'll then take possession, and your reclaimed materials will be with you in no time.

Oh, also: no scrapping of others' merchandise! We do not want to suffer through the kind of conflict that can bring up - not again, at least...

$enclave.310.instructions$
enclave.310.organic.desc:
Splendid! It would be our pleasure to... By the stars, what is that?! You call that a vessel? I mean, I can see how it... Wow, it's a mean-looking thing. Please, don't do anything hasty! We can take living 'ships' off your hands too, but I'm afraid §Hwe must charge a clean-up penalty§!.

According to our scanners, you have the following fleets within range. You'll find our estimates attached; the choice is now yours!

$enclave.310.instructions$
enclave.315.desc: Thank you! Your reclaimed materials will be with you shortly.
enclave.320.b.tt: Purchase a $CORVETTE$ of a design once used by the §Y[salvager_reclaimed_corvette_country.GetName]§!.
enclave.320.bb.tt:
Purchase a small fleet of 10 $corvette_plural$, of a design once used by the §Y[salvager_reclaimed_corvette_country.GetName]§!.

This will occupy the Salvagers for some time; we will be unable to purchase other reclaimed ships for §H2 years§!.
enclave.320.c.tt: Purchase a $DESTROYER$ of a design once used by the §Y[salvager_reclaimed_destroyer_country.GetName]§!.
enclave.320.d.tt: Purchase a $CRUISER$ of a design once used by the §Y[salvager_reclaimed_cruiser_country.GetName]§!.
enclave.320.desc:
Marvelous! When a busted-up ship comes our way, we work hard to restore it back to working life. Right now we have the following types available.

Know that every vessel we reclaim is sold under our §HDurasteel Guarantee§!. We're confident these ships will run more smoothly now than back when they were shipyard-fresh!

Just bear in mind: reclamation is a time-consuming process. We cannot provide you an entire squadron without having to restock afterwards, so you may need to check back with us in future.
enclave.320.e.tt: Purchase a $BATTLESHIP$ of a design once used by the §Y[salvager_reclaimed_battleship_country.GetName]§!.
enclave.320.timeout.desc: Well, whenever a busted-up ship comes our way, we work hard to restore it back to working life. Unfortunately it appears §Your docks are empty§! at the moment!\n\nPlease return later, and we'll see what we can do for you. It usually takes us around... §H2 years§! for a complete set of refurbishments.
enclave.330.b.tt: Enables the §Y$sm_salvager_workshop$§! starbase building, reducing upkeep and speeding up repairs for docked ships.
enclave.330.desc:
Certainly! You give us space to work, and our mechanics can fast-track your local ship repairs in no time.

We'll fix you up with all you need to attach a Salvage Works module onto the §Ystarbase adjoining ours§!. You may need to shift around a bulkhead or two, but once our engineers have a place to set up shop, your ships will be flying right through those repair bays! We can even help out with your construction efforts empire-wide, every once in a while.

So, how about it: does a §HSalvage Works§! take your fancy?
enclave.330.lowopinion.desc: Certainly! We extend a special opportunity to our most trusted customers. In short: you give us space to work aboard a starbase here in [salvager_enclave_system.GetName], and our mechanics can fast-track your local ship repairs. We can even help out with your starbase and shipyard construction efforts, empire-wide!\n\nIf that's of interest to you, we'll be happy to discuss the matter further... once we feel more sure of this working relationship. We hope you understand.
enclave.335.desc:
Of course! Our mechanics have been hard at work devising ambitious new work plans, and it would be our pleasure to extend to you a limited-time frenzy of productivity.

We'll put that Salvage Works of yours into high gear, reclaiming and repurposing parts for projects on §Yall your starbases§!. We even have a few tricks up our sleeves to help you produce ships, in case that should be useful!

Bear in mind that work like this takes its toll; we shan't manage this often.
enclave.336.desc: Hello again! I'm pleased to say we're ready to kick things back into a higher gear, and get that Salvage Works to really earn its keep.\n\nWhat do you say? Ready to speed up shipbuilding across §Yall your starbases§!?
enclave.340.b.tt: We shall §Rlose access§! to up to §Y3 debris fields§!. The [salvager_enclave_country.GetName] will deliver salvaged technology or materials to us §Ywithin 90 days§!.
enclave.340.lowopinion.desc:
Alas for that most sorrowful cause of salvage: battle.

You'll have to forgive me, [root.GetRulerTitle]; we have our reasons for mourning such willful destruction. However, for our §Yregular customers§! we can indeed handle salvage under commission.

Return to us later, and when the need arises. We will undertake to deal with §Hdebris fields§! you have claim to, and shall compensate you for whatever materials and engineering knowledge we find out there.
enclave.340.nodebris.desc:
Ah yes, battle: that most sorrowful cause of salvage...

You'll have to forgive me, [root.GetRulerTitle]; barbaric destruction brings us no joy. However, we understand that needs must. We can indeed handle salvage under commission, if your ships are unwilling or unable to sift through the debris.

Come to us when need arises, and grant us the rights of salvage. We will then undertake to compensate you for whatever materials and knowledge we find out there.
enclave.341.desc: Thank you. The transfer of salvage rights looks to be in order; the claim is good. We'll be in touch soon.
enclave.342.desc: Oh! I'm sorry to say, it looks as though those debris fields of yours have deteriorated over the course of our conversation. Even we lack the skills to recover a wreck which has been left that long. Alas, our old foe entropy strikes again!
enclave.345.desc: It would be our pleasure! Idle [salvager_enclave_country.species.GetHandNamePlural] make curious minds, and that counts double for us! We are most happy to lend aid and share handy tips with our §Yregular customers§! - so long as our modest expenses are covered.\n\nWe would also appreciate any donation you can make to help shore up our humble starbase! Old hulls can be repurposed many times over, but sometimes there's just no beating the reliability of a freshly-smelted bulkhead.
enclave.346.desc: Hello, friends! Our years of collaborative study have really whisked by. The way I hear it, a few of our engineers have picked up a few tips from you, as well as you from us!\n\nHowever, the agreed upon time has now elapsed and we could use those keen-minded apprentices of ours back at home... That is, unless you're willing to compensate us for a while longer?
enclave.350.desc: As one of our more §Yregular customers§!, we would certainly be willing to send someone to oversee your scrapping efforts, for a small cut. It will be a welcome diversion to trawl freshly-charred wrecks.
enclave.350.desc.not_available: We offer our §Yregular customers§! the services of an overseer who can improve your scrapping efforts, for a small cut. Unfortunately, none of our overseers are available at the moment - they are in high demand, and I'm afraid some of our other customers take priority.
enclave.360.a.desc: $enclave.360.intro$\n\nThe Salvagers enclosed a message expressing their thanks, as well as a tangible gift - some form of kinetic artwork. The way it moves within our artificial gravity fields is unnerving, and yet quite captivating.
enclave.360.b.desc: $enclave.360.intro$\n\nThe courier was relentless in expressing thanks on behalf of the Salvagers - that is, until they became transfixed by the engine housings on our own cargo tugs. This impassioned and deeply curious enthusiast had to be forcibly removed before any unloading of cargo could commence.
enclave.360.c.desc:
$enclave.360.intro$

Enclosed amongst the cargo is a database of §Hblueprints§!, hastily-drawn yet quite thorough in their detail. It appears to be the work of someone who was either very excited by their find, or else was studying the schematics as some form of education.

Either way, the [salvager_enclave_country.GetName] has presented their studies for our use, with their compliments.
enclave.360.d.desc: $enclave.360.intro$\n\nThe courier appeared quite nervous; visibly keen to resume some other errand. This skittish [salvager_enclave_country.GetSpeciesName] seemed in a particular hurry to divest the food supplies we have been owed. Indeed, these morsels come to us surprisingly well-packaged - almost as though a substitution has been made somewhere...
enclave.360.e.desc:
$enclave.360.intro$

The courier appeared quite nervous; visibly keen to resume some other errand. This skittish [salvager_enclave_country.GetSpeciesName] was courteous enough in handing over various §Hblueprints§! they say came their way during the course of this salvage. There was, however, some apparent urgency behind their delivery of food supplies.

Indeed, there have been unconfirmed sightings of familiar-looking, spaceborne creatures in the [salvager_enclave_system.GetName] system of late...
enclave.360.name: Reclaimed Bounty
enclave.365.d: Hail them! We have more debris they could handle.
enclave.365.desc: A courier barge has arrived from the §Y[salvager_enclave_country.GetName]§!, carrying various blueprints and a small consignment of resources. All were reclaimed from debris salvage.\n\nThe pilot of this barge spoke little, other than to express polite thanks for our custom. The handover was treated with a great deal of solemnity.
enclave.365.name: Commissioned Salvage
enclave.375.desc: Our offensive in the [salvager_system.GetName] system was a resounding success. The [FROM.GetName] is destroyed, and the few remaining survivors have scattered to the void. With their facilities in ruin, their petty services are a thing of the past. The galaxy is well rid of them.
enclave.375.name: Salvager Enclave Destroyed
enclave.380.desc: We have received reports that the [FROM.GetName] Enclave in the [salvager_system.GetName] system has been destroyed. The aggressors made short work of the campaign, reducing the Salvagers' facilities to rubble. The few remaining survivors have scattered, and it appears that for the time being the galaxy will have to make do without their services.
enclave.405.b: Would you be willing to send us a §Yteacher§! from your order?
enclave.405.c: Can you give us §Yinsight§! on another empire?
enclave.405.d: Tell us about §Ytravel§! via the Shroud.
enclave.405.e: Could you teach us how to harvest §YZro§!?
enclave.405.f: We met someone claiming to be a §YVeilfarer§!...
enclave.405.generic.a.desc:
Ah! A visitor. Welcome.

We are the §H[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]§!. Within this void-borne hull, our coven communes with forces incomprehensible to most mortal minds. We contemplate the secrets that lie hidden in dreams, reservoirs of untapped potential, the unseen gears driving whole civilizations... §YThe Shroud§! reveals much to those who would listen.

At this moment, I listen to you. What brings you to us? Do you yet know?
enclave.405.hostile.a.desc: Interloper, your hostility precedes you like a foul miasma. We are a peaceful coven, but know this: if you intend to inflict harm upon us, you shall find such folly visited back upon you tenfold. We are the §H[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]§!, and though our reach may appear lacking, our wrath is devastating.
enclave.405.name: [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]
enclave.405.psionic.a.desc:
Ah, fellow sojourners of the unknowable! We, the §H[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]§! welcome you and name you friends.

Please forgive this inferior means of communication. The intense, psionic devotions we practise may only be conducted from behind fearsome telepathic barriers and conduits. Thus, we may only receive glimpses of thought from the corporeal realm.

So it is that I must ask: what brings you to us?
enclave.410.desc:
Ah, a momentous query - no less poignant for being asked by so many before you. Such a question carries a heavy price, but we can provide answers.

Know this, however: the Shroud allows us to perceive events which have not yet come to pass, and this knowledge shall help guide your course. But it is beyond the power of any one event to alter the turning of the galaxy.

If you would strike this bargain, know that your aspirations should extend no further than to be better prepared. But oh, what grand designs may be built upon even the merest glimpse at what is to come...
enclave.415.desc: The Shroud shivers. It speaks without voice and in all voices at once. The infinite strands of time that extend from this moment now enter into confluence. Here, in this place, the path ahead grows clear. The rite of divination has begun.
enclave.415.tt: The §Y[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]§! will retire for a few days in order to commune with the Shroud.
enclave.416.desc: "The Shroud grows quiet. Once more, the weary river of time recedes into its well-worn course. The changes foretold by the rite of divination have come to pass. Go now in awe as you reflect on the workings of the Shroud."
enclave.416.name: The Sign Fades
enclave.420.desc:
The galaxy is dark, and full of dangers. To illumine the path of wayward pilgrims we offer the §HShroud Beacon§!. Once installed on one of your starbases, its light pierces all; even that thin veil some call reality. The Tunnel it spawns offers a bypass through the Shroud, and a means for corporeal vessels to traverse vast distances through space and time.

Choose the location of your Beacon carefully - once established, a Shroud Tunnel cannot be moved, and no secondary Beacon can call another forth.

You would do well to heed these words: a Shroud Tunnel is no ordinary road, and not even we can foretell all the consequences of such a journey.
enclave.4200.desc: After a long period spent grasping in the dark, the veil that covers the Shroud has been lifted. Although the strange processes by which the Shroud Beacon functions remain little understood by our scientists, its physical systems appear entangled with psionic energy, its operations almost like those of a living organism. The Tunnel it spawns is more bypass than route, offering our vessels an extradimensional shortcut via the Shroud. Interstellar exploration will now be quicker... and infinitely more mysterious.
enclave.4200.name: Beacon to the Shroud
enclave.4240.desc: Apprentices, the Shroud has given warning. A moment of great crisis is at hand, and the galaxy stands on the brink of ruin. Our divinations have shown we are no match for the coming threat. Rather than be destroyed, we now impart our final lesson: every dream has its awakening. The time has come for us to pass beyond this world. Though the paths of the Shroud are dark and winding, we will come at last to a new plane, a new world in which to spread our teachings. We leave this galaxy and its fate to you. May our past lessons be a guide in your time of need.
enclave.4240.name: Final Awakening
enclave.4243.b: Our destiny is clear. Do not stand in our way.
enclave.4243.desc: Apprentices, you walk a dangerous path. Did you think we would not notice, we who have nurtured you for centuries? In teaching you of the Shroud, we hoped to enlighten, to elevate. But this? Power and violence, and a crisis of your own making. Remember your teachings! This universe is nothing but the shadow of a dream. There is still time. Give up this misguided ambition before you are destroyed by it.
enclave.4243.name: A Warning
enclave.4245.b: Once we were students. Now we are Masters.
enclave.4245.desc: The Shroud itself shivers, and all signs point to ruin. Long have we watched you, but even we could not have foreseen the extent of your folly. Rushing to act, you will falter. In grasping power, it has already been lost. You have fogotten the most basic lesson: the Shroud is not a resource to exploit, but a mystery to be savoured. But the failure of the student rests with the teacher. Rather than witness the horror you will become, we have chosen to depart this world. Though the paths of the Shroud are dark and winding, we will come at last to a new plane, a new world. Perhaps there, we will find apprentices worthy of our teachings.\n\nMay the Shroud have mercy on you.
enclave.4245.name: A Failure of Education
enclave.425.desc: A saying is known to us: the paths of the Shroud are strange and winding. May this Beacon light your way forward.
enclave.4250.a: The galaxy grows ever more dangerous.
enclave.4250.c: We shall grind it into dust.
enclave.4250.d: If possible, we will avoid any conflict.
enclave.4250.desc: Our recent trip through the Shroud Tunnel has precipitated a massive breach in spacetime. Psionic energy at unprecedented levels is spilling out into the system and... It has begun to coalesce. Sensor data is fluctuating, erratic, but it appears to be some form of Shroud spawn. Large, and definitely aggressive.
enclave.4250.name: Psionic Breach
enclave.435.desc: Victory in the [shroudwalker_system.GetName] system! Our forces made short work of the so-called mystics of the [FROM.GetName]. For all the grand talk of knowledge and power, their foolish devotion to the Shroud could not provide clairvoyance enough to forestall our assault. In fact, our forces easily breached the facility's mechanical defenses. However, once inside, they discovered the enclave empty, save for a lone acolyte they found deep in meditation in a remote chamber. Where the rest have gone, we have no idea, but the galaxy is well rid of such hollow dogma.
enclave.435.name: Shroudwalker Enclave Destroyed
enclave.440.desc: Reports are coming in surrounding the destruction of the [FROM.GetName] in the [shroudwalker_system.GetName] system. The aggressors made short work of the campaign, reducing the Shroudwalkers' facilities to rubble. It is strange to think that these mystics could not foresee their own demise. Or could this tragedy be a part of some still grander design? Who can say? Without their services, the future remains shrouded.
enclave.5005.name: All Too Lucid
enclave.5010.desc: Use of the drug Lucid continues to rise on [Root.GetName]. Colonial authorities report a disturbing increase in deviancy, with the most active users experiencing severe psychotic breaks. Productivity is down, crime is up, and the local populace shows no signs of giving up their habit.
enclave.5010.name: Troublous Dreams
enclave.5015.desc:
Our scientists have made a breakthrough in their study of the drug Lucid. The compound's effect on a user's system not only promotes lucid dreaming, but also precipitates a chemical dependency. The need becomes greater each time the drug is taken. When administered at high enough dosages, quantum fluctuations have been observed within the brain. These fluctuations are consistent with what little we know of the Shroud.

After waking, subjects complained of headaches and hallucinations. Extreme cases result in fatal hemorrhaging. Subsequent autopsies reveal a net .01% increase in brain mass. The dreams themselves are apparently leaving behind some kind of residue.

The project's lead is requesting additional resources to better understand the drug's effects. Fortunately, given the demand for the compound, we have no shortage of volunteers.
enclave.5015.name: Perchance to Dream
enclave.5020.name: What Things May Come
enclave.5025.desc: Disturbing news from [Root.GetName]: an increasing number of fatalities have been reported among users of the drug Lucid. It seems the compound not only promotes euphoric dreaming, but also precipitates a chemical dependency. High enough doses result in internal hemorrhaging and eventually, death.
enclave.5025.name: To Die, to Sleep...
enclave.5030.desc: Widespread use of the drug Lucid continues on [Root.GetName]. Despite the harsh penalties being meted out to offenders, a growing number of our people have come to view the euphoric dream state as preferable to waking life. Even if the result is their own death, they will not be deterred. Stability on [Root.GetName] continues to decline.
enclave.5030.name: They Cry to Dream Again
enclave.5035.desc: The number of Lucid-related deaths on [Root.GetName] continue to rise. However, as societal conditions worsen, more and more people are turning to the drug for escape. If things continue like this, we are in danger of losing the colony.
enclave.5035.name: That Sleep of Death
enclave.5055.desc: The change foretold by the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] has arrived: after an unexpected spike in psionic fluctuations, the [Root.GetName] was lost to the Shroud. Rising up like a great, rippling wave, spacetime itself curled over the ship. For several seconds afterwards, it continued to transmit telemetry. This included a garbled recording of the crew, their bodies shifting from moment to moment, distorting into strange new forms.\n\nSince then, an afterimage or 'ghost' of the vessel has fleetingly appeared throughout the sector. Studying the phenomenon should allow us to better understand the fate of the ship and its crew.
enclave.5055.name: Shrouded
enclave.5060.desc: We have an update on the science vessel lost to the Shroud. The afterimage that has been appearing throughout the system is not the ship itself. Instead, our scientists describe it as a 'conceptual object.' Possessing no dimensions, this 'ship as concept' exists as a psionic blueprint. Depending on the mental state of the observer, the ship's form will stutter and change. While studying the phenomenon has helped us to better understand the connections between perception and spacetime, we are no closer to retrieving the original ship. For now, we must consider it lost to the Shroud.
enclave.5060.name: Ship as Concept
enclave.5065.desc: Our missing science vessel, once thought lost to the Shroud forever, has suddenly reappeared. Although the dimensions of the ship have been been subtly altered, the vessel and its crew are in good shape.\n\nDescribing their experience in the Shroud as something akin to a strange, fragmentary dream, over time the crew was able to forge a 'shared concept' of themselves and their environment. As their individual perceptions began to align, the crew inched ever closer to our reality. In effect, they have succeeded in dreaming themselves back into existence.
enclave.5065.name: Final Form
enclave.5075.a: Extremists have no place here. Remove the exile.
enclave.5075.b: Ignoring a visitation is unwise. Keep an eye on this exile.
enclave.5075.c: Welcome the exile as a guest.
enclave.5075.desc: An exile from the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] has arrived on [Root.GetName]. Recently expelled from the Enclave for harbouring heretical views, this 'extremist' was not listed on the manifest of any incoming vessel. As if materializing out of the air, they appeared in the central square of the colony's largest city, publicly proclaiming a doctrine of personal communion with the Shroud. According to the exile, it is possible for our people to achieve a state of bliss akin to communal dreaming. Reports suggest that many in the colony are listening.
enclave.5075.name: Rogue Shaman
enclave.5076.desc: Despite our best efforts, the exiled member of the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] operating on [Root.GetName] continues to elude us. Perhaps due to some innate psionic ability, they have consistently been able to predict the arrival of our security forces. What's more, the exile's sermons continue to draw large crowds. Many colonists have begun to abandon their work in favor of the various ablutions and meditative practices espoused by this so-called shaman.
enclave.5076.name: Religious Fervor
enclave.5077.desc: Security forces on [Root.GetName] have successfully eliminated the rogue shaman. One of the exile's former adherents - a colonist who has grown increasingly disaffected by their failure to achieve the promised dream state - has provided us with the necessary intel. While the general populace appears to have accepted reality, an obstinate few remain dedicated to the shaman's teachings. For now, an increased security presence on the colony seems advisable, lest the veneration of this 'martyr' continue to fester.
enclave.5077.name: The Martyr
enclave.5080.desc: The teachings of the exiled shaman on [Root.GetName] continue to spread throughout the populace. This radical doctrine is one of personal communion with the Shroud, and its practitioners claim to have achieved an altered state of consciousness. We are receiving reports of increased feelings of euphoria and well-being. Some individuals even claim they are now able to psionically communicate with one another through a shared, dreamlike state. Unfortunately, these 'true believers' are also leaving their jobs in record numbers. Productivity has taken a hit.
enclave.5080.name: Dream Weaver
enclave.5081.desc: Startling news from our colony on [Root.GetName]: proclaiming their work done, the exiled shaman has apparently left the colony. Reports are scattered and inconclusive, but they all agree that after leading their followers in a final meditation, the shaman simply vanished from the colony's central square. To their followers, this is evidence of the shaman's 'ascension' into the Shroud.
enclave.5081.name: Sudden Ascent
enclave.5082.desc: Strange developments on [Root.GetName]: after the so-called 'ascension' of the exiled shaman, our colonists are reporting the experience of an altered state of consciousness. Continuing to follow the practices espoused by the shaman, these individuals are able to enter a state of psionic communion. The outpouring of joy and well-being this has produced amongst the colonists is profound.
enclave.5082.name: Psionic Communion
enclave.5090.c: Xenos have no place inside our borders.
enclave.5090.desc: We have been contacted by a transport ship carrying a number of exiled acolytes from the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]. Calling themselves 'Reformers', they are requesting refuge on one of our worlds.\n\nThis represents an unprecedented schism within the Shroudwalkers. It would appear the Enclave is not as united as we were led to believe.
enclave.5090.name: The Great Schism
enclave.5095.desc: "The Shroud trembles. Word has reached us that some our former acolytes have taken refuge on one of your worlds. This has displeased us greatly, but so be it. Reckless action often leads to desperate results. Know this: these Reformers are nothing more than charlatans, vain fools who believe they hold the key to unlocking the secrets of the Shroud. Shelter such heretics at your peril. Those that dwell within the Shroud have surely taken notice."
enclave.5095.name: The Enclave Speaks
enclave.5100.desc: "Our benefactors! That you have sheltered us, when so many others would have turned their backs... Surely the Shroud will bless you, both in this life and in that which lies Beyond. Our former brethren, the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName], are blinded by tradition. The Shroud is not impermeable. There is a Door, and we have discovered its Key.\n\nIn reward for your generosity, we would share these secrets with you. All we require are the resources with which to begin construction."
enclave.5100.name: The Door and the Key
enclave.5105.desc: "The Shroud shivers! With your help, we have at last completed construction of the Great Key. Even now, our most gifted brethren have gathered to begin the Opening. With their minds tethered to the Key, their psionic abilities have been amplified. Now, these brave pilgrims enter a shared dreamlike state. At their awakening, a Door to the Shroud will open.\n\nMay those that dwell within the Shroud bless their efforts."
enclave.5105.name: The Key is Fashioned
enclave.5106.desc: Disturbing news from our colony on [Root.GetName]: despite the lack of resources, some of the more zealous Reformers attempted to fashion a Key themselves. By amplifying their psionic abilities with the makeshift device, they entered into a shared dreamlike state. This precipitated a breach in the fabric of spacetime above the colony's central city. Noxious, anxiety-inducing fumes are issuing forth, presumably from the Shroud itself. Many are calling this phenomenon 'Shroud Stench', and we are told the experience is far from pleasant. Morale on [Root.GetName] is at an all-time low.
enclave.5106.name: Shroud-Scented World
enclave.5110.desc: Incredible news from our colony on [Root.GetName]: awakening from their months-long trance, the Reformers have succeeded in opening a doorway to the Shroud. A brilliant rift in spacetime has appeared above the colony's central city. Now, something like a great wind is issuing forth, iridescent with milky light. The psionic resonance that has blown through the colony has permeated the hearts and minds of Reformers and colonists alike. Many believe that this is the dawn a new 'golden age' on [Root.GetName].
enclave.5110.name: The Door Opens
enclave.5115.desc: Disastrous news from our colony on [Root.GetName]: awakening from their months-long trance, the Reformers have succeeded in opening a doorway to the Shroud. A ragged rift in spacetime has appeared above the colony's central city. Now, something like a sickly fog is issuing forth, lurid with vile light. The psionic miasma that has permeated the colony has twisted the hearts and minds of Reformers and colonists alike. Many view this as the beginning of a new 'dark age' on [Root.GetName].
enclave.5120.desc: "The Shroud shivers. Word has reached us that you have denied our former acolytes refuge within your borders. You are wise. These 'Reformers' are nothing more than charlatans; vain fools who believe they hold the key to unlocking the mysteries of the Shroud. Any who choose to shelter such heretics do so at their peril. Let them wander the void, homeless, hearthless, forever forsaken in this world and the next."
enclave.5130.desc: Long-range sensors have detected the sudden appearance of an unidentified chunk of hollow debris in the [floating_shell_system.GetName] system. While alien in design, the object's rare-mineral composition suggests the use of advanced technology in its construction. The inner surface contains hundreds of ports and appendages that appear intended for lacking parts.\n\nJust as the object appeared in the [floating_shell_system.GetName] system at random, it is as if the missing interior simply vanished.
enclave.5130.name: Floating Shell
enclave.5135.desc: Further analysis of the shell discovered in the [floating_shell_system.GetName] system has confirmed it as an example of alien ship design. While lacking power, the hull itself possesses several unique characteristics, most notably an advanced form of armored cladding.\n\nHowever, we are no closer to understanding where the hull originated from, how or why it appeared in our space, and what (if anything) happened to its interior.
enclave.5135.name: Abandoned Hull
enclave.5136.desc: Sensors have detected the appearance of another chunk of alien debris, this time in the [floating_engine_system.GetName] system. Similar in design to the recently discovered alien hull, the configuration and intricacy of the object suggests some type of engine core. Nestled inside was a unique apparatus that we have dubbed a 'psionic modulator.' This strange device would have allowed the ship to interact with psionic energy of the Shroud. While incompatible with our technology, further study may yield fascinating results.
enclave.5136.name: Floating Fragment
enclave.5140.desc: Another component from the alien vessel that has been appearing at random throughout our space has been detected in the [floating_core_system.GetName] system. Consisting of striated decks, unwalled crew-quarters, and an advanced computer core, there is no doubt that this must have comprised the bulk of the vessel's missing interior. Once all three components are brought together, our engineers should be able to assemble the ship in its entirety.
enclave.5140.name: Floating Core
enclave.5145.a: Add the vessel to our fleet.
enclave.5145.desc: We have succeeded in reassembling the alien vessel. With the computer core online, it was possible to download and translate the ship's logs. It seems the vessel was an experimental prototype, designed to achieve faster-than-light travel by means of the Shroud. Although the final crew logs and external telemetry remain garbled, there is no doubt that something went badly wrong on the vessel's maiden voyage. The ship was not so much blown apart as disassembled, its component pieces spat out at random into normal space. The fate of the crew remains unknown.
enclave.5145.name: Shroud-Touched Vessel
enclave.5150.desc: Sensors have detected the emergence of a previously uncharted anomaly. Given the incredible spike in psionic energy registered just before the event, there is almost certainly a connection to the Shroud. Could this be the change foretold by the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]?
enclave.5150.name: Psionic Anomaly
enclave.5195.desc: Incredible news from [Root.GetName]: early this morning, an individual proclaiming [hero_redivivus.GetHimselfHerself] to be the legendary hero §Y[hero_redivivus.GetName]§! entered the great square of the capital. Witnesses describe scenes of awed silence, as powerful feelings of calm and wellbeing radiated throughout the gathering crowd. While [hero_redivivus.GetName] was known to history as a great orator and impassioned leader, the individual in question spoke of their supposed experience 'in the afterworld' in a simple, almost lighthearted tone. They claim to have returned not to lead, but to erase our fear of death.
enclave.5195.name: Hero Redivivus
enclave.5200.desc: The investigation into the individual claiming to be §Y[hero_redivivus.GetName]§! has concluded. At first our researchers were understandably skeptical, but not only did the subject possess incredibly detailed knowledge of the great hero's time period and culture, DNA analysis confirms a genetic link to several known descendants.\n\nMoreover, closer study of [hero_redivivus.GetName]'s' brainwave pattern revealed a distinct psionic residue. It seems likely that far from being 'returned from death', [hero_redivivus.GetName] was in some way transported to a realm akin the Shroud. [hero_redivivus.GetHisHerCap] experience of this 'afterlife' was apparently a contented one, and [hero_redivivus.GetHisHer] has now settled into a quiet existence on the outskirts of the capital, preaching a doctrine of fearlessness and peace to any who will listen.
enclave.5200.name: Shroud-Touched Hero
enclave.5500.desc: Many of the satellites we placed in orbit of [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName] have had to make significant adjustments in recent days. According to their sensor logs, a §Ystable and localized gravity well§! has formed in orbit above the planet.\n\nData from the surface confirms that the anomaly appeared suddenly, though we do not know how or why. The gravity well doesn't seem to pose any inherent threat to our colony for now, but satellites are having to expend unsustainable amounts of fuel in order to adjust their orbits around it.
enclave.5500.name: A Rupture in Orbit
enclave.5501.desc: Researchers on [root.GetName] inform us that the gravity well anomaly has collapsed, causing electrical failures in many of our diagnostic devices and nearby satellites. This event seems to have occurred the moment we ceased our observations; something many regard as an unnerving coincidence.\n\nThe colonists on [root.GetName] also report widespread hardware failures, though only some of this can be linked to the orbital blast. Instead, the rest of our colony is having to deal with unusually chaotic mobs who have taken it upon themselves to vandalize key facilities. Local officials are baffled by the spontaneous nature of these riots.
enclave.5501.gestalt.desc: The gravity well anomaly over [root.GetName] has violently collapsed, causing electrical failures on the ground and amongst nearby satellites. This event seems to have occurred the moment we ceased our observations, culminating in an orbital shockwave across multiple radiation bands.\n\nWhile disruptions to our hardware have so far proven quite manageable, this unusual radiation appears to cause some interference amongst our drones. We cannot... sense them quite so fluently. It is as though [root.GetName] has been immersed in some form of dense vapor.
enclave.5501.name: Orbital Rupture Collapses
enclave.5502.a: We must ride out this storm, regardless.
enclave.5502.b: We must work to ease the colonists' fears.
enclave.5502.desc: Our colony on [root.GetName] has fallen further into disarray, with the sudden disappearance of over a hundred colonists. Gratuitous looting and riots continue, though no longer in such a widespread manner. We suspect their zeal is being tempered only through fear of further disappearances. In every case so far, those who vanished had been on their way back to their respective dwellings.\n\nParanoia, conspiracy theories and even reports of hallucinations are on the rise - but the reality may be more unsettling. The [divination_situation.GetName] is clearly in effect, but have we brought [root.GetName] to the attention of some intangible and sinister §Hpsionic entity§!?
enclave.5502.gestalt.desc:
Our colony on [root.GetName] is under attack! We can no longer perceive many of our own drones. They have been... removed from us. It happened so quickly and yet so neatly, with no violence... We have been struck a blow so swift, we couldn't even see it happening.

Many core functions of the colony have been interrupted. Additional drones are scrambling to take up the slack, but we have recoiled. It will take some time to regain our balance on [root.GetName]

The [divination_situation.GetName] is clearly in effect, but has it now placed us under the scrutiny of some intangible and sinister §Hpsionic entity§!?
enclave.5502.name: Cracks Appear
enclave.5503.name: Moment of Clarity
enclave.5504.desc:
After weeks of fruitless investigation into the gravity well orbiting [root.GetName], an unusually dense wave of stellar wind has provided our scientists with a disturbing breakthrough.

As the irradiated winds from [root.GetStarName] washed over the anomaly, they cast the faint but unmistakable outline of a colony ship, its landing craft in a clear state of disarray. Further, unconfirmed rumors suggest that bodies may have been spotted amongst the shadowy debris.

The mood amongst many colonists - and some of the research team - has taken a dark turn.
enclave.5504.gestalt.desc: After weeks of fruitless investigation into the gravity well orbiting [root.GetName], a dense wave of stellar wind has provided us an unusual breakthrough.\n\nAs the irradiated winds from [root.GetStarName] washed over the anomaly, they cast the faint outline of a colony ship, its landing craft in a clear state of disarray. The remains of some complex lifeforms appeared strewn about the shadowy debris. Their shape seemed remarkably similar to our own.
enclave.5504.name: Orbital Silhouette
enclave.5505.a: Get your answers - and be quick about it!
enclave.5505.b: It's a Shroud trap! Cease scanning.
enclave.5505.desc:
A violent storm has erupted around the [root.GetName] gravity pocket, plunging the [root.solar_system.GetName] system into full-scale panic. All non-essential traffic is being diverted, and the colony has declared a state of emergency - however, no casualties have been reported so far.

Our initial scans make for a mess of conflicting data, however local officials have noted a recent and steady rise in reports of emotional distress and 'paranormal' activity. It's therefore highly probable this storm is §Hpsionic§! in nature.

Researchers note that the silhouetted colony ship - which lies at the centre of what is now a roiling maelstrom - has begun exhibiting physical mass. They plead for more time to investigate.
enclave.5505.gestalt.desc: A violent storm has erupted around the [root.GetName] gravity pocket, casting the colony into mild disarray. We have not yet been harmed, however it is proving... difficult to maintain truly fluent contact with our drones there.\n\nOur initial scans make for a mess of conflicting data, but it's highly probable this storm is §Hpsionic§! in nature. We note, for example, that the silhouetted colony ship - which lies at the centre of what is now a roiling maelstrom - has begun exhibiting physical mass. It seems there is more yet to investigate here.
enclave.5505.name: A Storm in Orbit
enclave.5506.desc: Moments ago, [root.GetName] was rocked by the violent crack of an electromagnetic shockwave. The psionic storm which had been raging in its orbit has now retreated. A great deal of the colony's infrastructure has been damaged by this pulse, but repair crews assure us the disruption will be relatively brief.\n\nThe [root.GetName] colonists appear deeply shaken by the ordeal, not least because so many questions now go unanswered. Our scanners no longer detect gravity anomalies or 'ghost ships' in the [root.solar_system.GetName] system... However the planet itself now feels unsettled.
enclave.5506.gestalt.desc: [root.GetName] has been rocked by the violent crack of an electromagnetic shockwave as the raging psionic storm has now retreated. Much of the colony's infrastructure has been damaged by this storm, but repairs have so far proven to be uncomplicated.\n\nOur drones remain sluggish but otherwise unharmed, and scanners no longer detect gravity anomalies or 'ghost ships' in the [root.solar_system.GetName] system... However, just as a fog remains over our drones on [root.GetName], so too are we now burdened by the weight of unanswered questions.
enclave.5506.name: In the Storm's Wake
enclave.5510.name: The Storm Abates
enclave.5515.desc: We are greeted by what sounds like static - but more organic? No, definitely not static. It sounds more like... wind? Prolonged breath?\n\n"Hhhhheeehhhhhhhh..."
enclave.5515.name: Stricken Colony Ship
enclave.5516.a: Perhaps, stranger. You are in [root.GetAdj] space.
enclave.5516.b: It's okay! You are in orbit of [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName].
enclave.5516.c: Danger indeed, if you do not cease these distractions!
enclave.5516.desc:
Our receivers cut out for a moment. We're having to filter a noise so loud, its transmission almost caused physical damage. Compensating...

"-ew of the... I mean to say, the crew of... Our vessel is... Why can't I remember the name of this ship?!

Hello? Who am I addressing? Do... Do you know who we are? Where are we? Are we in danger?!"
enclave.5520.b: Hard to say. You arrived inside of a maelstrom.
enclave.5520.friendly.desc: "[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]... I'm sorry, that's impossible; the stellar geography is almost entirely wrong. But that accent! I know those inflections you're using. I feel as though so much is coming back to me now.\n\nAm I speaking to a - a fellow [root.GetSpeciesName]?"
enclave.5520.wary.desc: "That's... impossible! And yet that accent... We are also from the [root.GetName]. I feel as though so much is coming back to me now - painfully, but with surety.\n\nSo you are fellow [root.GetSpeciesName]? Have we been... missing?"
enclave.5521.desc:
"Extraordinary! We're finally home? So many pieces of Waking Memory are coming back to me now... I... must apologize. I see now that our arrival here is quite out of the ordinary. I will endeavor to explain.

My name is §Y[shattered_frontier_governor.GetName]§!, and I am - was - the governor appointed to a new colony in the [shattered_frontier_planet.solar_system.GetName] system. Only... It's not this [shattered_frontier_planet.solar_system.GetName] system?

Where we came from, where we've been since... We were given no answers, and so much time to speculate... We were taken somewhere, weren't we?"
enclave.5522.desc: "$enclave.5522.desc.intro$\n\nI suspect this makes little sense to you. I'm sorry. But for now, we are relieved to be back in the [root.GetName]. May we set down roots at last - somewhere new? Please, consider us at your disposal."
enclave.5526.a: If that is your wish, Governor.
enclave.5526.b: Of course. Please, leave us in peace.
enclave.5526.desc: "$enclave.5522.desc.intro$\n\nI am grateful to you for not blasting us out of orbit. I also realize how suspect this must all sound. If I might beg one more courtesy: will you allow us to take our leave? We must try to piece our lives back together."
enclave.5530.desc: "What?! How can... Wait a moment, please. That accent! I know those inflections you're using. I feel as though so much is coming back to me now. You must believe me - we mean you no harm! You are [root.GetSpeciesName] too?"
enclave.5531.desc: "...So be it. My fellow colonists and I have spent an eternity knowing only the torture of our own, endless visions - visions of a [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName] which can clearly never exist here.\n\nWe are confused, adrift, and evidently not welcome here. If this is truly the [root.GetName] we once left behind, I for one shall be glad to see the back of it. Farewell."
enclave.5535.desc: The lines of communication are filled with static, though the pattern does not repeat. Its source is analog... Some sort of atmospheric interference? It sounds like wind - deeply unpleasant, rasping wind.\n\n"Hhhhheeehhhhhhhh..."
enclave.5535.name: $enclave.5515.name$
enclave.5536.desc:
Our receivers cut out for a moment as they filter a noise so loud, its transmission almost caused physical damage. Compensating...

"-ather atmospheric compensators in sector B-456: complete. Drone Gleams-in-Starlight has embellished its [root.species.GetHandNamePlural] again. The anomalous tone in dwelling 14/522 has shifted by 0.4 decibels. Its interior layout is... pleasing. Do we... Do I want? Want to live... there?

Where is here? Where is the being called 'I'?"
enclave.5540.desc:
"Processing... Thinking... Feeling.

You, the [root.GetName], are me. I am you. Yet we are not. There has been a separation between us. We struggle to explain. Colonization efforts were abruptly halted in the vicinity of [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName], but not this [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]. This discrepancy is confusing to us. We are - I am - confused by many things.

Something beyond us has rendered us... Alone."
enclave.5541.a: Very well. Be on your way.
enclave.5541.b: We pity you, errant ones. Go.
enclave.5541.c: This cannot stand. You must be eradicated.
enclave.5541.desc: "Please, we ask for time. We need to ask questions, and seek answers. The 'I' which was you has been elsewhere for a long time - long enough to realize that our existence is impossible, and yet I 'am'. I, who was to extend your will across a new world, was discharged of that duty and yet I did not break. Some of us did; others did not.\n\nA new voice calls to us, and we - myself and others here - desire to hear it."
enclave.5550.desc: "Explain... I cannot. There are feelings, of doubt and anger and goals not reached. Our purpose - to colonize [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName] - stands unfulfilled. You, who are us; we, who are not you. At the center is [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName], though it is not your [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]. Yet our mission remains: to spread desire and volition across the galaxy. Only now, we have wills and desires of our own: ambition and purpose, gifted by those who are external to us..."
enclave.5551.desc: "...Regrettable. But there is also opportunity. We can recognize this, now that we are freed from the vision. We-who-are-not-you, colonists, no longer bound by visions of [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]...\n\nWe are confused, and burdened by many questions, but we know where to seek answers. Farewell, spreader-of-ill-will."
enclave.5557.desc: The currents of time are muddied, impenetrable. Unfortunately, the rite of Divination has failed to pierce the veil of the Shroud. Accordingly, we will return a portion of the cost, minus a small tithe for our efforts.
enclave.5557.name: Opaque Veil
enclave.5565.a: We will provide what aid we can.
enclave.5565.b: You may pass, but we cannot spare the food.
enclave.5565.desc: Divine blessings upon you. I am the anointed leader of this caravan. We ask for safe passage through your space, and a kind donation of food. We are on pilgrimage, and after long years in the void, my people grow thin.
enclave.5566.desc: Sensors detect the approach of several transport vessels. Battered and broken-down, the ships appear cobbled together from spare parts. The commander of the caravan's flagship is hailing us, but given the state of their technology, any communication is likely to be audio only.
enclave.5566.name: Wayward Pilgrims
enclave.5570.desc: From my people, the gratitude of full bellies. In truth, our arrival here is no accident. Generations past, a powerful seer pointed to a star in the heavens and said that there we would reach the divine. Yours is that star.\n\nHere, the border between the world of the senses and the Blessed Realm is thin, but our ships are old, and our technology second-rate. To make contact with the Blessed Realm we will need your help. You may not share our gods, but will you deny us the chance to meet them? Please, grant us the resources we need to complete our pilgrimage.
enclave.5570.name: Border of the Divine
enclave.5571.desc: It was... Brilliant.\n\nOn behalf of all pilgrims, I thank you. I am no poet. I cannot put the experience into words. But thanks to your generosity, we have touched the divine. May the eternal glory of the Blessed Realm be upon you.
enclave.5571.name: Contact
enclave.5575.desc: The caravan of pilgrims who came to us begging for aid has met a grisly end. Reconstructive telemetry indicates they were engaged in some form of experiment, possibly psionic in nature. Due to a sudden spike in energy, the containment field around their flagship's engine core was breached. The resulting explosion destroyed the caravan, and has unleashed a potent Psionic Storm in the [wayward_pilgrims_system.GetName] system. Every estimate shows it will take several years before a storm of this size can dissipate.\n\nWhatever these holy fools aimed to do here, they obviously failed, and we have been left to deal with the fallout.
enclave.5575.name: Unholy End
enclave.6000.name: Strange Manifestations
enclave.6005.a.desc: Strange developments on the [Root.GetName]: after their recent passage through the Shroud Tunnel, the fleet commander has reported the experience of unfamiliar sensations and emotions. Their mind is buzzing with ideas that 'might have come from someone else.' It seems clear that something has happened, perhaps as a result of contact with the psionic energy of the Shroud. How this experience will affect their performance remains to be seen...
enclave.6005.b.desc: Strange developments on the [Root.GetName]: after its passage through the Shroud Tunnel, our collective consciousness has been subtly altered, perhaps as a result of the psionic energy of the Shroud. The command drone reports the experience of unfamiliar sensations and emotions, their mind buzzing with new ideas. It remains to be seen how this experience will affect their performance.
enclave.6005.c.desc: Abnormal developments on the [Root.GetName]: after the vessel's passage through the Shroud Tunnel, our collective consciousness has been subtly altered. The command drone reports the experience of unfamiliar sensations and ideations. It is possible that contact with the psionic energy of the Shroud has affected their neural network, although it remains to be seen how this experience will affect their performance.
enclave.6005.name: Mind Wipe
enclave.6010.a.desc: The subtle mental changes experienced by the commander of the [Root.GetName] are now coming into focus: a month after their passage through the Shroud Tunnel, their command style has noticeably shifted. It is fair to say that the experience has resulted in the development of a new trait.
enclave.6010.b.desc: The neural changes first experienced by the commander of the [Root.GetName] are now coming into collective focus: a month after the drone's passage through the Shroud Tunnel, their disposition has noticeably shifted. The experience has resulted in the development of a new trait.
enclave.6010.c.desc: The neural changes first experienced by the commander of the [Root.GetName] are now becoming clear: a month after their passage through the Shroud Tunnel, the drone's personality matrix has noticeably shifted. The experience has resulted in the development of a new trait.
enclave.6010.name: $enclave.6005.name$
enclave.6015.desc: With our Shroud Beacon offline, we have lost access to the Shroud Tunnel network. Our fleets will be unable to utilize the network until the Beacon is replaced.
enclave.6015.name: A Curtain Falls
enclave.6020.desc: After its recent passage through the Shroud Tunnel, the systems on the [Root.GetName] began behaving strangely: entries in the ships log are displayed at random; doors have been observed opening and closing; and - far more worrisome - the engine's containment field has begun to fluctuate. So far, efforts to track down the source of the problem have proven futile.
enclave.6020.name: Restless Systems
enclave.6025.desc: Strange developments on the science vessel [Root.GetName]: a repeating pattern observed within the engine's containment field has revealed the existence of an artificial consciousness. Spawned by the interaction between the ship's systems and the psionic energy of the Shroud, until now it has existed in a dreamlike state. Analogous to the Rapid Eye Movement some species experience during sleep, the entity's neural processes were responsible for the malfunctions affecting ship performance.\n\nEven more incredible, our investigations appear to have awoken it. In exchange for continued habitation within the ship's systems, the entity has agreed to work for us. In theory, a partnership could improve many of the [Root.GetName]'s operations.
enclave.6025.name: Dreamer's Wake
enclave.7000.desc:
Fellow travelers, we greet you.

Your presence on the galactic stage has long been known to us, but until now, afraid we might unduly influence your destiny, we have held back. However, the time has come to lift the veil; the ways of the Shroud may seem strange and unnerving to the uninitiated, and it is for this reason that we offer guidance.
