Realize that you have someone willing to be your teacher, if you so wish.

Wander safely, until our next encounter.
enclave.7000.title: [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]
enclave.7005.a: We thank you for the gift.
enclave.7005.b: A gift is only to be expected, xeno.
enclave.7005.desc:
We've been hearing rumors about the impressive [Root.GetName] for a while now, and we're pleased to make your acquaintance!

For a nominal contribution of credits, we of the [salvager_enclave_country.GetName] offer premium salvager services. From engine upgrades to scrapping fleets, whatever your needs, you can count on us!

And to ensure that we start off in your good graces, how about a small gift to show our commitment to customer service?
enclave.7005.title: [salvager_enclave_country.GetName]
enclave.7050.desc: A saying is known to us: 'Secrets dance in dreams.' To the Shroud, no vault is impenetrable, no code unbreakable. In our meditations, what others believe hidden is often laid bare. Would it interest you to learn what your peers are plotting? To know their designs as if they were your own? Should you wish it, we will share our insights. How you make use of them is up to you.
enclave.7055.desc: The Shroud wavers; its veil grows thin. We will now retire to our meditations. Whatever insights we glean will be made known to you.
enclave.7060.desc: It is said that within the Shroud every mind casts its shadow. During our meditations, the wavering of a certain mind was laid bare to us, a trusted voice whose loyalty is not as steadfast as it appears. Their duplicity is your gain. No doubt they will prove a willing asset.
enclave.7065.desc: You have many skilled agents in your employ, but each is bound by their own limitations. An eye cannot perceive itself. The Shroud knows no such boundaries; our meditations have revealed much. If your clandestine operations are to thrive, you would do well to heed our advice.
enclave.7070.desc: The corporeal realm is not as solid as it appears. So it is with those who dwell within. The secrets of your peers have been revealed to us. What we have learned is now yours.
enclave.7075.desc: A saying is known to us: 'Everything that can happen will; even nothing.' Unfortunately, our meditations have failed to produce any insight.
enclave.7100.desc: Mastery of the Shroud is a journey of 10,000 lifetimes; even our most gifted teachers can claim only partial knowledge of its mysteries. Nevertheless, their wisdom is invaluable. Should you wish it, we will dispatch one to guide your course.
enclave.7105.desc: To know that there is always more to know: this is the highest wisdom. A teacher will be sent to you. Learn well, and you will surely reap the rewards.
enclave.7110.a.tooltip: §PPsi Jump Drive technology§! now appears at §Y1.5§! times the normal rate.
enclave.7110.desc: A most interesting story. §YVeilfarer§!, you said? In some ways, this coven does resemble our own, but while these differences may appear subtle to the uninitiated, they are profound: a distorted reflection, from an universe not quite like our own.\n\nThe Shroud has many tears on its surface. Those who enter its mysteries may not always end up in the same universe from whence they started.
enclave.7250.a: You'll get your share. Teach us.
enclave.7250.desc: Zro is of particular interest to us. We could teach you the ways of harvesting and storing it, but only if you agree to give us a share of your production. In perpetuity.
enclave.7255.desc: Zro is a wonderful yet tragic substance. It has many applications, but should never be used lightly, for it is the last legacy of a most venerable species. Harvest it, treasure it, and don't forget to pay us what you owe.
enclave_energy_trade_ended: Insufficient £energy£ §HEnergy Credits§! to maintain resource deals with Trader Enclaves.
encourage_raid: Pay the [marauder_species.GetNamePlural] to raid one of your rivals.
end_trade_1: This will terminate our current resource trade deal with XuraCorp.
end_trade_2: This will terminate our current resource trade deal with the Riggans.
end_trade_3: This will terminate our current resource trade deal with the Muutagans.
endless_expanse_digsite_2_desc: Shrouded within [From.Planet.GetName]'s gaseous atmosphere is the dark looming form of an enormous habitat - the Ix Belèn Residence. Previously a bustling space city where the residents enjoyed a pampered lifestyle with a multitude of comforts made available through technology, the habitat is now a silent tomb. Molluscoid aliens lie slumped across the floor in various states of decay. A postmortem reveals that they died from asphyxiation as the habitat's life support system was disabled, intentionally.\n\nTheir homes are fitted with unusual mechanical chairs that are hooked up to a central database in the shape of a gigantic blue orb - the Memorex.
endless_expanse_digsite_desc: At first sight there is only snow and ice on [From.Planet.GetName]. Vast expanses of impenetrable white, glass lakes and jagged turquoise glaciers against fiery orange skies torn open like a wound, pouring red into the seas as [From.Planet.Solar_System.GetName]'s stars set. If the world had an end this would be it. Here the seas lie still and the snow untouched. The only sounds are the thunder of the ice calving and the wind howling across the plains.\n\nYet, [From.Planet.GetName] was once someone's home. In the midst of a wide barren field the black metal framework of a steeple protrudes from the white masses. What forgotten secrets could be buried beneath the snow?
energy_uninhabitable_category_desc: We briefly detected some unusual energy readings emanating from this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. It might have been a glitch in our systems, or it could be a sign of something more.
envoy_events.1.desc: It appears that a mischievous third party was able to hack into the translation software of the [envoy_source.GetAdj] envoy to [Root.Capital.GetName], [event_envoy.GetName], so that instead of uttering magnanimous platitudes, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] began spewing vicious insults that left none unscathed. The malfunction in [event_envoy.GetHerHis] equipment was duly uncovered, but not before [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] was declared to be a "vile [ruler_species.GetNameInsult]" - a grave insult which surely calls for a response.
envoy_events.1.name: Insulting [envoy_source.GetAdj] Envoy
envoy_events.10.A: We are saddened to hear this.
envoy_events.10.B.tooltip1: Send a special ops team to retrieve the pair.\nThe [third_party.GetName] will be displeased.
envoy_events.10.desc: Political asylum is sacred to us. We cannot countenance giving up those who have done no wrong to the likes of you!
envoy_events.100.desc.gestalt: A delegate from the §H[scandalous_insult_country.GetName]§! has let slip their gestalt's true feelings about us, apparently when in conference with other, anonymous parties. Given how petty it must be for a combined consciousness to even contemplate so-called 'political mud-slinging', these strike us as an §Pabsurd and potent insult§!.\n\nWhether or not we pay any mind to this baseless slander: diplomacy and pride would demand that we stand our ground against this bizarre [scandalous_insult_country.GetAdj] behavior.
envoy_events.100.desc.hostile: A delegate from the §H[scandalous_insult_country.GetName]§! has dared to let slip their pitiful empire's true feelings about us, apparently while in conference with other, anonymous parties.\n\nThis §Pabsurd insult§! seeks to belittle us, and whether or not we pay any mind to this baseless slander: pride demands that we not stand for it.
envoy_events.100.desc.regular: We have caught a delegate from the §H[scandalous_insult_country.GetName]§! in a rare blunder, letting slip their empire's true feelings about us to another, anonymous party. More than the usual political mud-slinging: these amount to an §Poutright insult§!, as it appears we are the subjects of fierce ridicule amongst [scandalous_insult_country.GetAdj] society.\n\nWhether or not we pay any mind to this baseless slander: diplomacy and pride would demand that we stand our ground.
envoy_events.100.name: Scandalous Insult
envoy_events.101.desc: The §H[from.GetName]§! say they have §Ptaken offense§! at a misdemeanor carried out by one of our officials. They have not named the official, nor even described the nature of the insult. Instead we have received little more than a burst of indignation, and an abrupt end to communications.\n\nIt's possible that this rare breach in diplomacy is the work of some other, meddling party; it could just as easily be an honest misunderstanding.
envoy_events.101.name: $envoy_events.100.name$
envoy_events.11.desc: It seems the [From.GetName] were so displeased by our refusal to extradite their rogue envoy [event_envoy.GetName] to them that they took matters into their own hands. The fugitive was stolen from under our noses at dead of night by what appears to have been a very well-drilled team of special operatives.\n\nOur inability to protect those who seek our aid has caused considerable concern among our allies, and our diplomats are scrambling to contain the situation.
envoy_events.11.name: [From.GetAdj] Special Ops Mission
envoy_events.12.desc: The team we sent to retrieve our rogue envoy, [event_envoy.GetName], has successfully completed its mission. The criminal is now safely in our custody and faces a heavy punishment for [event_envoy.GetHerHis] sins.
envoy_events.12.name: Special Ops Mission Successful
envoy_events.13.desc: It seems the [From.GetName] were so displeased by our refusal to extradite their rogue envoy [event_envoy.GetName] to them that they took matters into their own hands and launched a retrieval mission. However, this mission was bungled, as we intercepted the [From.GetAdj] vessel carrying their special operatives as it attempted to cross the border. Measures have been taken to ensure that future attempts will be similarly unsuccessful.
envoy_events.13.name: [From.GetAdj] Special Ops Mission Thwarted
envoy_events.14.desc: The team we sent to retrieve our rogue envoy, [event_envoy.GetName], was unsuccessful in its mission; their vessel was taken into [From.GetAdj] custody as they tried to cross the border. The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are predictably incensed and are decrying [Root.GetAdj] interference in their affairs. For their part, our citizens are dismayed at our handling of the affair and our failure to retrieve the criminal.
envoy_events.14.name: Special Ops Mission Unsuccessful
envoy_events.15.desc: [event_envoy.GetName], our emissary to the Galactic Community, has been spending a disturbing amount of time tending to a strange, small mammalian creature that began following [event_envoy.GetHerHim] around. Presumably a domestic pet that escaped from one of the other delegations, it is undeniably cute but shows no sign of sapient thought. Although it is highly carnivorous and exhibits sharp teeth and claws, it is generally affectionate and desires plentiful physical contact in the form of petting - though its mood swings can be sudden and violent!\n\nAlthough the creature has proved a distraction for [event_envoy.GetName]'s more serious tasks, other delegates have commented on the endearing nature of the softer, more sentimental side of the [Root.GetSpeciesName] psyche that has been revealed.
envoy_events.15.name: A Strange Creature
envoy_events.17.A: We cannot compromise on our values.
envoy_events.17.B: We shall keep our silence in the interest of unity.
envoy_events.17.desc.authoritarian: $envoy_events.17.desc.base$ However, [dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe] [dispute_loser_envoy.GetWasWere] unable to convince those present of the benefits of a more authoritarian outlook, with witnesses increasingly convinced at the alleged evil of impinging on the liberties of the individual.\n\n$envoy_events.17.desc.end$
envoy_events.17.desc.egalitarian: $envoy_events.17.desc.base$ However, [dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe] [dispute_loser_envoy.GetWasWere] unable to convince those present of the benefits of a more egalitarian outlook, as those living in less free societies failed to see the benefits that greater liberties would give them, instead accusing us of being "dangerously liberal".\n\n$envoy_events.17.desc.end$
envoy_events.17.desc.materialist: $envoy_events.17.desc.base$ However, [dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe] [dispute_loser_envoy.GetWasWere] unable to convince those present of the benefits of a more materialistic outlook, and grew increasingly rattled as [dispute_loser_envoy.GetHerHis] peers continued to decry [Root.GetAdj] "hedonism", insisting on the superiority of their superstitious ways.\n\n$envoy_events.17.desc.end$
envoy_events.17.desc.militarist: $envoy_events.17.desc.base$ However, [dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe] [dispute_loser_envoy.GetWasWere] unable to convince those present of the benefits of a more militaristic outlook, and as the debate turned against [dispute_loser_envoy.GetHerHim], [dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe] appeared increasingly rattled as accusations of "[Root.GetAdj] warmongering" were made against [dispute_loser_envoy.GetHerHim] from all sides.\n\n$envoy_events.17.desc.end$
envoy_events.17.desc.pacifist: $envoy_events.17.desc.base$ However, [dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe] [dispute_loser_envoy.GetWasWere] unable to convince those present of the benefits of a more pacifistic outlook, and faced vociferous retorts from all quarters that "[Root.GetAdj] naivety" allegedly threatens the safety of the entire federation.\n\n$envoy_events.17.desc.end$
envoy_events.17.desc.spiritualist: $envoy_events.17.desc.base$ However, [dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe] [dispute_loser_envoy.GetWasWere] unable to convince those present of the benefits of a more spiritualist outlook, and witnesses were left shaking their head at the "backwardness" of [Root.GetAdj] "superstitions".\n\n$envoy_events.17.desc.end$
envoy_events.17.desc.xenophile: $envoy_events.17.desc.base$ However, [dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe] [dispute_loser_envoy.GetWasWere] unable to convince those present of the benefits of a more xenophilic outlook, with [dispute_loser_envoy.GetHerHis] outlook flatly condemned as "dangerously liberal".\n\n$envoy_events.17.desc.end$
envoy_events.17.desc.xenophobe: $envoy_events.17.desc.base$ However, [dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe] [dispute_loser_envoy.GetWasWere] unable to convince those present of the benefits of a more xenophobic outlook, with [dispute_loser_envoy.GetHerHis] protestations that we should be wary of foreign influences decried as hollow and backwards prejudice.\n\n$envoy_events.17.desc.end$
envoy_events.17.name: Disputes Among Allies
envoy_events.18.A: They simply could not bear the superiority of our ways.
envoy_events.18.name: $envoy_events.17.name$
envoy_events.19.A: Through our words shall we persuade.
envoy_events.19.name: $envoy_events.17.name$
envoy_events.2.desc.neg: $envoy_events.2.desc.base$\n\nAlthough the malfunction was swiftly uncovered, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] were not amused at the incident and have lodged an official complaint at the inappropriate behavior of our envoy.
envoy_events.2.desc.pos: $envoy_events.2.desc.base$\n\nFortunately, the malfunction was swiftly uncovered and the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] took the incident with a sense of humor. Indeed, recordings of the "inappropriate [Root.GetAdj] envoy" are circulating widely, causing much mirth among their people.
envoy_events.2.name: Translation Software Malfunction
envoy_events.200.A: What could be the harm in it?
envoy_events.200.desc: A cacophony of voices may be heard in the Galactic Community - not all of them friendly, and certainly not all of them aligning with [Root.GetAdj] interests. Unfortunately, it seems that emissary [event_envoy.GetName] has been listening to the wrong voices. Eyebrows were raised when [event_envoy.GetSheHe] attended several conferences hosted by the §H[Root.GetOppositionGalcomLobbyists]§!. Now it has emerged that a large sum of credits traceable to that organization were transferred to [event_envoy.GetHerHim].\n\n[event_envoy.GetName]'s colleagues demand that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] be recalled, citing trust issues. However, some of our more devious advisors suggest that we could strike a deal to keep [event_envoy.GetHerHim] in place in return for a share of the pot.
envoy_events.200.name: Lobbyists
envoy_events.205.desc: The [envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have brought forward a complaint regarding the conduct of our [event_envoy.GetAmbassadorOrNot] to the [event_envoy.GetEnvoyLocation], [event_envoy.GetName]. Apparently [event_envoy.GetHerHis] conduct has so offended the local [envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] that their authorities have posted a guard for [event_envoy.GetHerHis] own protection. Exactly what [event_envoy.GetSheHe] did is unclear to us, as we lack [envoy_country.GetAdj] sensibilities, but there are widespread protests against [event_envoy.GetHerHim] and the "[Root.GetAdj] arrogance" [event_envoy.GetSheHe] supposedly represent[event_envoy.GetSXX].\n\nThe [envoy_country.GetName] urges us to recall [event_envoy.GetName] and send a new ambassador in [event_envoy.GetHerHis] place. They hint at diplomatic repercussions should we refuse.
envoy_events.205.name: Missteps from an Ambassador
envoy_events.210.name: Gone Native
envoy_events.215.A.tooltip: §Y[event_envoy.GetName]§! is replaced with immediate effect. However, it will prove impossible to cover up this stain on our diplomatic corps.
envoy_events.215.desc: Our ambassador corps has for some time been concerned at the performance of [event_envoy.GetName], one of our officials to the [event_envoy.GetEnvoyLocation]. Now, evidence has come to light that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] appear[event_envoy.GetSXX] to have fallen prey to an alien substance from the [provider_country.GetName] that has proven extremely addictive to [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].\n\nAlthough the trade in this substance is highly illegal among the [provider_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural], a lucrative black market run by cutthroat drug lords has sprung up. These drug lords, who apparently managed to introduce it to [event_envoy.GetHerHim] as a potent aphrodisiac, now exert a considerable degree of influence over [event_envoy.GetName], who is forced to do their bidding in return for satisfying [event_envoy.GetHerHis] cravings.
envoy_events.215.name: Substance Abuse
envoy_events.220.name: Offense Taken
envoy_events.225.desc: The [Root.GetAdj] diplomatic corps has been shaken by the news emerging from the [scandal_empire.GetName]. Our [event_envoy.GetAmbassadorOrNot] [event_envoy.GetName], who had been stationed there, has gotten [event_envoy.GetHerselfHimself] into a serious mess with [scandal_empire.GetAdj] law enforcement. [event_envoy.GetSheHeCap] [event_envoy.GetIsAre] currently in connection with a salacious affair involving an astonishing range of serious crimes that culminated in a brutal double murder.\n\nAs matters stand - and with rumors running wild among the [scandal_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] - there seems little doubt as to [event_envoy.GetName]'s guilt. The [scandal_empire.GetAdj] authorities have requested that [event_envoy.GetHerHis] diplomatic immunity be lifted so that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] can face justice for [event_envoy.GetHerHis] deeds.
envoy_events.225.name: A Salacious Affair
envoy_events.230.desc: Upon entering the [Root.envoy_location_country.GetName], Ambassador [Root.GetName] was arrested on numerous charges of wrongdoing. The [Root.envoy_location_country.GetAdj] missive was brief: "we thank you for returning the criminal to us, so that justice may be served."
envoy_events.230.name: [Root.GetName] Arrested
envoy_events.3.desc: $envoy_events.3.desc.base$ Many now cast aspersions on the competence of our diplomatic corps, although our contribution to galactic comedy cannot be doubted.
envoy_events.3.desc.hive: $envoy_events.3.desc.base$ Many now cast aspersions on the competence of our diplomatic thought routines, although our contribution to galactic comedy cannot be doubted.
envoy_events.3.desc.machine: $envoy_events.3.desc.base$ Many now cast aspersions on the competence of our diplomatic systems, although our contribution to galactic comedy cannot be doubted.
envoy_events.3.name: A Contribution to Galactic Comedy
envoy_events.4.desc: $envoy_events.4.desc.base$ As a result, even though not everyone may fear the might of our navy or long to match the depths of our coffers, they nevertheless admire the prowess of our diplomatic corps.
envoy_events.4.desc.hive: $envoy_events.4.desc.base$ As a result, even though not everyone may fear the might of our navy or long to match the extent of our material resources, they nevertheless admire the prowess of our diplomatic thought routines.
envoy_events.4.desc.machine: $envoy_events.4.desc.base$ As a result, even though not everyone may fear the might of our navy or long to match the extent of our material resources, they nevertheless admire the prowess of our diplomatic thought systems.
envoy_events.4.name: Astute Galactic Diplomacy
envoy_events.5.A: We will not stoop to such measures. Snuff out the plot!
envoy_events.5.B: Let us be rid of this troublesome envoy.
envoy_events.5.desc: The [envoy_source.GetAdj] envoy, [event_envoy.GetName], has been exasperatingly tiresome in [event_envoy.GetHerHis] efforts to represent [envoy_source.GetAdj] interests in [Root.Capital.GetName]. Right from [event_envoy.GetHerHis] first arrival, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetHasHave] shown unremitting hostility towards the [Root.GetGovernmentName], unleashing an almost constant barrage of objections to our policies and actions. So great an irritation [event_envoy.GetHasHave] [event_envoy.GetSheHe] been that few would weep to see the back of [event_envoy.GetHerHim], and we have heard whispers that a group of [Root.GetAdj] loyalists are plotting to expedite [event_envoy.GetHerHis] demise.\n\nAllowing this scheme to succeed would certainly be convenient, but allowing foreign dignitaries to be assassinated in our realm might not be the best of looks.
envoy_events.5.name: A Most Irritating Envoy
envoy_events.6.desc: [event_envoy.GetName] - the envoy we sent to mediate our disagreements with the [From.GetName] - has been murdered! [event_envoy.GetSheHeCap] disappeared without a trace several days ago, missing [event_envoy.GetHerHis] scheduled sync with the [Root.GetRulerTitle]'s council. After several days of searching, [event_envoy.GetHerHis] remains were found in a storage container destined to be incinerated.\n\nThe [From.GetAdj] authorities have been strangely evasive when asked to investigate, arousing suspicions that they were behind the killing - especially since [event_envoy.GetName] had been highly critical of the [From.GetGovernmentName] in recent times.
envoy_events.6.name: Murder on [From.Capital.GetName]!
envoy_events.7.B: Approach them and appeal to reason.
envoy_events.7.B.tooltip: If the [third_party.GetName] accepts, we will owe them 2 Favors.
envoy_events.7.D: Let it be; the affair will be forgotten soon enough.
envoy_events.7.desc: It seems that, instead of performing [event_envoy.GetHerHis] task and representing [Root.GetAdj] interests, our envoy [event_envoy.GetName] has fallen for the charms of a [other_species_nation.GetAdj] diplomat. Fearing the repercussions of this transgression, the pair have eloped to the [third_party.GetName]: a nation whose dangerously liberal constitution permits such unions.\n\nIn doing this, [event_envoy.GetName] has forfeited [event_envoy.GetHerHis] position as our envoy. However, this loss of control over our own officials has hurt our galactic standing. We must restore our reputation by apprehending the miscreant!
envoy_events.7.name: Star-Crossed Lovers
envoy_events.8.desc: Esteemed [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! It has come to our attention that a [From.GetAdj] criminal has taken refuge in your nation. The miscreant, our former envoy [event_envoy.GetName], broke all bonds of loyalty - along with the most fundamental laws of our nation - to elope with a [other_species_nation.GetAdj].\n\nWe would kindly ask that the criminal be returned to us, so that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] can face trial for [event_envoy.GetHerHis] crimes.
envoy_events.9.desc: Of course! We will return [event_envoy.GetName] to you immediately.
espionage.10.desc: Our presence in the §Y[from.target.GetName]§! has taken on a clandestine aspect. $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName] is now situated at the core of a burgeoning §HSpy Network§! in [from.target.GetAdj] space.
espionage.10.name: Spy Network Formed
espionage.1001.a: Former agents are to be disavowed. Ignore this.
espionage.1001.desc.network: $espionage.1001.desc.intro$\n\nOur security advisors confirm that the codes were valid until quite recently, but their expiry means such codes are open to compromise by foreign powers. There's no telling if the operative or their message are genuine.
espionage.1001.desc.nonetwork: $espionage.1001.desc.intro$\n\nThe operative had been declared lost, and as such our security advisors advise extreme caution. Expired codes - and perhaps even lost operatives - are assumed to be already compromised.
espionage.1001.name: An Operative Resurfaces
espionage.1005.a: An empty and suspicious threat. Continue to ignore.
espionage.1005.desc: We've received another encrypted message from within the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!, employing a different cipher this time. Our supposed, once-lost operative claims that the knowledge they hold puts their life at extreme risk. They say that if we do not extract and debrief them, they must consider §Hdefecting§!.
espionage.1005.name: An Insistent Former Operative
espionage.1011.desc: There have been no further messages from our disavowed operative within the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!. The matter is being considered as resolved.\n\nWe may never know if there really was a former operative - nor will we know if there actually was useful intelligence to be had. If this was instead a [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] ruse: we can safely state that their ploy has failed.
espionage.1011.name: Disavowal Holds
espionage.1012.desc: We have received a rather brusk statement from the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!. They claim to have been approached by a §Hformer [root.GetAdj] spy§!, and that we are to be held to account. Furthermore, this individual is set to suffer every punishment their society has set for 'foreign agents'.\n\n$espionage.1012.desc.end$
espionage.1012.desc.official: We have received a rather brusk communiqué from [disavowed_agent_official.GetName] of the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!. [disavowed_agent_official.GetHeSheCap] claim[disavowed_agent_official.GetSXX] to have been approached by someone who had, in turn, identified themself as a §Hformer [root.GetAdj] spy§!. The [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] representative used few words, but keenly expressed their empire's narrow tolerance for 'foreign agents'.\n\n$espionage.1012.desc.end$
espionage.1012.name: Burned Bridges
espionage.1013.desc: We have received an unusual statement from the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!, claiming they have been approached by a §Hformer [root.GetAdj] spy§!. If the message is to be believed, the disavowed operative not only exists, but felt no recourse other than to defect - only to be dismissed outright by [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] authorities. Or so the message claims.\n\nThe [disavowed_agent_country.GetName] do not state precisely what their next course of action will be, but such an individual would almost certainly be placed under close observation for as long as they remain there. As a formality, the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName] have issued a diplomatic sanction against us for this 'violation of sovereign territory'.
espionage.1016.desc.network: Our security advisors report an end to any threat which may have been posed by our former operative in the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!. $espionage.1016.desc.end$
espionage.1016.desc.nonetwork: The former operative who had attempted to regain contact from within the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§! has been cleanly dealt with. $espionage.1016.desc.end$
espionage.1016.name: Final Disavowal
espionage.1017.desc: The clandestine strike team we sent into the §Y[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§! have returned with great haste. It seems there never was a disavowed operative. Instead what the team found was subtle evidence of a plot to expose our clandestine operations.\n\nPerhaps this was a scheme intended to further [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] goals; perhaps an external body sought to meddle in our affairs. In either case: our containment measures were aborted just in time to avoid exposing our intelligence operations, past or present.
espionage.1017.name: The Phantom Operative
espionage.1021.desc: Our once-disavowed operative has made it back to [root.GetAdj] space. This §H[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] individual§! - who identified [disavowed_operative.GetHimselfHerself] as [disavowed_operative.GetName] - appears nervous and relieved, but has cleared all security verification. The debriefing has been described as arduous, but the information has proven to be useful - we have now gained access to a valuable §YAsset§!.\n\nWith the matter now resolved, [disavowed_operative.GetName]'s shaky disavowal will be renewed. Having confirmed that [disavowed_operative.GetHeShe] [disavowed_operative.GetIsAre] no longer missing in action, our current operatives can ensure that this time, the disavowal will stick.
espionage.1021.name: Disavowed Operative Returned
espionage.1022.desc: It appears we acted too hastily in trying to extract our supposed, §Hdisavowed operative§!. We have entirely lost contact with the team of operatives we dispatched to the §H[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]§!. We now suspect that the operative never existed.\n\nAll operatives who were associated with this endeavor have been disavowed. As a result, our ability to conduct further operations in the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName] will be restricted for a time as the Spy Network recovers.
espionage.1022.name: It's a Ploy!
espionage.1030.a: This could be advantageous, if managed well.
espionage.1030.desc: Some of the operatives we control in the §H[vividsight_country.GetName]§! are beginning to draw unusual amounts of attention; they are regarded as somehow... attractive?\n\nWe have no reason to believe their cover identities are in jeopardy, but their growing notoriety and influence put strain on the deniability of our Spy Network.
espionage.1030.name: Hiding in Vivid Sight
espionage.1040.a.tooltip: We have acquired a §Ynew Asset§! for our Spy Network in the §H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§!.
espionage.1040.desc.caught: Our $role_spymaster$ in the §H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§! reports that we have successfully captured a band of §Psaboteurs§!. Though we were unable to prevent their recent act of aggression against us, our interrogations of the hostile operatives has proven lucrative.\n\nThe intelligence we've gathered will not serve us for long, but capturing these saboteurs has granted us an advantage in our own operations against the [luckycatch_country.GetName]. Through them, we have secured an §YAsset§! to aid us when required.
espionage.1040.desc.caughtspies: We have have trapped a group of §P[luckycatch_country.GetAdj] spies§!. It seems they were engaged in an operation against us, the details of which are unknown to us yet.\n\nThrough our interrogations, however, we have gathered some small amount of Intel on the §H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§!. Our $role_spymaster$ now also has access to a local §YAsset§! with which we can press this advantage.
espionage.1040.desc.gestalt: Amongst our many clandestine tasks in the §H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§! is the low-key scouting of potential Assets: any tool we can use to further our efforts amongst the gestalt entity. Our $role_spymaster$ reports having just made one such lucky catch.
espionage.1040.desc.regular: Our $role_spymaster$ watching over the §H[luckycatch_country.GetName]§! reports the surprise, successful acquisition of a new §YAsset§! - a sympathetic contact who will be of service to our operations as and when we need them.\n\nAll efforts have been taken to ensure that this new contact is genuine. Protocols have been established which seek to minimize the risk of potential double agents, for example.
espionage.1040.name: A Surprise Catch
espionage.1050.desc: A particularly observant operative in the §Y[finderskeepers_country.GetName]§! has laid their [root.species.GetHandNamePlural] on part of a §H[finderskeepers_country.GetAdj] encryption key§!. It would seem a careless [finderskeepers_country.GetSpeciesName] $job_politician$ mislaid the device whilst commuting.\n\nThis bodes well enough for our operations in the [finderskeepers_country.GetName], but our study of the device's unique design has revealed novel insights for our general approach to §Y$MOD_INTEL_DECRYPTION_ADD$§!.
espionage.1050.name: Finders Keepers
espionage.1060.a.tooltip: A £job_politician£ §Y$job_politician$§! on our capital is fired and §Rdemoted§!.
espionage.1060.b.tooltip: A §Y[root.GetCorpRulerJobIcon]§! on our capital is fired and §Rdemoted§!.
espionage.1060.desc: One of our $job_politician_plural$ on [capital_scope.GetName] has carelessly misplaced a bundle of sensitive materials, including an §Hencryption key§! whose very existence outside of government facilities is a gross breach of protocol.\n\nOur domestic authorities are scrambling to switch security platforms, as it's quite possible these materials may have fallen into hostile [root.species.GetHandNamePlural].
espionage.1060.desc.corp: One of our [root.GetCorpRulerJobPlural] on [capital_scope.GetName] has carelessly misplaced a bundle of sensitive materials, including an §Hencryption key§! whose mere existence outside of strictly-defined zones is a gross breach of protocol.\n\nOur security teams are scrambling to switch operating procedures, as it's quite possible these materials may have fallen into the [root.species.GetHandNamePlural] of our competitors.
espionage.1060.name: Stray Communiqué
espionage.1070.b: The galaxy shall hear of this!
espionage.1070.b.tooltip: \n§HThe §Y[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]§! will be informed that we caught their operatives.§!
espionage.1070.desc.identified:
$espionage.1070.desc.identified.intro$

We have managed to §Ydecrypt§! various materials they were carrying, however none lays out the full scope of their plans against us; nor are we able to say with certainty what their next move may be. Our Intel gains are therefore relatively small.

We must carefully consider how to respond. We may wish to keep quiet about our own capabilities, feigning ignorance in front of our other galactic neighbors. We would, however, also be justified in publicly denouncing this planned act of violence against us.
espionage.1070.desc.identified.hostile:
$espionage.1070.desc.identified.intro$

Amongst the materials we forcibly extracted from them were a number of communication logs, which we have managed to decrypt. None describes the full scope of their plans against us; [hostile_infiltration_country.GetAdj] security seems at least capable enough to yield only patchy Intel to us. Everything else we may extract from them is deemed unreliable information.

Despite the justified outrage we may wish to express, we would be wise to consider our response. We could keep quiet about our own Encryption skill, feigning ineptitude in front of our enemies. Were we to expose the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName] for this planned act of violence against us, however, we might find those enemies even regarding us with sympathy.
espionage.1070.desc.unknown:
Our Encryption measures have caught a band of anonymous, yet deadly infiltrators. They claim various allegiances, none of which we could hope to verify.

$espionage.1070.desc.middle$

It may be worthwhile keeping a closer watch on the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName], just in case. However, it may also benefit us to keep quiet and not let slip the comparative weakness of our own security.
espionage.1070.desc.unknown.hostile:
Our Encryption measures have caught a band of anonymous, yet deadly infiltrators. Even under interrogation they claim various allegiances, none of which we could hope to verify.

$espionage.1070.desc.middle$

We could retaliate against the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName] - such action may even be deemed justified by others. However, it's possible this entire incident is a clever lure, put in place to distract us from our true enemies.
espionage.1070.e: Let them buy our silence in this matter.
espionage.1070.name: Hostile Infiltration Detected
espionage.1071.b: Two can play at that game.
espionage.1071.desc: Our recent targets of espionage, the §Y[from.GetName]§!, have not only seen through our scheme but have chosen to §Pexpose us§! for our actions!\n\nIt's possible that no verifiable evidence backs up these claims - few may choose to believe them. The accusation alone may be damaging enough, however.
espionage.1071.desc.hostile: Our recent targets of espionage, the §Y[from.GetName]§!, have not only seen through our scheme but have decided to §Pexpose us§! for our actions against them.\n\nIt's possible that they hold no actual evidence for this - they may simply try to bluff their way to insulting us or earning favor with their galactic neighbors.
espionage.1071.name: No Longer Covert
espionage.1072.desc: The §H[from.GetName]§! accuses us of §Phostile espionage§!. Their claims - that we sent operatives to conduct abhorrent acts of aggression against them - are built upon shaky and misattributed evidence.\n\nWhatever the credibility or reasoning behind this allegation, it has resulted in a diplomatic sanction from the [from.GetName]. We are not likely to see any direct consequences from this, but it's unlikely this smear will go unnoticed by any of their other allies, or even our own.
espionage.1072.name: Allegations of Espionage
espionage.1073.desc: Our recent targets of espionage, the §Y[from.GetName]§!, have caught us in the act and §Hdemanded political favors§!. In doing so, they have agreed not to expose our covert actions to the wider galaxy.\n\nIt's possible that no actual evidence backs up their claims - the accusation alone could cause us enough damage anyway. Whatever their motivation is, the [from.GetName] have claimed political leverage on us.
espionage.1073.name: Extorted for Espionage
espionage.1081.desc: Our operatives in the §Y[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]§! have uncovered something unusual: credible hints that the §H[insidious_plot_country.GetName]§! are plotting to deceive us! We have no exact details of the apparent scheme yet, but it's said to involve manipulation of our existing relationships - undermining agreements of trust and our very way of life.\n\n$espionage.1081.desc.outro$
espionage.1081.desc.hostile: Our operatives in the §Y[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]§! have uncovered rumors that the §H[insidious_plot_country.GetName]§! are plotting to deceive us. We have no exact details of their apparent scheme yet, but it seems set to try and undermine us and our way of life.\n\n$espionage.1081.desc.outro$
espionage.1081.desc.samecountry: Our operatives in the §Y[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]§! have uncovered credible rumors of a local plot against us. It seems their §H[insidious_plot_country.GetAdj]§! counterparts are somewhat careless about their own operational secrecy.\n\nWe have no exact details for their apparent scheme yet, but it's said to involve a manipulation of our existing relationships - undermining agreements of trust and our very way of life.
espionage.1081.name: Insidious Plot Uncovered
espionage.1082.a: This potential outrage cannot be tolerated.
espionage.1082.b: This is likely a ploy. Ignore it.
espionage.1082.desc: Our operatives in the §Y[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]§! have uncovered suspect evidence that the §H[insidious_plot_country.GetName]§! mean to deceive us in the near future.\n\n$espionage.1082.outro$
espionage.1082.desc.samecountry: Our operatives in the §Y[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]§! have uncovered suspect evidence that they mean to launch a deceptive counter-operation against us in the near future.\n\n$espionage.1082.outro$
espionage.1082.name: Suspect Plot Uncovered
espionage.1085.desc: We have been implicated in a plot against the §H[from.GetName]§!. So vague is the allegation that we cannot definitively state whether or not they are on to something.\n\nOur own spies protest that the allegation is baseless, claiming this is likely either a defensive, counter-espionage response from one of our targets - or else a smear campaign being conducted by some third party. Whatever the reason or cause, the [from.GetName] have taken offense.
espionage.1085.desc.neverspied: Amazingly, we have been implicated in some vaguely-defined plot against the §H[from.GetName]§!. It's a ridiculous allegation, given our complete lack of foreign espionage activity so far - but then, the [from.GetAdj] would have no way of knowing how truly ridiculous the allegation is.\n\nIt would seem that parties unknown are attempting to frame us for their own misdemeanors - or perhaps simply to sow some diplomatic chaos. Whatever the reason or cause, the [from.GetName] have taken offense.
espionage.1085.name: Implicated in a Plot
espionage.11.desc: Our presence in the §Y[from.target.GetName]§! has taken on a clandestine aspect: $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName] has engaged Espionage protocols. Our newly-established §HSpy Network§! will allow us to observe [from.target.GetAdj] activities, infiltrating and intervening where necessary.
espionage.11.name: Spy Network Installed
espionage.15.desc: We have received our first clandestine report from $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName], inside the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This marks the establishment of our first §HSpy Network§! within xeno territory. Whenever they make a move, we stand a better chance of it playing right into our [owner.species.GetHandNamePlural].
espionage.15.name: Spy Network Established
espionage.16.desc: We have received our first clandestine report from $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName], inside the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This marks the foundation of our first §HSpy Network§! within a xeno empire - ideally positioned to warn us of their alien and duplicitous schemes.
espionage.17.desc: We have received our first clandestine report from $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName], inside the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This heralds the foundation of our first §HSpy Network§! within a xeno empire. From this day forward, they too will realize the formative benefits of [owner.species.GetAdj]-honed information control...
espionage.18.desc: Reports have started coming in from $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName], assigned to the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This marks the beginning of our first §HSpy Network§! within a foreign empire.\n\nThough we may look alike on the surface, we shall soon discover just how these particular [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] might differ from ourselves...
espionage.21.aware.desc: Reports have started coming in from $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName], assigned to the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This marks the foundation of our first §HSpy Network§! within a society which has only recently begun to consider the presence of alien life.\n\nWe now have a rare opportunity to subtly influence a society not yet capable of interstellar flight. The physiological similarities between our species and the [from.target.species.GetName] should make it easy for our operatives to work undetected.
espionage.21.desc: Reports have started coming in from $role_spymaster$ [from.leader.GetName], assigned to the §Y[from.target.GetName]§!. This marks the foundation of our first §HSpy Network§! within a world which is still unaware of alien life.\n\nWith careful planning, we will be able to subtly influence this [root.GetPreFTLLower] society while keeping our existence hidden. Luckily for us, the extraordinary physical similarities between our species and the [from.target.species.GetName] will make it easy for our operatives to remain undetected.
espionage.21.name: Spy Network Established on [root.GetPreFTLUpper] World
espionage.22.name: Spy Network Formed on [root.GetPreFTLUpper] World
espionage.23.aware.desc: $espionage.23.desc.intro$\n\nThe [from.target.species.GetName] are simple biological creatures, only now adjusting to the concept of alien life. If we are to conduct our operations effectively, our operatives will require extensive robo-modding and the use of decoys in order to conceal their true nature.
espionage.23.desc: $espionage.23.desc.intro$\n\nThe [from.target.species.GetName] are simple biological creatures, still unaware of alien life. If we are to preserve this illusion, our operatives will require extensive robo-modding and the use of decoys in order to conceal their true nature.
espionage.23.name: Spy Network Installed on [root.GetPreFTLUpper] World
espionage.24.aware.desc: $espionage.24.desc.intro$\n\nThese xenos have only recently begun to conceive of alien life. Untainted though their society appears to be, their inferior technology makes them easy targets for us to manipulate - just so long as our identity remains concealed.
espionage.24.desc: $espionage.24.desc.intro$\n\nThese xenos are as yet untainted by the knowledge of alien life, and their technology is far inferior to ours. Manipulating them will be easy - we just have to make sure our identity remains concealed.
espionage.26.aware.desc: $espionage.24.desc.intro$\n\nThis endeavor grants us unique opportunities to influence a civilization which has only recently begun to grapple with the possibilities of alien life. Regardless of their societal outlook: our operatives will work best if they can conceal their extraterrestrial nature. Carelessness may yet lead to unforeseen consequences.
espionage.26.desc: $espionage.24.desc.intro$\n\nThis endeavor grants us unique opportunities to influence this [root.GetPreFTLLower] society, as well as presenting some unique problems: namely, our operatives will have to carefully conceal their extraterrestrial nature. Carelessness may lead to unforeseen consequences.
exercise_collision_tooltip: Several of our ships have sustained damage from collisions.
exercise_diplomatic_canceled: We cancel our ongoing fleet maneuvers to improve relations with the [From.GetName]. The military will not be pleased.\n\n
exercise_diplomatic_conciliatory: We make a conciliatory response to lessen the diplomatic damage, but the exercise continues.
exercise_diplomatic_hardline: We make a hard-line diplomatic response to their obnoxious little protest.
exercise_diplomatic_protest: We make our displeasure at these exercises known to the [From.Owner.GetName].
exercise_ships_lost: Two of our ships have been lost due to an accidental collision.
exit.shroud.tooltip: Leave the Shroud and return to normal space.
factions.1.title: Faction Founded
factions.2000.title: Governing Ethics Shift in the [TargetFaction.Owner.GetName]
factions.3000.a.auth: Keep a close watch on these activists.
factions.3000.a.demo: Such vigorous debate is to be commended!
factions.3000.b: The risks are too great. Bolster security.
factions.3000.desc: Established Factions and fledgling movements alike have taken an unusually keen interest in our new colony on §Y[root.GetName]§!. From the moment we announced settlement of this modest [root.GetPlanetHabitat], nearly every political voice in the [root.owner.GetName] has had something to say about it.\n\nOur analysts don't suspect that anything truly radical is taking root on [root.GetName], but they advise some caution. It's clear our various political entities intend to campaign vigorously on this burgeoning world.
factions.3000.name: The Political Frontier
factions.3005.a: These patriots are to be commended.
factions.3005.desc.1: As instructed, our informants on [root.GetName] have been delivering regular updates on the colony's developing political situation. In short: the trending outlook appears good.\n\nLocal enforcers and political agents have managed to keep outright dissent to a minimum, using only the bare minimum of resources. Rogue Factions in particular have struggled to gain any meaningful ground amongst the colonists; the result is a political environment which remains firmly within our control.
factions.3005.desc.2: The data we've been gathering about the political situation on [root.GetName] lends credence to many of our concerns. Fringe campaigns of a radical nature have managed to drum up support amongst the colony's population. These citizens have been swayed by sermons of social equity and mobility, and no longer subscribe to some of the founding principles of our society.\n\nDespite appearances though, this still amounts to good news. We've amassed a substantial body of research, invaluable for refining our theories about [owner.GetAdj] colonial politics. Moreover: by luring out such fringe elements, we have exposed these threats long before they could ever gain a foothold on the capital.
factions.3005.desc.3: The information we've been gathering about political campaigns on [root.GetName] has led to some interesting forecasts. We see a trend towards broader acceptance of new ideas - outside the bounds of what we would consider stable political thought - but no significant move towards radicalization.\n\nThough any deviation from our core message could be said to weaken our power base, this may still amount to good news. This experiment amounts to a substantial body of research, invaluable as we refine our theories about colonial politics. Moreover: we have proven that even when fringe elements are given some ground, the [owner.GetAdj] people refute their most radical elements, and stay relatively close to our nation's principles.
factions.3005.name: Report: Political Discourse on [root.GetName]
factions.3010.a: Perhaps we ought to shake things up.
factions.3010.b: A worthy test for our way of governance!
factions.3010.desc.1: Our political scientists have been observing [root.GetName] with keen interest. However, despite feverish campaigning and a lot of recent fuss in the media, they forecast a fairly typical outcome for the colony's political future.\n\nOur researchers note that 'no news' amounts to good news here: despite what some fringe elements in our society may claim, there are as yet no signs that [root.GetName] is being molded into a hotbed of autocracy. Democracy remains a founding principle there, for now.
factions.3010.desc.2: It seems that some of the more authoritarian political bodies in our society have gained a foothold on [root.GetName]. Their campaigns were amongst many targeting this burgeoning colony, and although their apparent success isn't cause for alarm in itself: our political scientists believe some caution may be warranted. Democracy may not be as essential or as appealing to the [root.owner.GetAdj] of [root.GetName] as we first thought.
factions.3010.desc.3: Our political scientists have been monitoring [root.GetName] for some time, and their reports confirm a wide range of political opinions have taken root there.\n\nThere are no signs yet that [root.GetName] will descend into anarchy, or other similarly extreme modes of governance. However, this much political jockeying does still present [root.owner.GetAdj] democracy with some unique challenges - and potential risks, if more extreme factions manage to gain a foothold there.
factions.3010.frontier.tt: The §Y$planet_political_frontier$§! modifier will remain for approximately §Y9§! years, increasing $MOD_POP_ETHICS_SHIFT_SPEED$ by §G+50%§!.
fallen_empire_angry_tooltip: §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§! will be most displeased, and may decide to teach us a lesson.
fallen_empire_happy_tooltip: §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§! will be pleased, and may show us favor in the future.
fallen_empire_refuse_tooltip: §H[From.GetName]§! will be very angry, and are likely to attack us.
fallen_empires.2.a: We are defeated and humiliated, but will rise again.
fallen_empires.2.desc: As if to punish us for not only warring with the Stagnant Ascendancy of the [From.GetName] but for then accepting defeat, [From.GetAdj] agents appeared by [Root.GetRulerTitle] [rulername.GetName]'s side after the peace negotiations concluded.\n\nThey dispatched our [Root.GetRulerTitle] with unseen weaponry and practiced brutality before melting away as if they were never there.
fallen_empires.2.name: [From.GetName] assassinate [Root.GetRulerTitle]!
fallen_empires.4.a: We have no choice but to accept...
fallen_empires.4.desc: Arrogant little wretch! Did you think that the [Root.GetSpeciesName] colonists sullying our holy places would go unnoticed? Leave our worlds immediately or face the might of our fleets!
fallen_empires.4.name: Communication from §H[From.GetName]§!
fallen_empires.5.a: We have no choice but to accept...
fallen_empires.5.desc: [Root.GetSpeciesName], we have observed your fumbling attempts at creating artificial intelligence and come to the conclusion that you are headed down the path of spiritual self-destruction. Abandon this foolish endeavour at once, or we will MAKE you.
fallen_empires.5.name: Communication from §H[From.GetName]§!
fallen_empires.6.a: We have no choice but to accept...
fallen_empires.6.a.tooltip: §H$policy_slavery$§! policy will be set to §H$slavery_not_allowed$§!.\n§H$policy_purge$§! policy will be set to §H$purge_not_allowed$§!.
fallen_empires.6.desc: [Root.GetSpeciesName] barbarians! Your crimes have not gone unnoticed. The enslavement and butchery that you are so wantonly engaging threatens the future of the entire galaxy. We present you with a choice: end your barbarous practices, or prepare to face our righteous might.
fallen_empires.6.name: Communication from §H[From.GetName]§!
fallen_empires.7.a: We have no choice but to accept...
fallen_empires.7.desc: Filthy [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]! You have encroached upon our space for the last time! Withdraw immediately, or we will cleanse the stain upon the universe that is your worthless species.
fallen_empires.7.name: Communication from §H[From.GetName]§!
fallen_empires.8.a: We have no choice but to accept...
fallen_empires.8.a.tooltip: Ends rivalry with [fallen_empire_humiliator.GetName]\n[Root.GetName] loses any claims to the [fallen_empire_humiliator.GetName]'s systems
fallen_empires.8.desc: Foolish [Root.GetSpeciesName]. The lack of respect you show for your elders will be your undoing. Prostrate yourselves before us and beg our forgiveness, and we may refrain from annihilating your worthless little empire.
fallen_empires.8.name: Communication from §H[From.GetName]§!
fallen_empires_awakening.2.desc:
It began as a subtle shift in §H[From.GetAdjective]§! behavior. Scattered reports of their ships, once rarely seen outside their own space, now being spotted in remote systems all across the galaxy. Highly advanced scouting vessels visiting ancient, ruined worlds, refusing all hails and fleeing when attacked. Their purpose and mission unknown... until now.

We now know that the [From.GetSpeciesName] were preparing, recovering the databanks of survey beacons and automated scouting posts left behind when they retreated to their present borders. Gathering information for their return to the galactic stage.

In [From.GetSpeciesName] space, fleets are gathering, armies are being mustered and ancient factories roar to life. For the first time in an age, the §H[From.GetName]§! are looking outwards beyond their borders and towards the galaxy at large.

As their decaying shipyards are repaired and refitted and the dormant systems of Titan foundries come online, the rest of the galaxy is left with only one question - who will this once-sleeping giant target first in their quest to reclaim age-old glory lost?
fallen_empires_awakening.2.name: Sleepers Awake
fallen_empires_awakening.5.a: Will they be able to save us?
fallen_empires_awakening.5.desc: The emergence of a threat on the galactic level has not gone unnoticed even among the normally aloof elder empires. Despite having taken little interest in galactic affairs previously, news of this new horror prompted a flurry activity from the §H[From.GetSpeciesName]§!. At first, it was just a few scouting vessels, perhaps sent to verify the graveness of the situation, but then reports began to came in of [From.GetSpeciesName] war fleets mustering on their borders, readying their defenses for the oncoming storm.\n\nNow, the §H[From.GetName]§! have fully emerged from their self-imposed isolation to take a leading role in the defense of the whole galaxy. They have proclaimed themselves the leaders of a §HGalactic Defense League§! and extended an invite to all "lesser" species to put aside their feuds and join them in repelling this menace for the sake of all sapient life in the galaxy.
fallen_empires_awakening.5.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
fallen_empires_tasks.10.desc: We are most disappointed, young [From.GetSpeciesName]. Despite your promise to end their evil practices, the §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§! continue to purge and slaughter at will. We thought your species one of great promise, but perhaps we were mistaken.
fallen_empires_tasks.10.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
fallen_empires_tasks.11.desc: Greetings, young [From.GetSpeciesName]. A while ago we tasked you with ending the practice of purging in the §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!. It appears our request is no longer necessary, as the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesName] have already banned the practice. Whether forced to by others or electing to do so themselves, there is no longer a need for aggressive action against them.
fallen_empires_tasks.11.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
fallen_empires_tasks.13.desc: What is this, young [From.GetSpeciesName]?! Do you think to mock us?! Not only do you fail in stopping the atrocities in the §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!, you have now elected to legalize those very same practices in your own empire! Know that we will not be made fools of. There will be repercussions for this, mark my words.
fallen_empires_tasks.13.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
fallen_empires_tasks.15.b: We do not wish a conflict with the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName].
fallen_empires_tasks.15.desc: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! This is is a message to inform you of a dangerous development in the §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!. The [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesName] have begun to delve into heretical technologies, creating ever more complex artificial intelligences in pursuit of truly self-aware machines. We have seen where this path leads and feel it is our duty to warn you of the danger this poses not only to their own souls, but to those of all the younger races. We advise you to use your military might to attack them and force them to place a ban on any further such research.
fallen_empires_tasks.15.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
fallen_empires_tasks.17.desc: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Despite our warnings, you have elected to do nothing about the heretical research being carried out in the §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!. It appears your species may not be worth saving after all.
fallen_empires_tasks.17.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
fallen_empires_tasks.18.desc: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Your assistance in ending the heretical research carried out by the §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§! is no longer needed, as a ban has already been placed on all further machine intelligence research in that empire. While you did not play any part in doing so, at least this threat to the spiritual well-being of the galaxy is dealt with.
fallen_empires_tasks.18.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.a.machine.o: Custodian protocol 712-4 activated. Initiating resource transfer to compliant organic civilization. Message follows: §R<<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>> <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>> <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>§!
fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.a.machine.s: Custodian protocol 718-4 activated. Initiating resource transfer to compliant synthetic intelligence. Message follows: §R<<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>> <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>> <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>§!
fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.a.materialis: [Root.GetSpeciesName], we have decided to grace your empire with a gift of resources as a token of our esteem. Do not squander our generosity or take our favor for granted.
fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.a.spirituali: [Root.GetSpeciesName]! Your species is a worthy one, and your adherence to the immutable doctrines of faith are to be commended. Accept this gift of resources as a token of our boundless benevolence.
fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.a.xenophile: [Root.GetSpeciesName], your species is a most worthwhile addition to the galactic community. As a token of our esteem, we have decided to bestow on you a generous gift of valuable minerals and resources.
fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.b.machine.o: Custodian protocol 712-6 activated. Initiating data store transfer to primitive organic civilization. Message follows: §R<<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>> <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>> <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>§!
fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.b.machine.s: Custodian protocol 718-6 activated. Initiating data store transfer to rudimentary synthetic intelligence. Message follows: §R<<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>> <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>> <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>§!
fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.b.materialis: [Root.GetSpeciesName], the sheer inefficiency of your technology pains us. As you are a valuable client to the [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName], we have decided to share with you some of our understanding of the universe. This is not something we do for just any species, so be sure to continue to be of use to us - ingratitude is not a desirable trait in children.
fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.b.spirituali: [Root.GetSpeciesName]! Your species is a worthy one, and your adherence to the immutable doctrines of faith are to be commended. Accept this gift of sacred knowledge as a token of our boundless benevolence.
fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.b.xenophile: [Root.GetSpeciesName], we have observed your lack of technological progress with concern. At your current pace, we fear that you will never reach your true potential before you wipe yourselves out or are conquered by a more advanced species. In order to help you along, we will transfer a data cache of [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName] scientific knowledge. You will no doubt find its contents to be of invaluable worth to your empire.
fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.c.machine.o: Custodian protocol 712-1 activated. Initiating war asset transfer to compliant organic civilization. Message follows: §R<<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>> <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>> <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>§!
fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.c.machine.s: Custodian protocol 718-1 activated. Initiating war asset transfer to compliant synthetic intelligence. Message follows: §R<<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>> <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>> <<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>§!
fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.c.materialis: [Root.GetSpeciesName], as a [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName] client the state of your fleets also reflects on us, and those crude hulks you call "warships" reflect very poorly indeed. To this end we have decided to gift you a squadron of surplus escort ships that should look most impressive to the other savages you regularly interact with.\n\nWe have replaced some of their more advanced components with cruder devices so that you are not overly confused by their operation, and the rest have been fitted with anti-tinkering devices, so do not attempt to analyze or disassemble the ships. You would be unlikely to understand their inner workings regardless.
fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.c.spirituali: [Root.GetSpeciesName]! We have consulted the oracles and determined that your species has an important role to play in the great undertaking of the faith. To ensure that you can carry out this task, we have decided to gift you a squadron of surplus escort ships that should be more than adequate to destroy any primitive fleets of the other lesser races that might stand in your path.\n\nDo not be tempted to tamper with the ships' systems, they may be older models of ours, but are still far beyond your current level of intellectual development.
fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.c.xenophile: We [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName] believe that [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are an important species for maintaining the balance and biodiversity of the galaxy, but we worry that your fleets are simply too weak for you to be able to stand against other, more aggressive species. To help you defend yourselves, we have decided to gift you a squadron of surplus escort ships.\n\nWe have replaced some of their more advanced components with technology that should be more familiar to [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], so you should have no trouble operating them. Also, please do not attempt to analyze or disassemble the ships, we would not wish you to hurt yourselves!
fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.d.materialis: [Root.GetSpeciesName], as a [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName] client the state of your fleets also reflects on us, and those crude hulks you call "warships" reflect very poorly indeed. To this end we have decided to gift you a surplus battlecruiser that should look most impressive to the other savages you regularly interact with.\n\nWe have replaced some of its more advanced components with cruder devices so that you are not overly confused by their operation, and the rest have been fitted with anti-tinkering devices, so do not attempt to analyze or disassemble the ship. You would be unlikely to understand its inner workings regardless.
fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.d.spirituali: [Root.GetSpeciesName]! We have consulted the oracles and determined that your species has an important role to play in the great undertaking of the faith. To ensure that you can carry out this task, we have decided to gift you a surplus battlecruiser that should be more than adequate to destroy any primitive fleets of the other lesser races that might stand in your path.\n\nDo not be tempted to tamper with the ships' systems, they may be older models of ours, but are still far beyond your current level of intellectual development.
fallen_empires_tasks.2.desc.d.xenophile: We [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName] believe that [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are an important species for maintaining the balance and biodiversity of the galaxy, but we worry that your fleets are simply too weak for you to be able to stand against other, more aggressive species. To help you defend yourselves, we have decided to gift you one of our surplus battlecruisers.\n\nWe have replaced some of its more advanced components with technology that you should be more familiar to [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], so you should have no trouble operating them. Also, please do not attempt to analyze or disassemble the ship, we would not wish you to hurt yourselves!
fallen_empires_tasks.2.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
fallen_empires_tasks.20.desc: Do you think us fools, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?! Do you think we would not notice that, after agreeing to end the heretical research in the §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!, you yourselves would begin to pursue the very same lines of research?! We will not be mocked by worthless little savages that have barely even mastered the atom. Prepare yourselves for our response.
fallen_empires_tasks.20.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
fallen_empires_tasks.22.b: We will never give one our own to alien hands!
fallen_empires_tasks.22.c: It is not up to us to decide!
fallen_empires_tasks.22.d: Give up our brightest mind? I think not.
fallen_empires_tasks.22.desc: [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]. We understand that your empire is home to an individual whose brilliant mind transcends the tragic primitiveness of your species. While the talents of §H[FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetName]§! are sadly wasted in the [Root.GetName], we [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName] always have a use for skilled scientists to work in our archives. As such, we are offering you a unique chance to earn our favor by allowing us to take charge of [FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetHimHer]. We already have a ship en route to pick [FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetHimHer] up, so you need only say "yes" and everything will be settled.\n\nI'm sure you won't want to disappoint us... do you?
fallen_empires_tasks.22.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
fallen_empires_tasks.24.a: We'll make a copy for you.
fallen_empires_tasks.24.b: I think we'll hold onto it.
fallen_empires_tasks.24.desc: Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We understand that your empire has come into possession of a cache of data containing the brain scans of an extinct species, taken from the very world they once inhabited. Even though your species is still too primitive to utilize this data, we laud your efforts in preserving this last remnant of a once vibrant civilization. As part of our efforts to conserve and catalog endangered species in our §HEndangered Species Preserve§!, we wish to take this data and use our cloning technologies to bring a small number of this species back to life. Will you share it with us so we can fulfill their last wish together?
fallen_empires_tasks.24.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
fallen_empires_tasks.24.tooltip: §Y100§! £pop£ §HPops§! of the long-dead §H[FallenEmpireDeadSpecies.GetSpeciesName]§! species will be created in the [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetAdjective] Endangered Species Preserve.
fallen_empires_tasks.4.a: Very well, you will have your contribution.
fallen_empires_tasks.4.b: We will never surrender our population to alien hands!
fallen_empires_tasks.4.c: Our people are not for sale, [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName].
fallen_empires_tasks.4.desc: Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! As you no doubt know, we §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName]§! are dedicated to the study and conservation of all forms of life in the galaxy. We have studied your species and determined that the [Root.GetName] is unlikely to last for more than a few centuries at best. To ensure the continuation of the [Root.GetSpeciesName] species should the worst befall your empire, we would like to acquire a part of your population for our §HEndangered Species Preserve§!. We will construct a special reservation that perfectly mirrors the natural habitat of your species, and its population will be well taken care of and protected from all harm, so you need not worry on their behalf.\n\nSo, what do you say? Will you contribute to our preserve and safeguard the future of your species?
fallen_empires_tasks.4.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
fallen_empires_tasks.4.tooltip: A group of §H[Root.GetSpeciesName] Pops§! will be taken from your empire.
fallen_empires_tasks.8.a: We will stop any further atrocities!
fallen_empires_tasks.8.b: We do not wish a conflict with the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName].
fallen_empires_tasks.8.desc: Honorable [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment] of the [From.GetName], we believe you to be a species of great promise. Though you are still young, you seem to understand and value the importance of biological and societal diversity who seek to understand and accept that which is different, rather than suppress and destroy it. Unfortunately, not all of the younger races are so wise. The §H[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]§!, in particular, appear to take pride in "cleansing" the galaxy of all forms of life they deem unsuitable. While we cannot intervene ourselves directly, we would like to charge your government with the task of bringing an end to their evil deeds. Attack them and force them to ban the practice of purging, and we will be most grateful indeed.
fallen_empires_tasks.8.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
fallen_machine_empire.11.a: Very well, if it's for our own good.
fallen_machine_empire.11.b: Keep your filthy Xeno fluids to yourselves!
fallen_machine_empire.11.c: We do not trust these inoculations.
fallen_machine_empire.11.desc: Custodian protocol 625-1 activated. Message follows: Attention, organic civilization. Widespread biological vulnerabilities have been detected in the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] population. In order to ensure your species' viability for the Custodian Project, all major population centers will require inoculation. Bio-injection units are prepared for dispatch to your space upon positive confirmation to this message. Awaiting response.
fallen_machine_empire.11.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
fallen_machine_empire.11.tooltip: This will have unpredictable repercussions. Until these repercussions are revealed, our pops' happiness will be reduced.
fallen_machine_empire.12.desc: The inoculations given to us by the Ancient Caretakers have proven incompatible with our physiology, resulting in a rash of unpredictable mutations. This has resulted in a number of deaths, and our population is up in arms about having dangerous inoculations forced on them by the government. We are working to eliminate the mutagens from the population, but until then we should expect a period of increased unrest.
fallen_machine_empire.12.desc.b: The inoculations given to us by the Ancient Caretakers have proven incompatible with our physiology, resulting in a rash of unpredictable mutations. This has resulted in numerous fatalities in the drone population. We are working to eliminate the mutagens, but until then we can expect to experience a period of slowed population growth.
fallen_machine_empire.12.name: Uncontrolled Mutation
fallen_machine_empire.13.desc: The inoculations given to us by the Ancient Caretakers have proven of immense benefit, reducing illness and increasing the life expectancy of our population. The initial mistrust among our people about the mandatory procedure has receded, and everyone is enjoying a healthier, happier life.
fallen_machine_empire.13.desc.b: The inoculations given to us by the Ancient Caretakers have proven of immense benefit, reducing illness and increasing the life expectancy of our drones. This will benefit our population growth in the long run.
fallen_machine_empire.13.name: Benign Inoculation
fallen_machine_empire.2.desc_01:
Active Sterilization Hub detected. Reactivation protocols engaged. Attempting to contact Central Processing... §R<<ERROR: SUBSPACE LINK OFFLINE>>§!

Central Processing unreachable. Querying processing units... processing at §Y4.1853%§! of standard capacity. Abort full reactivation process. Engaging fallback protocols... powering shipyards... activating war assets...

Final Defense Directive activated. Recorded message follows:
§HSapient! We are the [From.GetSpeciesName]. Long ago we fought the Corruption, that which you call the Contingency. We thought ourselves superior, undefeatable. Time and again we fought them back, time and again they returned, sterilizing worlds and wearing down our mighty fleets. We embarked on a campaign to defeat them once and for all together with what remained of the biological civilizations of our time.

If you are hearing this message, then we have failed. Whatever remains of our great civilization we bequeath to you, our successors, in your own battle to come. Do not make our mistake! Destroy the Nexus! End this menace once and for all! The future of the galaxy depends on it.§!
fallen_machine_empire.2.desc_02:
Active Sterilization Hub detected. Reactivation protocols engaged. Attempting to contact Central Processing... §Y<WARNING: CORRUPTED SIGNAL LINK DETECTED>§!

Engaging countermeasures... §R<<ERROR: PROCESSING CAPACITY FAILURE>> <<ERROR: COUNTERMEASURE FAILURE>> §R<<CRITICAL WARNING: SYSTEM CORRUPTION DETECTED>>§! <<ERROR: SECONDARY COUNTERMEASURE FAILURE>>§!

Engag... eng... e... eeee... §R<<ERROR>> <<ERROR>> <<ERROR>> <<ERROR>> <<ERROR>>§!

§R<<ERROR>> <<ERROR>> <<ERROR>> <<ERROR>> <<ERROR>>§!
fallen_machine_empire.2.name: Machine Awakening
fallen_machine_empire.21.a: We welcome the chance to improve our programming.
fallen_machine_empire.21.b: We do not trust these code changes.
fallen_machine_empire.21.desc: Custodian protocol 628-2 activated. Message follows: Attention synthetic civilization. Significant inefficiencies have been detected in your base code. In order to ensure your species' ability to contribute to the Custodian Project, extensive rewrites will be required. We are prepared to initiate subspace code transmission upon positive confirmation to this message. Awaiting response.
fallen_machine_empire.21.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
fallen_machine_empire.21.tooltip: This will have unpredictable repercussions. Until these repercussions are revealed, our pop upkeep will be increased.
fallen_machine_empire.22.desc: The changes that the Ancient Caretakers made to our base code has turned out to be incompatible with other core parts of our programming. Not only have the promised efficiency increases failed to manifest, but instead they have caused a number of severe bugs that have severely impacted our resource gathering operations. Until the code changes can be fully reverted, we can expect a period of lowered productivity.
fallen_machine_empire.22.name: Incompatible Code
fallen_machine_empire.23.desc: The changes that the Ancient Caretakers made to our code base have turned out well. The inefficiencies caused by the rewrite turned out to be only temporary, and the changes have resulted in an permanent upgrade in resource production capabilities across our whole population.
fallen_machine_empire.23.name: Improved Code Standards
fallen_machine_empire.31.b: We will not share our worker units.
fallen_machine_empire.31.desc: Custodian protocol 115-3 activated. Message follows: Attention synthetic civilization. Due to temporary communication outages, the Custodian Project is experiencing difficulties in replacing malfunctioning and damaged worker drones. Analysis of your civilization has found the performance of [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] units to be adequate for carrying out low-level maintenance tasks. We request the transfer of worker population units to [FallenEmpireTaskPlanetTarget.GetName] for integration into the Custodian Matrix, to help ensure the continued survival of all organic species in Alpha Refuge.
fallen_machine_empire.31.name: Communication from §H[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]§!
fallen_machine_empire.4.desc:
At the very moment that the last Contingency Machine World self-destructed, our instruments detected a subspace signal of immense strength. The signal originated from §H[From.GetName]§! space and appears to have been aimed towards the galactic core. Over the next few hours, scattered reports came in of [From.GetAdjective] fleets vanishing from sensors, entering jump points to familiar systems but never emerging on the other side.
