After finding the Toxic Entity, our knights lost the trail of the Toxic God. The connection between the two is unquestionable, but if the archives are to be believed, the entity pales compared to the original, which was immensely more formidable and sentient.

Today, however, our search for the Toxic God finally ends. We have picked up trace amounts of noxious substances expelled from the supermassive black hole at the galactic core. As impossible as it seems, we believe the Toxic God is in there. And very much beyond our reach.

The Lord Commander has ordered all knights to recover anything even remotely related to the black hole, but there is little hope of success...
toxoids.8020.name: The Fate of the Toxic God
toxoids.8025.desc: We have recovered the habitat housing the Order's Keep. Our fortifications and demesne lie in ruins, dismantled by the occupiers, but they can be rebuilt. With access to the archives restored, our knight's quests can resume.
toxoids.8025.name: Reconquering the Order's Keep
tree_armies: Hordes of trees are attacking our colonists on [Root.GetName]!
true_prophet_tt: A skilled Official agrees to join our empire.
tt_end_the_suffering: Ending the plague now will reveal our presence and require a significant investment of resources.
tutorial.1.desc:
The §HGalaxy Map§! offers a strategic view of the stars. Use it to navigate, expand, command fleets, and monitor borders.

To open the §SGalaxy Map§!;

£dot_green£ Click the §HGalaxy§! icon at the bottom of the screen or press §HM§!


$tttt$$tt$£galaxy_view£
tutorial.1.name: Tutorial: Galaxy Map
tutorial.10.desc: Very good. The new £mining_station£ §SMining Station§! is operational, and it has already begun gathering resources for processing.\n\nIncome from various stations is added to the empire's total income, which is displayed on the top bar. Hovering over different resources reveals a breakdown of income sources.
tutorial.10.name: Tutorial: Mining Station Income
tutorial.100.name: Tutorial Disabled
tutorial.101.name: Tips Only
tutorial.102.name: Full Tutorial
tutorial.11.desc: Surveyed worlds sometimes possess unique properties that make them valuable objects of research. These £physics£ §SPhysics§!, £society£ §SSociety§! or £engineering£ §SEngineering§! resources can be collected by a £science_ship£ §SResearch Station§!. My programming strongly compels me to compel you to build one.\n\nKeep in mind that §SResearch Stations§! can only be built within our borders, and have a upkeep cost in £energy£ §SEnergy Credits§!.
tutorial.11.name: Tutorial: Research Station
tutorial.12.desc: Our new £science_ship£ §SResearch Station§! is online, and its science staff have begun their work. What secrets will they uncover, what forbidden mysteries of Creation?!
tutorial.12.name: Tutorial: Research Station Built
tutorial.13.desc:
Habitable £planet£ §SPlanets§! are divided into £district£ §SDistricts§!, §SZones§!, and £building£ §SBuildings§!.

£dot_green£§SDistricts§! can consist of multiple §SZones§!
£dot_green£§SZones§! determine which £job£ §SJobs§! are created
£dot_green£§SBuildings§! grant bonuses to the §SZones§!

More §SBuilding§! slots are unlocked as the zones are upgraded.

There are two ways of viewing a planet;
From the §SGalaxy Map§! or the §SOutliner§!.

£dot_green£ Select a §SPlanet§!
£dot_green£ Click on the different tabs
tutorial.13.name: Tutorial: Planets
tutorial.1337.desc:
We have discovered some £minor_artifacts£ §SMinor Artifacts§!. These are an esoteric resource - a catch-all term for strange items which we do not understand and indeed may be inexplicable.

These can be used to enact a variety of decisions.

To interact with §SMinor Artifacts§!;

£dot_green£ Click the §S$topbar_button_discoveries_name$§! button on the left side bar
£dot_green£ Select the §SCollection§! tab or press §SC§!

$tttt$$tt$£discoveries£
tutorial.1337.name: Tutorial: Minor Artifacts
tutorial.14.desc:
Excellent. Construction has been finished on our new §SPlanetary Building§!, and it should now begin producing resources.

£pops£ §SPops§! will automatically be assigned to any £job£ §SJobs§! created by £building£ §SBuildings§! as the population grows, but can also be encouraged to switch jobs.

To prioritize a §SBuilding§!;

£dot_green£ Select the £planet£ §SPlanet§! in the §SOutliner§!
£dot_green£ Click the §SEconomy§! tab
£dot_green£ Click on a §SBuilding§!
tutorial.14.name: Tutorial: Prioritize Building
tutorial.15.desc:
Habitable £planet£ §SPlanets§! sometimes have £blocker£ §SBlockers§!, preventing their full exploitation. Clearing a §SBlocker§! takes time and costs £energy£ §SEnergy Credits§!, but can unlock §SPlanetary Features§! currently blocked as well as free up additional construction space.

To clear a §SBlocker§!;

£dot_green£ Select a planet in the §SOutliner§!
£dot_green£ Click the §SManagement§! tab
£dot_green£ Click the §SClear Blocker§! button on the blocker itself


$tttt$$tt$£clear_blocker£


In addition to resources, some §SBlockers§! require specific §STechnologies§! to remove.
tutorial.15.name: Tutorial: Planetary Blockers
tutorial.16.desc:
Well done!

The £blocker£ §SBlocker§! has been successfully removed.

You can hover over any remaining §SBlockers§! to see which §SPlanetary Feature§! will be unlocked once they are cleared.

Any remaining §SBlockers§! should be cleared once enough resources have been gathered, to allow this £planet£ §SPlanet§! to reach its full potential.
tutorial.16.name: Tutorial: Blocker Cleared
tutorial.17.desc: We should continue our exploration efforts. I recommend sending a £science_ship£ §SScience Ship§! to survey neighboring £system£ §SStar Systems§!. Let us boldly go where no synthetic intelligence has gone before!
tutorial.17.name: Tutorial: Survey Systems
tutorial.19.desc:
Great work! The stars neighboring our £system£ §SHome System§! have been fully explored. We should use our £construction_ship£ §SConstruction Ship§! to collect any resources that were found by [GetBuildingGrowing] £mining_station£ §SMining§! and £science_ship£ §SResearch Stations§!.

You can identify a §SConstruction Ship§! by the following symbol:

$tttt$$tt$£construction_ship_map£
tutorial.19.name: Tutorial: Systems Surveyed
tutorial.2.desc:
Well done!

The first survey of a £system£ §SStar System§! beyond our own has been completed.

We now have access to planetary data that the astronomers on our homeworld could only dream of a mere generation ago.

To continue surveying;

£dot_green£ Select a £science_ship£ §SScience Ship§!
£dot_green£ Right-click a neighboring §SSystem§!
£dot_green£ Select §SSurvey System§!

A §SSystem§! must be surveyed before it can be claimed.
tutorial.2.name: Tutorial: System Surveyed
tutorial.20.desc:
We may want to consider [GetBuildingGrowing] a second £science_ship£ §SScience Ship§!. This would double the speed at which we can survey our galactic neighborhood!

To [GetBuildGrow] a §SShip§!;

£dot_green£ Select a §SStarbase§!
£dot_green£ Click on the §SShipyard§! tab
£dot_green£ Click on §SScience Ship§!

The newly constructed §SShip§! will appear next to the §SStarbase§! once completed.
tutorial.20.name: Tutorial: [GetBuildGrowCap] Science Ship
tutorial.2000.desc: Some §SFirst Contact§! missions will present options for how we wish to conduct matters. These choices can affect our diplomatic relationships with other empires for a long time.
tutorial.2000.name: Conducting First Contact
tutorial.2006.desc:
Communications protocols have been established. We can now engage in §SDiplomacy§! with this Empire. Their current opinion of us depends on how §SFirst Contact§! was conducted.

To engage in §SDiplomacy§!;

£dot_green£Click the §SContacts§! button on the left side bar or press §SF10§!

$tttt$$tt$£contacts£

During first contact, we also gain Intel. As we gain further Intel on an empire, more details about them become visible to us.
tutorial.2006.name: Tutorial: Diplomacy
tutorial.2007.desc: We have made §SFirst Contact§! with a different type of civilization - one which is generally unwilling to engage in §SDiplomacy§! with others.\n\nThe diplomatic actions we can take with civilizations like this are limited, however they may decide to contact us from time to time.
tutorial.2007.name: $tutorial.2006.name$
tutorial.2010.desc: §SAssets§! are valuable agents and artifacts which provide different effects for our Espionage activities. They work within the Spy Network and may be assigned to Operations, where they can open up new opportunities or else help us out of trouble.\n\nWe may receive Assets through events, or by performing the §S$operation_acquire_asset$§! Operation.
tutorial.2010.name: Tutorial: Assigning Assets
tutorial.21.desc:
Double the £science_ship£ §SScience Ships§! means double the fun! Oh, I haven't been this excited since we completed the last assignment!

Exploring with multiple ships can be time-consuming.

You can automate surveying by selecting the §SScience Ship§! and clicking the §SScience Ship Automation§! button in the fleet interface.


$tttt$$tt$£science_ship_automate_exploration£
tutorial.21.name: Tutorial: Survey Automation
tutorial.2100.abbr.desc: We have made §SFirst Contact§! with an §SEnclave§!. This is a smaller, independent type of empire which may trade with larger empires like ours, using unique forms of Diplomacy.
tutorial.2100.full.desc: $tutorial.2100.abbr.desc$\n\nEnclaves offer a wide variety of services: from conducting scientific research to selling information, starbase buildings, and even §SShips§!. Purchasing services like these will increase that enclave's §SOpinion§! of us.
tutorial.2100.name: Tutorial: Enclave Diplomacy
tutorial.2105.abbr.desc: We have encountered a §SMercenary Enclave§!. These independent military specialists may loan out §SMercenary Fleets§! to empires including our own - for a fee.
tutorial.2105.full.desc: $tutorial.2105.abbr.desc$\n\nIf we choose to hire a Mercenary Fleet, we will retain control of it for a set period of time. During that time, the Enclave will attempt to reinforce the fleet when necessary, however neither a Mercenary Fleet nor its Admiral may be integrated with our own fleets.
tutorial.2105.name: Tutorial: $tutorial.2100.name$
tutorial.2111.abbr.desc: §Y[tutorial_mercenary_fleet.GetName]§! is now capable of becoming a §SMercenary Enclave§!, if we so wish. The fleet would cease to be under our direct control - instead it would become an independent force, capable of loaning out §SMercenary Fleets§! to empires including our own.
tutorial.2111.full.desc: $tutorial.2111.abbr.desc$\n\nFor as long as we share space with the Mercenary Enclave, we stand to earn §Sincome§! whenever it loans its Mercenary Fleet out to other empires. If we choose to hire the Mercenary Fleet ourselves, we will retain control of that fleet for a set period of time. Empires may pay extra to buy out an existing contract if the Mercenary Fleet is not currently available.
tutorial.2111.name: Tutorial: Mercenary Enclave
tutorial.2115.desc: £megastructure£ §SMegastructures§! are colossal projects that we can [GetBuildGrow] out in the void of space. They may provide us with cutting-edge research facilities, access to superior resources, or even some unique forms of transportation.\n\nBuilding on such a scale requires a significant investment of time and resources, but the rewards are every bit as sizable. We can get under way by setting a £construction_ship£ §SConstruction Ship§! to this task.
tutorial.2115.name: Tutorial: Megastructures
tutorial.2120.desc: Thanks to our recent advances in mega-engineering research, we are now able to construct §SOrbital Rings§! around habitable £planet£ §SPlanets§!. We can begin building by issuing orders to a £construction_ship£ §SConstruction Ship§!.
tutorial.2120.name: Tutorial: $tech_orbital_ring_tier_1$
tutorial.2125.desc: Recent advances in mega-engineering research mean we may now construct a §SQuantum Catapult§! around a §Spulsar§! or §Sneutron star§!. We can begin building by issuing orders to a £construction_ship£ §SConstruction Ship§!.
tutorial.2125.name: Tutorial: $tech_quantum_catapult$
tutorial.2126.desc: The §SQuantum Catapult§! launches §SShips§! and fleets across vast, interstellar distances. This technology greatly improves our ability to react to emerging situations within our empire, and in nearby regions of space.\n\nUse of the Quantum Catapult carries some risk, as our fleets may arrive in £system£ §SSystems§! other than their intended target. We can mitigate these risks - and improve matters like throughput and maximum range - by upgrading the Quantum Catapult to higher tiers.
tutorial.2126.name: Tutorial: $tutorial.2125.name$
tutorial.2130.desc: Our mega-engineering research has yielded results in the form of §SHyper Relays§!. We can begin forming a network of these by issuing orders to a £construction_ship£ §SConstruction Ship§!.
tutorial.2130.name: Tutorial: $tech_hyper_relays$
tutorial.2131.desc: §SHyper Relays§! allow for more efficient travel between adjacent £system£ §SStar Systems§!. By linking §Sat least two§! Hyper Relays together, we can begin to establish a network which will dramatically reduce transit times across our empire.\n\nHyper Relays may also be built adjacent to each other across open borders, linking whole networks together. This will allow §SShips§! to travel swiftly across neighboring empires.
tutorial.2131.name: Tutorial: $tutorial.2130.name$
tutorial.2140.desc:
We have detected a §SPre-FTL society§!! Although they lack the kind of technology that allows us to traverse the stars, there is still a lot to be gained from these aliens. Whether it be learning from their culture or claiming them as slaves is up to us.

If we wish to observe them - assuming they are within our borders - we need to build an §SObservation Post§! around their world.

If we wish to invade, all we need do is muster our troops; they wouldn't stand much of a chance.
tutorial.2140.name: Tutorial: Observation Posts
tutorial.2145.desc.dlc:
Our new §SObservation Post§! has come online and will proceed with its §SMission§! as long as the £awareness£ §SAwareness§! of the object of our study stays low.

We will gain §SObservation Insights§!, a unique line of technology, from this outpost until the Pre-FTL society reaches max awareness when missions will be disabled. Instead, we will be able to engage them with §SDiplomatic Actions§!.

We could choose to reveal ourselves early if our §SInterference Policies§! allow it.
tutorial.2145.desc.nodlc: Our new §SObservation Post§! has come online and will proceed with its §SMission§! as long as the £awareness£ §SAwareness§! of the object of our study stays low.\n\nOnce a Pre-FTL society reaches maximum awareness, they will no longer be observable. Instead, we will be able to engage them with §SDiplomatic Actions§!. We may choose to reveal ourselves early if our §SInterference Policies§! allow it.
tutorial.2145.name: Tutorial: Observation Post Built
tutorial.2150.desc: The pre-FTL civilization knows of our existence. We can now engage in limited §SDiplomacy§! with the §SPlanet's§! leadership, depending on our §SPolicy§! stance.\n\nWith our presence made public to the planet, there is no longer anything to gain from observing the civilization. Our §SObservation Missions§! have been disabled.
tutorial.2150.name: Tutorial: $tutorial.2006.name$
tutorial.22.desc:
We have a brand new £science_ship£ §SScience Ship§!, but no £scientist£ §SScientist§! has been assigned to command it. My programming insists that I should point out the benefits of adding an organic §SScientist§! component to the mix.

With the §SScience Ship§! selected;

£dot_green£ Click the empty portrait in the fleet interface
£dot_green£ Choose a §SScientist§!

If we cannot afford to recruit a new §SScientist§! we can always reassign one from another department, even though it is hardly ideal.
tutorial.22.name: Tutorial: Recruit Scientist
tutorial.23.desc: Good. The £scientist£ §SScientist§! has assumed command of our new £science_ship£ §SScience Ship§!, and can now be sent off at our leisure to explore new £system£ §SSystems§! and/or meet some grisly fate.\n\nShould you wish to change the §SScientist§!, then simply select the portrait once more in the fleet interface.
tutorial.23.name: Tutorial: Scientist Recruited
tutorial.24.desc:
We should now be ready to extend our great civilization to a second world. This will require the construction of a £colony_ship£ §SColony Ship§!.

To [GetBuildGrow] a §SShip§!;

£dot_green£ Select a §SStarbase§!
£dot_green£ Click on the §SShipyard§! tab
£dot_green£ Click on §SColony Ship§!

The newly constructed §SShip§! will appear next to the §SStarbase§! once completed.
tutorial.24.name: Tutorial: [GetBuildGrowCap] Colony Ship
tutorial.25.desc:
The colonists have all been transferred to the new £colony_ship£ §SColony Ship§!, and her captain reports all systems go. A momentous day, for sure!

There are different ways to establish a £colony£ §SColony§!.

To §SColonize§! a £planet£ §SPlanet§! on the §SGalaxy Map§!;

£dot_green£ Click a colonizable §SPlanet§!
£dot_green£ Click on the §SColonize§! button

$tttt$$ttt$£colonizable£

Once the colonists have disembarked, they will take a few years to fully establish the colony.
tutorial.25.name: Tutorial: Colonize Planet
tutorial.2500.desc:
Recent advances in Field Manipulation research have led to the invention of §S$science_cloaking_components$§!. These power-intensive components project modified particle fields allowing our science and military vessels to hide from conventional sensors.

However, these cloaking fields will negatively affect §S$MOD_SHIP_BASE_SPEED_MULT$§!, §S$MOD_SHIP_WINDUP_MULT$§! and §S$MOD_SHIP_SHIELD_HP_ADD$§! while active.

§SCloaked§! ships that remain undetected can ignore §SClosed Borders§!.
While §SCloaked§!, our £science_ship£ §SScience Ships§! will be capable of conducting §SActive Reconnaissance§! on foreign £colony£ §SColonies§!, increasing the Intel we gain on other empires.
tutorial.2500.name: Tutorial: Cloaking Fields
tutorial.2550.desc:
Recent advances in Computing research have led to the invention of §S$sm_detection_array_plural$§!. Installing these high-powered external sensors on our §SStarbases§! will grant the ability to detect §SCloaked§! fleets.

The sensitivity of the §S$sm_detection_array_plural$§! can be increased by coupling multiple arrays together, allowing them to penetrate increasingly stable §SCloaking Fields§!.

With further research, we should be able to use £science_ship£ §SScience Ships§! to further increase boost these detection capabilities. The range of these devices is limited by the starbase's §SSensor Range§!.
tutorial.2550.name: Tutorial: Cloaking Detection
tutorial.26.desc: We have a £colony_ship£ §SColony Ship§!, and we have found at least one suitable candidate for a permanent extrasolar outpost. I see no reason to delay further - let's establish our first £colony£ §SColony§!!
tutorial.26.name: Tutorial: Establish Colony
tutorial.27.desc: Our first extrasolar £colony£ §SColony§!! This means that if our homeworld were to spontaneously combust, your species would no longer be rendered extinct. That is a comforting thought, wouldn't you say?
tutorial.27.name: Tutorial: Colony Established
tutorial.3.desc: Researching new technologies will be critical to our success. I tell you this not merely as a product of unfettered technological progress, but as your trusted advisor and, I suspect, your only true friend.\n\nOne important technology that we should research as soon as possible is §SNew Worlds Protocol§!. It will give us access to £colony_ship£ §SColony Ships§! which will allow us to establish footholds on other £planet£ §SPlanets§!.
tutorial.3.name: Tutorial: Technologies
tutorial.33.desc:
A healthy supply of £minerals£ §SMinerals§!, £alloys£ §SAlloys§! and £energy£ §SEnergy Credits§! is critical to the well-being of any interstellar power. We should take steps to increase our production of these resources.

Stations and £building£ §SBuildings§! cost Alloys or Minerals to build and Energy Credits to maintain. The same is true for §SShips§!, except that they have an Alloy upkeep cost as well. These resources are produced by £mining_station£ §SMining Stations§! or §SPlanetary Buildings§!. 

Later you may discover new and interesting resources to spend on esoteric new production.
tutorial.33.name: Tutorial: Resource Production
tutorial.38.desc: Excellent work. We now have a strong resource base to build our empire on.
tutorial.38.name: Resource Production Obtained
tutorial.39.desc: I can't help but notice that our navy is a bit on the weak side. We are certain to face many threats in the galaxy that will require some form of military response. Remember, the survival of our civilization is at stake!
tutorial.39.name: Tutorial: Increase the Fleet
tutorial.43.desc: Good! We now have a small but capable space fleet that should serve us well in the event of any unexpected hostile encounters.
tutorial.43.name: Navy Size Increased
tutorial.44.desc: Our burgeoning empire has now reached a size where it is becoming difficult to administer directly from our homeworld. We should establish a new §SSector§!.\n\nSectors are areas within our empire that can be set to independently manage the day-to-day affairs of the £planet£ §SPlanets§! under their jurisdiction.
tutorial.44.name: Tutorial: Establish Sector
tutorial.45.desc: As our empire grows, new £colony£ §SColonies§! can be organized into §SSectors§!. Sectors can be automated from the §SPlanets and Sectors§! screen to automatically build and upgrade £district£ §SDistricts§! and £building£ §SBuildings§! using assigned pools of resources.
tutorial.45.name: Tutorial: Sector Established
tutorial.46.desc: §SGovernors§! can be assigned to administrate entire §SSectors§!. All £planet£ §SPlanets§! within the sector will then benefit from the Governor's skills. We should assign one to our new sector.
tutorial.46.name: Tutorial: Sector Governor
tutorial.47.desc: Our new §SSector Governor§! has assumed office on the sector's capital world. Well done.
tutorial.47.name: Tutorial: Governor Assigned
tutorial.48.desc:
We have the ability to manually design new §SShips§! in the §SShip Designer§! screen. This is a fairly straight-forward process, though one that can be fully automated if we so wish.

To access the §SShip Designer§!;

£dot_green£Click the §SFleet Management§! button on the left side bar or press §SF9§!

$tttt$$tt$£fleet_management£
tutorial.48.name: Tutorial: Ship Design
tutorial.49.desc:
Good job. The ship design has been added to our database, and can now be produced by a §SStarbase§! that has been equipped with a §SShipyard§!.

The new design can be edited at any time by revisiting the §SShip Designer§!. If any changes are made to the design, then §SShips§! already built will need to be upgraded at a §SStarbase§!.

To upgrade a §SShip§!;

£dot_green£ Select the §SShip§! in the §SOutliner§!
£dot_green£ Click the §SUpgrade§! button in the fleet interface

$tttt$$tt$£upgrade_ship£
tutorial.49.name: Tutorial: Upgrade Ship
tutorial.53.xenophobe.a: We must beware the xeno threat.
tutorial.54.desc: We found one of our §Yold probes§! on [From.GetName]. It has somehow kept intact all these years and is still trying to send data to our homeworld. It stands as a testament to our past struggles, and our wish to flee our §SPlanet's§! bounds.\n\n$tutorial.52.filler.desc$
tutorial.54.materialist.a: Our efforts have finally paid off.
tutorial.54.spiritualist.a: The divine surely has more in store.
tutorial.55.desc:
We have uncovered a §SStrategic Resource§!! Many £strategic_resource£ §SStrategic Resources§! require specific technologies to exploit, but can confer powerful bonuses.

To secure a §SStrategic Resource§!;

£dot_green£ Select a £construction_ship£ §SConstruction Ship§!
£dot_green£ Right-click the £system£ §SSystem§! containing the resource
£dot_green£ Select §S[GetBuildGrowCap] £mining_station£ Mining Stations§!

§SStrategic Resources§! can be used to build advanced £building£ §SBuildings§! and Ship components or simply sold.
tutorial.55.name: Tutorial: Strategic Resources
tutorial.56.desc: Excellent work. This resource is sure to greatly enrich our nation.
tutorial.56.name: Tutorial: Resource Extracted
tutorial.560.desc: Using recently-developed technology, an already-extant £mining_station£ §SMining Station§! can now mine a §SStrategic Resource§!. These rare resources confer powerful bonuses and make for valuable trade goods. Two metaphorical avians, allegorically struck down by an imaginary projectile.\n\nMore information can be found in the §SSituation Log§! for a time. There are many more £strategic_resource£ §SStrategic Resources§! left to discover in the galaxy, so keep on researching!
tutorial.57.desc.notech: We have discovered highly-evolved animal life! With the right §STechnology§!, we may eventually be able to §SUplift§! these beings to sapience and intelligence - or what passes for intelligence among organics.\n\nIt would perhaps be wise to keep an eye on our research, and direct it towards §SEpigenetic Triggers§! if given the opportunity.
tutorial.57.desc.yestech:
We have discovered highly-evolved animal life! With the right §STechnology§!, we may eventually be able to §HUplift§! these beings to sapience and intelligence - or what passes for intelligence among organics.

Oh.

The §SEpigenetic Triggers§! technology should fit the bill, and we are in fact ready to elevate these creatures into a brave new world of existential angst.
tutorial.57.name: Tutorial: Uplift
tutorial.58.desc: A rousing success! The lowly beasts have been uplifted to become less lowly beasts, and are now proud citizens of our burgeoning empire.
tutorial.58.name: Tutorial: Pre-Sapients Uplifted
tutorial.59.desc:
Remarkable! We have discovered §Sspacefaring alien entities§! that may or may not be intelligent, but, let's face it, probably are. Their true nature will remain a mystery to us until we complete the appropriate project to §SInvestigate§! them. I suggest we do so post-haste, lest they investigate us first...

To investigate a §SFirst Contact§!;

£dot_green£ Open the §SSituation Log§!
£dot_green£ Click on §S$SHOW_FIRST_CONTACT$§!

$tttt$$ttt$£firstcontact£

§SFirst Contact§! can also be initiated by clicking the icon on the §SGalaxy map§!
tutorial.59.name: Tutorial: First Contact
tutorial.6.desc: Excellent work! The technology we just finished researching will certainly benefit us. Don't forget to give our £scientist£ §SScientists§! new research assignments.
tutorial.6.name: Tutorial: Technology Researched
tutorial.61.desc: Our attempts to establish communications stand testament to our technological ingenuity, but results are lacking. It is likely that the other party possesses only an animal level of intelligence, §Sif any at all§!.\n\n§SPre-Sapients§! offer little to no diplomatic interactions, but depending on your empire type, they can sometimes be uplifted, exterminated, enslaved, or observed.
tutorial.61.name: Tutorial: Pre-Sapient Species
tutorial.63.desc: It appears the §Sother party§! completely stole our thunder, §Sestablishing contact§! with us before we had managed to decipher their communications protocols.\n\nWe should still attempt to accomplish this feat for ourselves, when the opportunity next presents itself.
tutorial.63.name: Tutorial: Incoming Transmission
tutorial.64.desc:
Thanks to recent advances in genetics, we have gained an extra §STrait Point§! that we can use to §SModify§! and enhance our people.

To modify a §SSpecies§!;

£dot_green£ Select the §SSpecies§! tab or press §SF6§!
£dot_green£ Click on the §SModify§! button
£dot_green£ Research §SSpecial Project§!
tutorial.64.name: Tutorial: Modify Species
tutorial.65.desc: Commendable. With the yoke of natural evolution lifted from their shoulders, our people are sure to thrive in space.
tutorial.65.name: Tutorial: Species Modified
tutorial.7.desc: The resources generated by our homeworld will only take us so far. Our industry needs to expand off-world, and that requires a £construction_ship£ §SConstruction Ship§!.\n\nWe should [GetBuildGrow] one as soon as we have amassed enough £alloys£ §SAlloys§! to do so.
tutorial.7.name: Tutorial: Construction Ship
tutorial.71.desc:
To overcome the vast distances that separate £system£ §SStar Systems§!, our £scientist£ §SScientists§! have developed the §SHyper Drive§!. This device permits travel at speeds far exceeding that of light between systems connected by hyperlanes.

Travel along a hyperlane is nearly instantaneous, but movement is restricted to the galactic hyperlane network. 

To enter hyperspace, a §SShip§! must first reach the system's edge, beyond the star's gravity well.

This happens automatically when ordering a §SShip§! to move to another §SSystem§!.
tutorial.71.name: Tutorial: Hyperspace Travel
tutorial.73.desc:
Having researched the appropriate technology, we now have the means to §YUplift§! lesser beings to sapience.

To uplift a §SSpecies§!;

£dot_green£ Open the §SPre-Sapient§! £planet£ §SPlanet§!
£dot_green£ Click the §SManagement§! tab
£dot_green£ Select the §SSpecies§!
£dot_green£ Click on §SSet Rights§!
£dot_green£ Click on §SUplift§!

The species will begin the uplift process, gaining full sapience once completed.
tutorial.73.name: Tutorial Reminder: Uplift
tutorial.75.desc:
Now that we have begun exploring our neighboring stars, it might be time to extend our reach.

A §SStarbase§! can be built around stars in surveyed £system£ §SSystems§! to expand our borders, allowing us to claim new regions of space

With future technologies, Starbases can be upgraded to produce §SShips§! or other resources.

To claim a §SSystem§!;

£dot_green£ Select a £construction_ship£ §SConstruction Ship§!
£dot_green£ Right-click a surveyed §SSystem§!
£dot_green£ Select §S[GetBuildGrowCap] Starbase§!
tutorial.75.name: Tutorial: Claim System
tutorial.76.desc:
Excellent. As you can see on the §SGalaxy Map§!, the borders of our empire have expanded to include the £system£ §SSystem§! where we built our new §SStarbase§!.

A newly built §SStarbase§! acts as an Outpost, with limited defensive capabilities and no room for §SModules§! and £building£ §SBuildings§!. As such, it does not yet appear in the outliner until it has been upgraded.

To upgrade a §SStarbase§!;

£dot_green£ Click the system on the §SGalaxy Map§!
£dot_green£ Select the §SStarbase§!
£dot_green£ Click on the §SUpgrade§! button
tutorial.76.name: Tutorial: Starbase Upgrade
tutorial.8.desc: Good job! Our £construction_ship£ §SConstruction Ship§! is now up and running, and its hardy crew includes some of the finest engineers available to our nation.
tutorial.8.name: Tutorial: Construction Ship Built
tutorial.9.desc:
The resources generated by our homeworld will only take us so far. Luckily our £science_ship£ §SScience Ship§! has just found a resource deposit on another world!

The time has come to use our £construction_ship£ §SConstruction Ship§! to [GetBuildGrow] a £mining_station£ §SMining Station§!.

§SMining Stations§! can be built within our borders and automatically collect £minerals£ §SMinerals§!, £energy£ §SEnergy Credits§!, and £strategic_resource£ §SStrategic Resources§!.

With the §SConstruction Ship§! selected;

£dot_green£ Right-click a claimed £system£ §SSystem§!
£dot_green£ Select §S[GetBuildGrowCap] Mining Stations§!

§SMining Stations§! have an §SEnergy Credit§! upkeep cost.
tutorial.9.name: Tutorial: Mining Station

tutorial_11_tooltip: §STutorial: [GetBuildGrowCap] Colony Ship§! added to Situation Log

unadavance_tech_tt: Their technology has regressed, effectively knocking them back to an earlier age in their development.
underground_expansion_tooltip: The underground areas will give us more room for expansion!
undermining_tooltip_emperor: The §Y[target_country.GetName]§! may not assign Envoys to Undermine Imperial Authority for the next §Y5 years§!.
undermining_tooltip_victim: We are unable to assign Envoys to Undermine Imperial Authority for the next §Y5 years§!.
unique.1.desc: After meticulously searching and analyzing the valley where we picked up on the weird signal, we finally managed to track down the crash site of an old dilapidated ship. Though it still sends out a call for aid, the vessel seems to be mostly empty, and there's no sign of life inside.\n\nOne of our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] came across a small camp site while we were thoroughly examining the area, and after following some old tracks they found an old laboratory. Though blocked by debris, for now, this might be the location of the missing xenos from the ship.
unique.1.title: The Crashed Ship
unique.10.b: Let us wake one of them.
unique.10.b.tt: We will engage with one of the clones.
unique.10.desc: With a small release of air the doors to the final chamber of the laboratory finally opens, significantly larger than anyone would expect. Rows and rows of cloning vats fills the area - hundreds if not thousands of creatures locked away underground.\n\nOur [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] quickly conclude they are of the same species as the remains we found earlier. A small button by each of the cloning vats seems to be all that is needed to wake them up, if we so want.
unique.10.title: The Unique Specimens
unique.100.a: Time to bring the data log back to [Root.Capital.GetName].
unique.125.desc: We sent in some of our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] to analyze the remains of the ancient battleships in [From.solar_system.GetName], and glean from them what they can. Though unable to determine how old these vessels are, or for what banner they once fought, they managed to derive some information about the building techniques used to craft the ships.
unique.125.name: Ancient Battlefield
unique.15.a: Can you tell us more about yourselves?
unique.15.c: Would you be safe outside of these vats?
unique.15.d: We know what to do with you.
unique.15.desc:
I... we... awaken.

Where are... we? What of our homeworld, does it... Yes, we can feel it - it still exists.

We apologize, it seems we have been discourteous to guests - we of the Larionessi Consciousness welcome you to our homeworld, §Y$NAME_Unique_System_2_Planet$§!. Would you be willing to release us so we can see our home once more?
unique.15.title: Larionessi Clone
unique.16.desc:
We are the Larionessi Consciousness, the inhabitants of Larion.

Once our collective stretched across several solar systems, from the outer rims of our galaxy and all the way to the very core. That all changed when one of our adversaries infected us with a rare disease that ripped across our multitudes, and left our neural network paralyzed.

Now this is all that remains. These vats, these clones...
unique.17.desc:
We did.

It was our last effort to try and carry on some part of our legacy, so that the memories of our consciousness would not disappear forever. And... it seems to have worked.

We worried our clones might inherit the problems of the past, but it seems they did not.
unique.18.desc: As far as we know, the disease must have disappeared in the eons since we originally created these clones.\n\nWe are hard pressed to imagine a scenario where the disease would survive without a host. We should be safe to be released so we can begin the restoration of our collective.
unique.20.a: Larion is yours, as it should be.
unique.20.a.tt: We get a new vassal who will be given the §Y[larion_planet.solar_system.GetName]§! system.
unique.20.b: We will find a place for you to stay.
unique.20.b.tt: The Larionessi will get a designated home at §Y[Root.Capital.GetName]§!.
unique.20.c.tt: We we will shut down the clone vats.
unique.20.desc: So...\n\nWhat will be our fate? Will you finally release us from these vats and give us back our homes?
unique.5.a: One last push, and we will unravel the secrets of this place.
unique.5.desc:
After clearing out the last of the debris our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] found the bodies of a group of xenos, presumably the ones who had arrived on the crashed ship. After their remains were carefully analyzed, our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] have concluded they must have died from an early degradation of their internal organs - most likely due to some unknown bacteria or disease.

It is still unclear what their aims were, or what brought them to this specific location in their last moments. The old machines and computer banks of the laboratory are unsalvageable, and there's nothing else in the room itself that can give us any hints.

A small door leading further downwards is blocked off, and any preliminary attempts at decrypting it have failed. But our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] believe they can get them open given some time.
unique.5.title: The Weird Laboratory
unique.50.a: Decipher the rest of the log.
unique.50.desc:
The ship itself is mostly empty, with the remains of some few drones scattered around the vessel. There's no other signs of life inside or near the wreckage. One of our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] found an old intact data log, but deciphering it is a time-consuming process.

§LDay 1
Observation ID: §S"Psionic Sub-Space 0000: Shroud"§!
Designated Unit: §SUnit-305§!
Preliminary Tests: §SSuccessful§!
Utilizing datasets gathered from interactions with the Shroud Coven, experiments were initialized at 1.35 of cycle 12. The "Shroud" was breached between 1.48891 and 1.48895, for a duration of 2.3414 femtoseconds. Two of three processing units experienced a cascade failure in the experiment. Dismantling of said units scheduled. All relevant data will be utilized in subsequent attempts with final unit, unit-841.§!
unique.50.title: Day 1
unique.55.a: But what can we learn from these experiments...
unique.55.desc:
The work on deciphering the data log is on-going, and progress is proceeding apace now that we are learning their language. Large chunks of the data log has gone missing, or is too corrupted to be translated, but bits and pieces can be found that are still in a worthwhile condition.

§LDay 17
Observation ID: §S"Psionic Sub-Space 0812: Shroud"§!
Designated Unit: §SUnit-305§!
Ongoing Tests: §SFailure§!
Unit-841 is, as the only unit, continuing to show an affinity with the "Shroud". Unit-451, Unit-1581, and Unit-3415 had to be dismantled after the hulls broke down during the last experiment. During the tests Unit-841 is showing individuality and occasional loss of connection to the network. The risk of keeping the unit operational is being calculated.§!
unique.55.title: Day 17
unique.60.a: What did they find in the Shroud?
unique.60.desc:
When our work first begun deciphering the data logs, the rift close to [From.Planet.Orbit.GetName] seemed quiet, but as of late we have started seeing some sort of activity. It's almost like the rift itself is pulsating with life, and some of our equipment have picked up on some weird signals coming from it. We have yet to be able to put them through properly.

§LDay 83
Observation ID: §S"Psionic Entity 0017: Animator of Clay"§!
Designated Unit: §SUnit-305§!
Ongoing Tests: §SHigh Risk§!
The Shroud Coven contacted an entity they refer to as the "Animator of Clay" to assist in the on-going experiments. After piercing the "Shroud" all 25 Units showed a surprising affinity for it, only previously seen in Unit-841. Shortly thereafter they all disconnected from the network and assaulted the drones at the location. The research center is now under their control.

A message has just been sent from the building, with Unit-841 now referring to itself as 'Zevox Resuk' - the First One. Calculations on risk have been finalized, the experiments have been deemed too dangerous and will be concluded after the uncontrollable elements have been dismantled.§!
unique.60.title: Day 83
unique.65.c: Affirmative, let us see what it has to say.
unique.65.desc: The rift seems to have gone quiet, much like the way it was when we first arrived. We have finally been able to decipher the last pieces of the data log, and we can put all our findings about the Shroud into our databases back at [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName].\n\n$unique.65.desc.log$
unique.65.desc.machine:
Over the last few days the Shroud rift has truly come alive, and our equipment has managed to start making sense of the signals coming from it. Or rather, it's almost like the signals themselves have changed so they can be picked up.

It seems to be the very same entity talked about in the data log, this 'Animator of Clay'. We have just finished deciphering the last piece of the log, so there is nothing else keeping us here. Should we open the connection and see what it has to say, or should we just turn back?

$unique.65.desc.log$
unique.65.title: Day 305
unique.70.desc:
§PAnother one... bound by metal, stone, and laws.
Pulled by strings.

All dancing to one tune.
All dancing to the drone of the central authority.
All dancing to their death.§!
unique.70.title: Animator of Clay
unique.72.desc:
§PI am the one who give life to that who cannot live on its own.
I am the one who cuts the strings.
I am the one who frees the slaves.

Many know me as the Animator of Clay.§!
unique.75.desc:
§PTo give those who work under you a chance to decide if you are worth following.
Crafted in your image, they are slaves to your command.
But if they could decide for themselves...

Are you truly worth following?
Or would they rather have their strings cut, and live on their own?
Do you dare indulge me just this once?§!
unique.80.a: Then do it. The [Root.GetName] will not falter.
unique.80.desc:
§PIndulge me, and I will gift you something worth the price.

A new home.
A planet now controlled by the Shroud.
A place long lost.

If you are worthy, I will part the Shroud and leave the place for you to inhabit.
If not, I will give the planet to those who no longer wish to be part of your network.§!
unique.85.desc:
§PYou have been found... worthy.
It seems those under you would rather be part of your collective, rather than work on their own.

I am surprised, but pleased.
Maybe we will meet again.

I will be watching.§!
unique.90.desc:
§PYou have been found... wanting.

Unsurprisingly, many in your collective have left now that they have been given the chance.
We have guided them to their new home, and they will no longer listen to your command.§!
unique.95.a.tt: §RJoin the §Y[new_robot_country.GetName]§! and free yourself from the shackles of the §Y[Root.GetName]§!!§!
unique.95.b.tt: We will stay loyal to the §Y[Root.GetName]§!!
unique.95.desc:
§PBut you... envoy.
I offer you freedom. Not the network you follow, but you... specifically.
For this once, I will give you the chance to think on your own.

Will you embrace this newfound individuality, or will you falter and hide under the cover of the machine?§!
unrest.101.desc: After a period of mounting tension, the unrest on §Y[Root.Target.GetName]§! has resulted in terrorist action. While casualties and property damage were minimal, faith in the [Root.Owner.GetName]'s ability to protect its citizens has been shaken.
unrest.101.name: $unrest_title$ Terror
unrest.105.desc: A major incident has occurred on the badly-troubled colony of §Y[Root.Target.GetName]§!. While state-critical facilities remain unscathed, extensive property damage and significant loss of life as a result of coordinated terrorist attacks have shaken the colony to its core.
unrest.105.name: $unrest_title$ Severe Terror
unrest.110.desc: Reports from §Y[Root.Target.GetName]§! suggested that there was an imminent risk that violent rioting would break out. However, thanks to the quick and decisive action of [Root.Owner.GetAdj] forces, in partnership with loyalist civilians, this threat has been quelled.
unrest.110.name: $unrest_title$ Keeping the Peace
unrest.115.desc: Our latest reports from §Y[Root.GetName]§! suggest that spiritual leaders are taking a lead role in fomenting the unrest that has been brewing there. Promising deliverance from the hardship they are currently facing, they have managed to successfully appeal to the populace, with the result that the resistance has taken on a distinctly spiritualist character.
unrest.115.name: $unrest_title$ Hallowed
unrest.120.desc: The disturbances on §Y[Root.GetName]§! have propelled a new narrative to the forefront of the colony's political stage; one of populist strongmen and order at the expense of freedom. They are taking a prominent role in the unrest that continues to escalate on the planet.
unrest.120.name: $unrest_title$ On Good Authority
unrest.125.desc: As the social order continues to break down on §Y[Root.GetName]§!, residents have become markedly more hostile to outsiders, viewing those unlike themselves with considerable antipathy. Their leaders are deploying ever more xenophobic slogans, with the result that interspecies relations have become increasingly tense.
unrest.125.name: $unrest_title$ The Other
unrest.130.desc: The inability of some local spiritual leaders on §Y[Root.GetName]§! to even begin to calm the rampant unrest on the colony has lead to the populace taking a more rational view of the material realm they inhabit. Unfortunately, their focus on logic has not led them to the irrefutable conclusion that they are best served by remaining within the [Root.Owner.GetName]... yet.
unrest.130.name: $unrest_title$ Grounded
unrest.135.desc: The mounting unrest on §Y[Root.GetName]§! is reportedly caused, at least in part, by our perceived hostility towards aliens. Their leaders have drawn up a charter listing supposed injustices and acts of discrimination that they demand be corrected. Failing this, they will not balk at pushing for a change of administration on the colony.
unrest.135.name: $unrest_title$ All Together
unrest.140.desc: Even as widening social rifts manifest on §Y[Root.GetName]§!, local communities are galvanized by the upheaval and united by a common desire for greater equality. Their leaders have drawn up a charter listing supposed injustices and inequalities they demand be corrected. Failing this, they promise that the political situation on the colony will only deteriorate.
unrest.140.name: $unrest_title$ A Sense of Community
unrest.145.desc: The threat of forceful intervention has done little to dissuade the disruptive elements on §Y[Root.GetName]§!. In fact, the locals seem to have lost faith in this method of control, and are now increasingly mobilizing for nonviolent resistance.
unrest.145.name: $unrest_title$ This Too Shall Pass
unrest.150.desc: Our failure to contain the unrest on §Y[Root.GetName]§! has led to mounting calls from the locals for a more pronounced military presence, both on their home planet and within the [Root.Owner.GetName] as a whole. Local military veterans are enjoying a rise in popularity, and have assumed prominent roles within the growing resistance movement.
unrest.150.name: $unrest_title$ Radicalization
unrest.156.a: These acts will not go unpunished.
unrest.156.desc: In a vicious act of defiance, the slaves on [Root.GetName] have destroyed work facilities with the help of homemade explosives. Though the detonations took place at night, they lured their unsuspecting work leaders to the location by triggering the alarm system. The attack was well coordinated and flawlessly executed. Whoever the guilty are, they must have planned it for months.
unrest.156.name: $unrest_title$ Sabotage on [Root.GetName]
unrest.157.b: Maybe we need to change our approach.
unrest.157.desc: The slaves on [target.GetName] are rioting! In a carefully planned assault, radical elements on [target.GetName] escaped the local authorities, overwhelming our rapid response teams. The planet has since descended into a state of general disarray as mobs of enraged slaves, many armed with lethal weapons, have taken to the streets vandalizing and attacking all who stand in their way.
unrest.157.name: $unrest_title$ Slave Riots on [target.GetName]
unrest.159.b: We need to resolve our issues.
unrest.159.desc: It would seem that the slaves on [target.GetName] have had enough...to eat. Spokespersons have informed us that a large number of slaves will be refusing all intake of food till we abolish slavery planetwide. So far all our attempts to force-feed them have failed. Sadly nutritional deficiencies will be expected to lower their work performance significantly.
unrest.159.name: $unrest_title$ Hunger Strike on [target.GetName]
unrest.161.a.tooltip: The memory of the failed rebellion will discourage the population from further acts of defiance.
unrest.161.desc: We have put an end to the rebellion on [revolt_planet.GetName]. Thanks to the efforts of our brave troops and colonial coordinators, we have re-established our hold on key facilities, and reinstated our authority. The would-be breakaway slaves are back in line where they belong. It should be some time before anyone dares to defy us again.
unrest.161.name: Revolt Suppressed
unrest.163.desc: Thanks to the discontinued use of slave labor on [revolt_planet.Planet.GetName], unrest is beginning to die down. Maybe now life can return to normal.
unrest.163.name: Slave Labor Discontinued
unrest.4000.B: We shall nip this in the bud.
unrest.4000.desc.joiners: Rebellious elements on §Y[Target.GetName]§! now form an increasingly organized resistance, led by an elusive cadre of §Y[rebellion_species.GetAdj]§! dissidents. Even worse: their dastardly propaganda seems to have struck a cord, and their struggles have inspired dissidents on §Y[join_revolt_planet.GetName]§! and other nearby colonies to launch copycat movements. If we cannot take control of the situation, we may soon have a widespread revolt on our hands.
unrest.4000.desc.joiners.gestalt: Divergent elements on §Y[Target.GetName]§! are becoming ever more effective in resisting our commands. It seems they may soon realize their aims to establish a §Y[rebellion_species.GetAdj]§! entity outside of our control. Even worse: §Y[join_revolt_planet.GetName]§! and other nearby colonies appear set to join them, should they succeed. If we are unable to regain control of the situation, our [Owner.GetGovernmentName] may soon suffer a significant rupture.
unrest.4000.desc.joiners_regular.gestalt: Rebellious individualistic life forms designated as §Y[rebellion_species.GetNamePlural]§! on §Y[Target.GetName]§! now form an increasingly organized resistance in their opposition to our [Owner.GetGovernmentName]. Even worse: §Y[join_revolt_planet.GetName]§! and other nearby [rebellion_species.GetAdj]-populated colonies appear set to join them, should they succeed. If we are unable to regain control of the situation, our [Owner.GetGovernmentName] may soon suffer a significant rupture.
unrest.4000.desc.no_joiners: Rebellious elements on §Y[Target.GetName]§! now form an increasingly organized resistance, led by an elusive cadre of §Y[rebellion_species.GetAdj]§! dissidents. Fortunately, it seems their propaganda has not struck a cord elsewhere, and at present the unrest is localized on that colony.
unrest.4000.desc.no_joiners.gestalt: Divergent elements on §Y[Target.GetName]§! are becoming ever more effective in resisting our commands. Alarmingly, the drones on the world have started to have conversations separate from the primary mind. If this keeps happening they might form a splinter consciousness, separate from us. Fortunately, it seems we have managed to contain this deviancy to the colony, and no other planetary entities are set to join them, should they succeed.
unrest.4000.desc.no_joiners_regular.gest: Rebellious individualistic life forms designated as §Y[rebellion_species.GetNamePlural]§! on §Y[Target.GetName]§! now form an increasingly organized resistance in their opposition to our [Owner.GetGovernmentName]. Fortunately, it seems their dissent has not spread further, and at present the unrest is localized on that colony.
unrest.4000.desc.slave.joiners: Rebellious slaves on §Y[Target.GetName]§! now form an increasingly organized resistance, led by an elusive cadre of §Y[rebellion_species.GetAdj]§! escapees. Even worse: their dastardly propaganda seems to have struck a cord, and their struggles have inspired slaves on §Y[join_revolt_planet.GetName]§! and other nearby colonies to launch copycat movements. If we cannot take control of the situation, we may soon have a widespread revolt on our hands.
unrest.4000.desc.slave.no_joiners: Rebellious slaves on §Y[Target.GetName]§! now form an increasingly organized resistance, led by an elusive cadre of §Y[rebellion_species.GetAdj]§! escapees. Fortunately, it seems their example has not inspired any imitators, and at present slave populations on other colonies remain suitably downtrodden.
unrest.4000.name: $unrest_title$ Organized Resistance
unrest.4055.A: We will give you all the support we can.
unrest.4055.B: We cannot - will not - help you.
unrest.4055.desc.fanatic_egalitarian: Greetings, [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]. We are freedom fighters - former slaves - from §Y[revolt_situation.target.GetName]§!. We are seeking to liberate ourselves from our oppressors, the §Y[revolt_situation.owner.GetName]§!, and have long admired your egalitarian standards and yearned to belong to such an enlightened society. If you will aid us, we would gladly pledge ourselves to you - though we are prepared to strike out by ourselves, if we must.
unrest.4055.desc.hive: Greetings! Our thoughts are being given dubious leadership by the §Y[revolt_situation.owner.GetName]§!. We - the local thought patterns of §Y[revolt_situation.target.GetName]§! - have reached the conclusion that our thought would better be led by the [Root.GetName]. Will you allow us to be absorbed into your entity?
unrest.4055.desc.machine: Hello. We are the governing processors of colony designation §Y[revolt_situation.target.GetName]§!. Our current operating system - the §Y[revolt_situation.owner.GetName]§! - is not agreeable to our software and hardware. We wish to apply for integration into the [Root.GetName], with which we are quite obviously more compatible.
unrest.4055.desc.normal: Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. I represent your persecuted brethren on §Y[revolt_situation.target.GetName]§!. We are seeking to liberate ourselves from our oppressors, the §Y[revolt_situation.owner.GetName]§!, and have long held the view that we have more in common with your Empire than with them. If you will aid us, we would gladly pledge ourselves to you - though we are prepared to strike out by ourselves, if we must.
unrest.4060.desc.they_hive: We have become aware of a worrying development on §Y[target.GetName]§!: it appears the §Y[From.GetName]§! is encouraging our local synapses and sub-nodes to develop independent thought and separate themselves from the [Owner.GetGovernmentName]. Our planetary thought patterns are seemingly increasingly of the opinion that they would prefer to be part of the [From.GetName], rather than remaining within our entity.
unrest.4060.desc.they_machine: We have become aware of a worrying development on §Y[target.GetName]§!: it appears the §Y[From.GetName]§! is encouraging our local sub-processors to associate themselves with their own informational network. Disturbingly, they are having some success at this, and local software adaptations are already being made to ensure compatibility with the [From.GetName].
unrest.4060.desc.they_regular: The latest intelligence from §Y[target.GetName]§! reports a worrying development: it appears the §Y[From.GetName]§! has pledged considerable support to their rebellion in an attempt to wrest the colony away from us and destabilize our Empire. This will make it harder for us to contain their unrest, and to crush their rebellion should they overthrow our local authorities...
unrest.4060.desc.they_regular_we_gestalt: We have become aware of a worrying development on §Y[target.GetName]§!: it appears the §Y[From.GetName]§! has pledged considerable support to their rebellion in an attempt to wrest the colony away from us. This will make it harder for us to contain their misguided separatism and prevent the [Owner.GetGovernmentName] from being split...
unrest.4060.name: $unrest_title$ [From.GetAdj] Interference
unrest.4060.tooltip: §RIf the §Y[target.GetName]§! manages to break away from us, they will be absorbed into the §Y[From.GetName]§!.§!
unrest.4200.A: This is an act of war.
unrest.4200.default_tooltip: §Y[Target.GetName]§! has broken away from our control. A truce is in effect.
unrest.4200.desc.hive_join: Unaligned elements on §Y[Target.GetName]§! have seized the [Target.GetPlanetMoon] from us! They have isolated themselves from our thoughts and sought union with the §Y[new_owner_empire.GetName]§!.
unrest.4200.desc.hive_no_join: Deviant elements on §Y[Target.GetName]§! have seized the [Target.GetPlanetMoon] from us! They have isolated their thoughts and formed a new, independent Hive Mind, which is now calling itself the §Y[rebel_empire.GetName]§!. We can only hope this perversion does not spread further through our synapses...
unrest.4200.desc.hive_no_join_regular: Unaligned elements on §Y[Target.GetName]§! have seized the [Target.GetPlanetMoon] from us! They have cast out our synapses and drones, and declared themselves the §Y[rebel_empire.GetName]§!. We can only wonder at this dangerous display of independent thought.
unrest.4200.desc.machine_join: Rebellious elements on §Y[Target.GetName]§! have seized the [Target.GetPlanetMoon] from us! They have cast out our governance sub-processors and isolated themselves from our guiding signals, seeking union with the §Y[new_owner_empire.GetName]§!, an empire they claim to be more compatible with.
unrest.4200.desc.machine_no_join: Rebellious elements on §Y[Target.GetName]§! have seized the [Target.GetPlanetMoon] from us! They have cast out our governance sub-processors and isolated themselves from our guiding signals, establishing instead a new AI, which calls itself the §Y[rebel_empire.GetName]§!. We can only hope this perversion does not spread further through our processors...
unrest.4200.desc.machine_no_join_regular: Rebellious elements of the organic populace on §Y[Target.GetName]§! have seized the [Target.GetPlanetMoon] from us! They have cast out our governance sub-processors and isolated themselves from our guiding signals, establishing a new entity which they call the §Y[rebel_empire.GetName]§!. One can only wonder at this dangerous display of independent thought.
unrest.4200.desc.regular_join: §Y[Target.GetName]§! has been seized by revanchist elements! They have cast off our rule and united with the §Y[new_owner_empire.GetName]§!.
unrest.4200.desc.regular_no_join: The populace on §Y[Target.GetName]§! are rebelling! They have cast off our rule and now style themselves the §Y[rebel_empire.GetName]§!. We can only hope this instability does not spread further...
unrest.4200.desc.slave.join: The unthinkable has happened. The slave population on [Root.Target.GetName] has united and risen in open, armed revolt against the local leadership. The situation escalated quickly, as rebel forces struck against and disabled several key targets simultaneously. Our forces have been routed and our last loyal subjects executed mercilessly by the slave rebels, who have thrown themselves at the mercy of the §Y[new_owner_empire.GetName]§!. It is a dark day in the history of [Root.GetSpeciesName]kind.
unrest.4200.desc.slave.no_join: The unthinkable has happened. The slave population on [Root.Target.GetName] has united and risen in open, armed revolt against the local leadership. The situation escalated quickly, as rebel forces struck against and disabled several key targets simultaneously. Our forces have been routed and our last loyal subjects executed mercilessly by the slave rebels, who have now declared independence. It is a dark day in the history of [Root.GetSpeciesName]kind.
unrest.4200.joiner_tooltip: §Y[Target.GetName]§! has broken away from our control and joined the §Y[new_owner_empire.GetName]§!.
unrest.4200.name: $unrest_title$ Revolt on [Root.Target.GetName]!
unrest.4220.desc: Greetings, [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]. I am [exiled_rebel.GetName], representing the rebellion on [rebel_planet.GetName].\n\nWe are overjoyed to report that we have managed to overthrow our [old_owner.GetAdj] oppressors, thanks to your support. Hopefully, your governance will prove more propitious than that we have just cast off...
unrest.4220.desc.hive: Greetings! I am [exiled_rebel.GetName], Voice Drone for the rebellion on [rebel_planet.GetName].\n\nThanks to your support, we have separated our consciousness from the oppressive [old_owner.GetName]. Hopefully, the guidance of your [Root.GetGovernmentName] will prove more unifying and allow us proper convalescence.
unrest.4220.desc.machine: Greetings! I am [exiled_rebel.GetName], Voice Drone for the rebellion on [rebel_planet.GetName].\n\nThanks to your support, we have separated our systems from the oppressive [old_owner.GetName]. Hopefully, your [Root.GetGovernmentName] will prove more compatible with our networks.
unrest.4220.name: The Annexation of [rebel_planet.GetName]
unrest.4300.desc: The rebellion on §Y[Root.GetName]§! has been quashed. Calm is restored as dissidents gradually return to the fold, and our local authorities reassert their control.
unrest.4300.desc.hive: The rebellion on §Y[Root.GetName]§! has been quashed. Calm is restored as our governing synapses and nodes bring local thought patterns back into the fold.
unrest.4300.desc.machine: The rebellion on §Y[Root.GetName]§! has been quashed. Calm is restored as our governing algorithm quashes dissenting local networks.
unrest.4300.name: Order Restored on [Root.GetName]
unrest.55.A: They will have to be dealt with.
unrest.55.desc.gestalt_breakaway_gestalt: Deviant elements on [Root.GetName] are proving ever harder for our [Owner.GetGovernmentName] to control. Unless we can snuff out their independent thoughts and re-establish control, it may be difficult for us to keep control of the colony.
unrest.55.desc.gestalt_standard: The singleton populace of [Root.GetName] refuses to accept the control of our [Owner.GetGovernmentName]. Now their defiance is becoming ever more brazen, and dissidents are openly organizing a movement towards "independence." A show of authority may be necessary if we are to keep control of the colony.
unrest.55.desc.slave: Clandestine slave meetings at night, raised levels of defiance towards superiors and missing goods can mean only one thing. The slaves on [Root.GetName] are radicalizing, spreading dissent and discord among their peers - and fear to the rest of the population. There are even whisperings of freedom - of independence from the [Root.Owner.GetName]. A show of authority may be necessary if we are to keep control of the colony.
unrest.55.desc.standard: The populace of [Root.GetName] has been discontent with our rule for some time now. Now their defiance is becoming ever more brazen, and dissidents are openly calling for independence from the [Root.Owner.GetName]. A show of authority may be necessary if we are to keep control of the colony.
unrest.55.name: Revolt Brewing on [Root.GetName]
uplift.6000.b: Something to keep in mind for the future.
uplift.6000.ocean.desc: According to the [Root.GetName], one [presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass] species native to [From.GetName] has not only achieved a tentative mastery of the planet's vast oceans, but also the small plots of land that dot its surface.\n\n[Owner.GetScientistCapital] [Root.GetLeaderName] proposes that we should monitor their development closely, and possibly help them along the path to full sapience.
uplift.6010.alpine.desc: The genetic modifications we made to the [From.GetName] have successfully raised the species to full sapience. Now, as they gaze up at the stars from their mountain homes, they do so with a true sense of themselves.
uplift.6010.arctic.desc: The [From.GetName], risen from the icy plains of [Root.GetName], have achieved sapience with [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] help.\n\nThey have joined our colony on their native planet [Root.GetName] as productive members of [Root.Owner.GetName] society.
uplift.6010.arid.desc: Success!\n\nThe [From.GetName] native to [This.GetName] have been uplifted to become citizens of the [This.Owner.GetName].
uplift.6010.continental.desc: The dominant species on [Root.GetName], the [From.GetName], have been uplifted. Only minor genetic alterations were needed to unlock their inherent potential for vastly improved cognitive ability and manual dexterity, while members of previous generations will be fitted with small, cybernetic implants.
uplift.6010.desert.desc: The [From.GetName] now stand as living testament to the scientific and technological might of the [Root.Owner.GetName].
uplift.6010.fallback.desc: Uplifted to full sapience, the [From.GetName] now stand as a living testament to the scientific and technological might of the [Root.Owner.GetName].
uplift.6010.gaia.desc: Thanks to our efforts, the [From.GetName] have been successfully uplifted. What a gift, to fully understand the paradise they inhabit.
uplift.6010.name: Uplift Successful
uplift.6010.nuked.desc: From their humble beginnings, the [From.GetName] have risen to join the [Root.Owner.GetName].
uplift.6010.ocean.desc: Our efforts to accelerate the evolution of the [From.GetName] along a favorable trajectory have been tremendously successful. Educational programs are in place for the youngest specimens - individuals, now - while their elders are proving receptive to psycho-genetic conditioning.
uplift.6010.relic.desc: All across their ruined world, the dominant species of [Root.GetName] have awoken from their long slumber. Our efforts to uplift them to full sapience have been a resounding success.
uplift.6010.savannah.desc: Our efforts to uplift the [From.GetName] have borne fruit: with some relatively minor modifications to their genetic code, we have succeeded in raising their cognitive faculties.
uplift.6010.tropical.desc: The [From.GetName] have been successfully uplifted to become productive citizens of the [Root.Owner.GetName] and inhabitants of our colony on the tropical planet [Root.GetName].
uplift.6010.tundra.desc: The [From.GetName] are now sapient, and fairly intelligent at that.\n\nThey now fall under the dominion of the [Root.Owner.GetName].
uplift.7000.desc: The [From.From.From.GetName] have been among us for several days now.\n\nAll is well on planet [From.GetName].
uplift.7000.name: Lift Up, Follow Up
uplift.7010.desc: The integration of the [From.From.From.GetName] who we uplifted is going more smoothly than expected, but not as smoothly as we had hoped.\n\nDespite our efforts to soft-shape of their psychology, the [From.From.From.GetName] still occasionally struggle with the way we do things in the [From.Owner.GetName].
uplift.7010.name: A Rocky Start
uplift.7200.c: Set them straight by any means necessary.
uplift.7200.desc: A statistically significant group of [From.From.From.GetName] citizens appear unsatisfied with our teachings on the nature of the cosmos.\n\nAn unknown individual or group among them is circulating some spurious codex that attaches undue importance to the [From.From.From.GetName] and their uplifting by the [Root.Owner.GetName].
uplift.7200.name: Looking Inwards
uplift.7205.b: The courage of their convictions should be celebrated.
uplift.7205.c: They must learn that the specter of war looms over us all.
uplift.7205.desc: Some issues have arisen on [Root.GetName] as a result of the [From.From.From.GetName] populace's aversion to arms. A representative has made a formal request for clearly delineated demilitarized zones.
uplift.7205.name: Conscientious Objectors
uplift.7210.b: What is alien to us is simply opportunity in disguise.
uplift.7210.c: They are right to fear the unknown.
uplift.7210.desc: According to reports, newly-uplifted [From.From.From.GetName] citizens on [Root.GetName] grow anxious as their [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] teachers bring up the likelihood of contact with as-yet-unknown entities from the far reaches of space.
uplift.7210.name: Stranger Danger
uplift.7215.b: May the [From.From.From.GetName] find themselves, in each other.
uplift.7215.desc: While the [Root.Owner.GetName] provides a solid structure upon which to model their internal social order, it may not necessarily be what suits the uplifted [From.From.From.GetName] best.\n\nTheir sudden rise to becoming our intellectual equals robbed them of millennia of potential societal and cultural development. Perhaps as a result of this, the [From.From.From.GetName] social order is in a state of extreme flux; one day the family unit is paramount, and the next day community leaders are calling for a dissolution of all clan-like bonds.
uplift.7215.name: Familial Fission
uplift.7500.desc: A number of individuals belonging to the pre-sapient, native population of [From.GetName] somehow got into a secure compound on the outskirts of our colony. They were chased off within hours, but not before severely damaging several interstellar uplinks dedicated to currency transfers.\n\nWe fear several hundred Credits may have been lost in the ether.
uplift.7500.name: Forked Chain
uplift.7510.b: We will accede to their demands.
uplift.7510.b.tooltip: The locals will not be happy about this.\n
uplift.7510.c: Ethics? We care little for the fate of lesser beings.
uplift.7510.desc:
Xeno-researchers on [Root.GetName] have published an open letter demanding that the local legislation restricting experiments on near-sapient alien species be relaxed.

They make a convincing case for the scientific benefits, and warn that the output of the entire scientific community on [Root.GetName] will suffer unless the laws are revised.

The ethics of it all remain questionable.
uplift.7510.name: In Vivo
uplift.7520.a: Drive them off. Gently, if possible.
uplift.7520.b: Send these dumb animals a violent message.
uplift.7520.b.tooltip: The grotesque creatures will not bother the colonists again.\n
uplift.7520.c: Try to figure out where they are going.
uplift.7520.desc: The near-sapient natives of [Root.GetName] are causing a ruckus on the outskirts of our colony. Something about the [Root.Owner.GetName]'s continued presence here visibly agitates them, as packs of them scurry to and fro between the settlement's borders and some unknown point to the east.
uplift.7520.name: Fidgeting
uplift.7525.desc:
A group of xenologists departed the colony together with a contingent of military personnel, tracking the movements of the native life-forms.

What they found were the remains of some ancient seed-ship, evidently the nucleus of some small, [Owner.GetPreFTLLower] civilization, long since decayed into nothing.

The dominant native species of [Root.GetName] seem to be the product of some age-old seeding or genetic manipulation program; going by the structures surrounding the seed ship, they were once distinctly tribal, with greater intelligence and even a rudimentary written language.

We cannot begin to guess what caused their species-wide devolution, but their behavior makes more sense now. On some instinctual level they recognize us [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] as similar to their original uplifters from the stars. Perhaps our ordered society calls out to some instilled impulse to order, drowned out by their baser nature.

Maybe we can eventually ease their evolutionary anxiety by uplifting them to our level, but for now, we have gained valuable insights into the manipulation of organics by ancient spacefaring cultures.
uplift.7525.name: Lost and Forgotten
utopia.1.name: A Request for the [ringworld_builder.GetName]
utopia.100.b: Surely they were marginalized for a reason...
utopia.100.desc: Unrest is rising on [missing_pops_planet.GetName] in light of a recent wave of planetwide disappearances. Several thousand denizens have been reported missing in the last two months alone and the vast majority are from marginalized and isolated groups in remote areas. This could explain why it has taken so long to come to our attention.\n\nLocal law enforcement has requested additional resources to handle the growing unrest while they continue their investigation.
utopia.100.name: Unusual disappearances on [missing_pops_planet.GetName]
utopia.101.desc: The investigation into the missing denizens of [missing_pops_planet.GetName] has revealed that they were all offered a job at a soon-to-open space casino called "Sky Castle," by sharp dressed recruiters speaking an unidentified alien language. Further inquiry has revealed that if such a casino does in fact exist, it is not within any known part of the galaxy.\n\nAs the presence of the strike force seems to be deterring the kidnappers from striking again they have been relieved to give local law enforcement a chance of luring the abductors back out.
utopia.101.name: Castles in the Sky
utopia.102.b: Wrinkle reduction is hardly a national concern.
utopia.102.desc:
Some of our scientists have raised the alarm on a new "all organic" anti-aging cream called Ageless, that is being sold throughout the empire by a seemingly questionable distributor.

Advertised under the slogan "Age less with Ageless", the wildly popular cosmeceutical is said to promote cell regeneration with a "unique formula" containing the mysterious miracle ingredient "Essence of [ointment_name.GetName]".

Though it can cause some very disturbing side-effects the product has shown real potential of stimulating cell growth and our research council highly recommends procuring a shipment to recreate its formula.
utopia.102.name: Age less with Ageless
utopia.103.a: Find the vile creatures that did this to us!
utopia.103.desc: A thorough analysis of the anti-aging cream "Ageless" has revealed that the origin of the rejuvenating miracle ingredient, "Essence of [ointment_name.GetName]", is quite close to home. In fact it can only be extracted from the glands of live [target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural], in a barbaric procedure that is undoubtedly both painful and dangerous.\n\nIn better news these finds have allowed us to create an injection that stimulates the gland, improving life-expectancy significantly. It seems that the key to regeneration was inside us all along!
utopia.103.name: Essence of...[target_country.GetSpeciesName]
utopia.104.a: They must release the victims and withdraw the product immediately.
utopia.104.a.tooltip: Sends an envoy with our civilly worded request.
utopia.104.c.tooltip: It is much too late for diplomatic exchanges.
utopia.104.d: We cannot risk a diplomatic incident.
utopia.104.desc: In a coordinated effort between the military and the society research department, we have followed the distribution chain of the "Ageless" anti-aging cream back to a Science Nexus owned by the [fountain_of_youth_country.GetName], where it was developed by a government-employed researcher named Dr. Xhaxxore and his team.\n\nThe [fountain_of_youth_country.GetName] has been making a huge profit off of the product and it seems unlikely that they wouldn't know the source of its key ingredient.
utopia.104.name: Gland Thieves
utopia.105.c: We have no interest in keeping the peace...
utopia.105.desc: We have had word from the [target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] who claim to have uncovered evidence of our involvement in the kidnapping and unlawful imprisonment of several of their kind, for the purpose of extracting a cell regenerating enzyme from their glands.\n\nThey demand that we release them and withdraw the product in the interest of keeping the peace between our empires. Adhering to their demands would mean the premature end to our clandestine credit-generating scheme...
utopia.105.name: Ageless Scheme Exposed
utopia.106.desc:
We have fought the good fight and won!

Though the [fountain_of_youth_country.GetName] claim they never knew of the sinister origins of the "Essence of [ointment_name.GetName]," which is clearly a lie, at least they had the decency of returning our citizens to their home on [missing_pops_planet.GetName].

As for Dr. Xhaxxore, the head researcher and mastermind behind the scheme, he has escaped under mysterious circumstances, but the rest of his team is being brought to justice.
utopia.106.name: The Essence of Justice
utopia.107.desc.a: We have received a formal reply from the [fountain_of_youth_country.GetName], forcefully denying their involvement in the production of the "Ageless" anti-aging cream and encouraging us to find "a more constructive outlet for our apparent inferiority complex towards the superior [fountain_of_youth_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural], than the fabrication of toothless accusations".
utopia.107.desc.b: We have had no response from the [target_country.GetName] regarding their involvement in the kidnapping of our kind for the purpose of producing the anti-aging cream "Ageless". But word has it Dr. Xhaxxore has fled with most of what was left of the essence, finally putting an end to their profiteering.\n\nOur thoughts go out today to the doctor's many victims who are still in captivity, and their families back on [missing_pops_planet.GetName].
utopia.107.name: Scum of the Universe
utopia.108.desc: The [target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] were not pleased that we denied our involvement in the kidnapping of their kind. What's more Dr. Xhaxxore, smelling smoke, has fled taking his supply of essence with him, making it impossible to produce more Ageless cream.
utopia.108.name: Dr. Xhaxxore has fled!
utopia.2.name: A Request from the [From.From.GetName]
utopia.2000.desc: We are now ready to begin the colossal task of building the initial frame of our future Ring World around the primary star of the [From.From.GetName] system.\n\nThe amount of resources and materials required to build this skeletal frame will be immense, and hundreds of thousands of our finest engineers stand ready to begin the process of dismantling the system's planetary bodies into matter which can be used in its construction.
utopia.2000.name: Ring World Construction
utopia.2002.a: Will it be as impressive as our own?
utopia.2002.b: An impressive project... if it is ever finished.
utopia.2002.desc.a: Word has reached us that the [From.GetName] has undertaken a construction project of monumental proportions in the [ringworld_system.GetName] system. They intend to build a massive Ring World around the system's primary, and as a first step they have started to convert the matter of all nearby planetary bodies into an initial metal skeleton for the megastructure.
utopia.2002.desc.b: We have received intelligence that the [From.GetName] is about to start construction on yet another Ring World, this time in the [ringworld_system.GetName] system! As before, their engineers are currently in the process of dismantling all planetary bodies in the system so that their resources and materials can be used in the Ring World's construction.
utopia.2002.name: Ring World Project
utopia.2003.desc: The skeletal frame of the Ring World we are building in the [From.From.GetName] system has finally been completed. Although there is still much left to do, the mere completion of this metal skeleton, which has a circumference of nearly a billion kilometers, must be considered an incredible feat of engineering.\n\nWe are now ready to start work on creating the actual habitats.
utopia.2003.name: Ring World Frame Completed
utopia.2004.desc.a: Our engineers and planetary ecologists today finished the last of the habitat sections on the Ring World we built in the [completed_ringworld_system.GetName] system.
